# THE SECRET DOCTRINE

<term>Secret Doctrine</term> <note>This term refers to a body of hidden or esoteric wisdom that the author claims underlies all world religions and philosophies, accessible only to those initiated into its mysteries.</note>

<summary>This page is the half-title for the work, presenting the main title "The Secret Doctrine," which introduces the reader to the theme of hidden spiritual knowledge.</summary>

<summary>This is the title page for the second volume of H. P. Blavatsky's foundational occult work, "The Secret Doctrine," focusing on the origins of humanity (Anthropogenesis). It identifies this copy as the third revised edition, published in London and reprinted multiple times through the early 20th century.</summary>

<meta>This page serves as the copyright and legal registration record for Volume II of "The Secret Doctrine." It appears on the verso (back) of the title page. The text confirms the work's legal status in both the United States and the United Kingdom, noting the original copyright date of 1888 despite this being a later printing. Faint ink from the title page is visible through the paper.</meta>

->*“Entered according to the Act of Congress in the year 1888, by H. P. Blavatsky,*<- <note>The Act of Congress refers to the United States copyright law of the time, which required authors to register their works with the Library of Congress to secure legal protection.</note>
->*in the Office of the Librarian of Congress at Washington, D.C.”*<-

->ENTERED AT STATIONERS’ HALL<- <note>Stationers' Hall in London was the headquarters of the Stationers' Company; until 1911, registering a book here was the standard way to secure copyright in the United Kingdom.</note>

->ALL RIGHTS RESERVED<-

<summary>This page contains the formal copyright and legal registration notices for Volume II of "The Secret Doctrine," establishing Helena Petrovna Blavatsky's ownership of the material in both the United States and Great Britain as of 1888.</summary>

<meta>Following the scriptural authority established on the previous page, this section introduces the philosophical argument for evolution as both a physical and spiritual process.</meta>

Modern science insists upon the doctrine of evolution; so do human reason and the *Secret Doctrine*, and the idea is supported by ancient legends and myths, and even by the *Bible* itself when it is read "between the lines" <note>interpreting the hidden or symbolic meaning rather than just the literal text</note>. We see a flower slowly developing from a bud, and the bud from its seed. But where does the seed come from, with its pre-set program of physical transformation? What about its invisible—and therefore *spiritual*—forces that gradually develop its form, color, and scent? 

The word *evolution* speaks for itself. The "germ" <term>germ: the initial spark or seed of life</term> of the current human race must have existed beforehand in the ancestors of this race, just as the seed containing next summer’s flower was developed in the seed-pod of its parent flower. The parent may be only *slightly* different, but it still differs from its future offspring. The pre-flood <note>original: "antediluvian"</note> ancestors of the modern elephant and lizard were, perhaps, the mammoth and the plesiosaurus <term>plesiosaurus: a large, long-necked marine reptile from the dinosaur era</term>. Why then shouldn't the ancestors of our human race have been the *"giants"* of the *Vedas* <note>ancient Hindu scriptures</note>, the *Völuspá* <note>original: Völuspa; an Old Norse poem describing the creation of the world</note>, and the *Book of Genesis*? 

While it is completely absurd to believe that the “transformation of species” took place according to some of the more materialistic views of the evolutionists, it is only natural to think that each genus—beginning with mollusks and ending with "monkey-men"—has changed from its own original and distinct form.

->—*Isis Unveiled*, I. 152-3.<-

## THE ARCHAIC STANZAS, AND THE FOUR PREHISTORIC CONTINENTS.

> "The appearance of the entire universe, although it varies in infinite ways, remains nonetheless always the same."—SPINOZA. <note>original: "Facies totius universi, quamvis infinitis modis variet, Manet tamen semper eadem."</note>

The Stanzas, along with the commentaries on them in this volume, are drawn from the same ancient records as the Stanzas on the creation of the universe <note>original: "Cosmogony"</note> in Volume I. As far as possible, a word-for-word translation is provided. However, some of the Stanzas are too obscure to be understood without explanation. Therefore, just as in Volume I, they are first presented in full exactly as they appear. Then, when they are examined verse by verse alongside their commentaries, an attempt is made to make them clearer by adding words in footnotes, looking ahead to the fuller explanations found in the commentary itself.

Regarding the evolution of mankind, the *Secret Doctrine* proposes three new ideas that stand in direct opposition to modern science as well as current religious dogmas. It teaches: 

(a) The simultaneous evolution of seven human groups on seven different portions of our globe; 
(b) The birth of the *astral* <term>astral: a subtle, non-physical energy body that serves as a blueprint for the physical form</term> body before the *physical* body, with the former serving as a model for the latter; 
(c) That man, in this Round <term>Round: a major cycle of evolutionary development for life on Earth</term>, preceded every mammal—including the anthropoids <term>anthropoids: the group of primates including monkeys and great apes</term>—in the animal kingdom.*

The *Secret Doctrine* is not alone in speaking of primeval men born simultaneously on the seven divisions of our globe. In the *Divine Pymander* <note>a foundational text of Hermeticism, an ancient philosophical and religious tradition</note> of Hermes Trismegistus, we find the same seven primeval—

Humans evolved from Nature and the "Heavenly Man" in a collective sense—specifically from the Creative Spirits. In the fragments of Chaldæan <note>original: "Chaldæan"; referring to the ancient region of Babylonia</note> tablets collected by George Smith, which contain the Babylonian Legend of Creation, the first column of the Cutha tablet mentions seven human beings "with the faces of ravens" (meaning they had dark, swarthy complexions) whom "the [seven] Great Gods created." Or, as explained in lines 16, 17, and 18:

> In the midst of the earth they grew up and became great,
> And increased in number,
> Seven kings, brothers of the same family.†

These are the seven Kings of Edom referred to in the *Kabbalah*; they represent the First Race, which was imperfect because it was born before the "balance" (the separation of the sexes) existed, and was therefore destroyed.‡

Seven Kings, who were brothers, appeared and fathered children; their people numbered 6,000. The God Nergal <note>original: "Nergas"; likely a typo for Nergal, the Babylonian god of death and the underworld</note> [death] destroyed them. "How did he destroy them?" By bringing into equilibrium [or balance] those who did not yet exist.§

They were "destroyed" as a race by being merged into their own descendants (through a process of exudation <term>exudation: a process where the physical form "sweats out" or gives rise to the next form</term>). In other words, the sexless Race reincarnated into the (potentially) bisexual race; the bisexual race then reincarnated into the androgynous <term>androgynous: having both male and female characteristics</term> race; and these, in turn, became the sexual beings of the later Third Race. If the tablets were less damaged, they would be found to contain a word-for-word account of the same history found in the *Archaic Records* and in the works of Hermes <term>Hermes: referring to Hermes Trismegistus, the legendary figure associated with ancient Egyptian-Greek wisdom</term>—at least regarding the fundamental facts, if not the minute details. This is because the writings of Hermes have been significantly distorted by poor translations.

It is quite certain that the seemingly supernatural nature of these teachings—though they are allegorical—is directly opposed to the literal interpretation of the *Bible*,|| as well as to the latest theories of modern Science.

### I. The Imperishable Sacred Land.

The reason for this name is that this "Imperishable Sacred Land" is said to have never shared the fate of the other continents. ### II. The Hyperborean.

This will be the name chosen for the second continent. It was the land that stretched its peninsulas southward and westward from the North Pole to receive the Second Race, and it comprised the whole of what is now known as Northern Asia. Such was the name given by the ancient Greeks to that far-off and mysterious region where, according to their traditions, Apollo the Hyperborean traveled every year. Astronomically, Apollo is, of course, the Sun; abandoning his Greek sanctuaries, he loved to annually visit his distant country, where the Sun was said to never set for half of the year. "For the paths of night and day are near each other," <note>original Greek: "Ἐγγὺς γὰρ νυκτός τε καὶ ἤματός εἰσι κέλευθοι"</note> says a verse in the *Odyssey*. <note>Book 10, line 86.</note>

But historically—or perhaps more accurately, ethnologically and geologically—the meaning is different. The land of the Hyperboreans was the country that extended beyond Boreas, the "frozen-hearted God" of snows and hurricanes, who loved to sleep heavily on the chain of Mount Rhipæus. This was neither an ideal, imaginary country, as mythologists have suspected, nor was it a land in the neighborhood of Scythia and the Danube. <note>See Karl Volcker, *Mythological Geography of the Greeks and Romans*, pages 145 to 170.</note>

### III. Lemuria.

The third Continent we propose to call Lemuria. The name is an invention, or an idea, of Mr. P. L. Sclater, who, between 1850 and 1860, asserted on zoological grounds the actual existence in prehistoric times of a continent which he showed to have extended from Madagascar to Ceylon and Sumatra. It included some portions of what is now Africa; but otherwise this gigantic continent, which stretched from the Indian Ocean to Australia, has now wholly disappeared beneath the waters of the Pacific, leaving here and there only some of its mountain peaks which are now islands. Mr. A. R. Wallace, the naturalist, as quoted by Mr. Charles Gould:

> Extends the Australia of the Tertiary periods to New Guinea and the Solomon Islands, and perhaps to Fiji, and from its marsupial types <note>marsupial: mammals like kangaroos that carry young in a pouch, characteristic of Australasia</note> infers a connection with the northern continent during the Secondary period.*

# THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

Since the day of its earliest teachings and the destruction of the great Atlantis, the face of the Earth has changed more than once. There was a time when the delta of Egypt and Northern Africa belonged to Europe, before the formation of the Straits of Gibraltar; a further upheaval of the continent then entirely changed the face of the map of Europe. # THE TROPICS AT THE POLE.

This leads to a natural question. If the Greeks, during the time of Homer, knew of a "Hyperborean" <term>Literally "beyond the North Wind"; in Greek mythology, the Hyperboreans were a mythical people who lived in a land of perpetual sunshine far to the north</term> land—that is, a blessed land beyond the reach of Boreas <term>The Greek god of the cold north wind and winter</term>, the god of winter and hurricanes—who told them about it? It was described as a country where nights were short and days were long, and even further beyond, a land where the sun never set and palm trees grew freely. If the Greeks knew of all this, where did the information come from? 

In their era, and for ages before, Greenland must have already been covered in eternal snow and ice that never melted, just as it is today. Everything suggests that the land of short nights and long days was Norway or Scandinavia, and beyond that was the blessed land of eternal light and summer. For the Greeks to have known this, the tradition must have been passed down to them from a people even older than themselves who were familiar with these climatic details—details the Greeks themselves could not have known firsthand. 

Even today, science suspects that at the very center of the North Pole, beyond the frozen Arctic seas, there exists an open sea that never freezes and a continent that remains forever green. Ancient spiritual teachings and the *Purânas* <note>original: "Purânas"; these are a vast genre of ancient Indian literature covering philosophy, history, and mythology</note>—if one understands their allegories—state the same thing. For our purposes, it is enough to acknowledge the strong probability that during the Miocene epoch <note>A geological period lasting from about 23 to 5 million years ago</note>, at a time when Greenland was a nearly tropical land, a people lived there who are now unknown to history.

> In the earliest times, a maiden,
> The beautiful Daughter of the Upper Air <term>original: "Ether"; in this context, it refers to the refined substance believed to fill the higher regions of space and serve as the medium for light and life</term>,
> Spent her existence for ages 
> In the great expanse of Heaven.

> ->. . . . . . .<-

> Before her first-born was delivered.
> ->. . . . . . .<-
> Before a beautiful duck, descending,
> Hastens toward the Water-Mother <note>original: "water-mother"; in the *Kalevala*, this is Ilmatar, a virgin spirit of the air who descends to the sea to begin the process of creation</note>,

> Where she can lay her eggs in safety.
> ->. . . . . . .<-

> Six golden eggs she lays there,
> And then a seventh—an egg of iron.

# ANTHROPOGENESIS <note>Greek for "the origin or generation of humanity"</note>

### FROM

# THE STANZAS OF DZYAN.*

## STANZA I.

1. The <term>Lha</term> <note>original: "Lha"; a Tibetan word for a spirit, deity, or celestial being</note> that guides the Fourth <note>referring to the fourth "round" or stage of planetary development, which is the current phase of the Earth</note> is a servant to the spirits of the Seven. These are the ones who revolve, driving their chariots around their Lord, the "One Eye of our World" <note>the Sun</note>. His breath gave life to the Seven; it gave life to the First.

2. The Earth said: "Lord of the Shining Face <note>the Sun</note>, my house is empty. . . . Send your sons to inhabit this wheel <note>the planet or cycle of existence</note>. You have sent your seven sons to the Lord of Wisdom <note>often associated with the planet Mercury in esoteric astrology</note>. Seven times does he see you closer to himself; seven times more does he feel you. You have forbidden your servants, the small rings <note>likely referring to moons or smaller celestial bodies</note>, to catch your light and heat, or to intercept your great bounty on its journey. Send that same bounty now to your servant."

3. The Lord of the Shining Face said: "I will send you a fire when your work has begun. Raise your voice—"

. . . to other worlds <note>original: "Lokas"; Sanskrit for planes or spheres of existence</note>; apply to your Father, the Lord of the Lotus <note>likely referring to a solar creator deity</note>, for his Sons. . . . Your people shall be under the rule of the Ancestors <note>original: "the Fathers," or Pitris, the progenitors of humanity in occult philosophy</note>. Your men shall be mortals. Your seven layers <note>original: "Skins"; likely referring to the geological or atmospheric layers of the Earth</note> are still upon you. . . You are not ready. Your men are not ready.”

4. After great labor pains <note>original: "throes"</note>, she cast off her old three layers and put on her new seven layers, and stood in her first one.

---

## STANZA II.

5. The Wheel <note>the Earth or its cycle of existence</note> turned for 300 million <note>original: "thirty crores"; a crore is ten million</note> more years. It constructed forms <note>original: "Rûpas"; Sanskrit for bodies or material forms</note>; soft stones that hardened, and hard plants that softened. Visible things emerged from the invisible: insects and small lives. She shook them off her back whenever they overran the Mother. . . . After 300 million years, she turned around. She lay on her back; on her side. . . She would call no Sons of Heaven; she would ask for no Sons of Wisdom. She created from her own breast. She developed Water-Men, who were terrible and bad.

6. She created these terrible and bad Water-Men herself from the remains of others. She formed them from the waste and slime of her first, second, and third stages. The Lords of Meditation <note>original: "Dhyâni"; celestial beings or spirits of high intelligence</note> came and looked . . . the spirits from the bright Father-Mother, from the White Regions they came, from the homes of the Immortal Mortals.

7. They were displeased. “Our flesh is not there. 8. The flames came—the fires with the sparks, the night-fires, and the day-fires. They dried out the muddy, dark waters. They extinguished them with their heat. The <term>spirits</term> <note>original: "Lhas"; Tibetan for celestial beings or spirits</note> from on high and the <term>elemental spirits</term> <note>original: "Lhamayin"; lower-ranking spirits or titans</note> from below arrived. They slaughtered the forms that had two and four faces. They fought the goat-men, the dog-headed men, and the men with the bodies of fishes.

9. Mother-Water, the Great Sea, wept. She rose up and disappeared into the Moon, which had lifted her and given her birth.

10. When those creatures were destroyed, Mother Earth remained bare. She asked to be dried.

## STANZA III.

11. The Lord of the Lords came. From her body, he separated the waters, and that became the heaven above—the first heaven.

12. The great <term>Lords</term> <note>original: "Chohans"; high-ranking spiritual masters or "Lords" in the occult hierarchy</note> called to the Lords of the Moon, those of the airy bodies: “Bring forth men—men of your own nature.”

## STANZA IV.

14. The Seven Hosts, the Lords born of Will, driven by the Spirit of Life-Giving, separated humanity from themselves, each in his own zone <note>geographical region or spiritual plane</note>.

15. Forty-nine <note>Seven times seven</note> shadows of future men were born, each of his own color and kind. Each was inferior to his "father" <note>the spiritual progenitor</note>. These fathers, being boneless, could not give life to beings with bones. Their offspring were <term>Bhûta</term> <note>original Sanskrit: "Bhûta"; refers here to elementals or "beings" without solid form</note>, having neither solid form nor mind. Therefore, they are called the <term>Chhâyâ</term> <note>original Sanskrit: "Chhâyâ"; meaning "Shadow" or "Image"</note> Race.

16. How are the <term>Manushya</term> <note>original Sanskrit: "Manushya"; human beings</note> born? How are the <term>Manus</term> <note>original Sanskrit: "Manus"; the "thinking" men or progenitors of humanity</note> with minds created? The "fathers" called upon their own fire for help, which is the fire that burns within the Earth. The Spirit of the Earth called upon the Solar Fire for help. Through their combined efforts, these three produced a functional <term>Rûpa</term> <note>original Sanskrit: "Rûpa"; a form or body</note>. It could stand, walk, run, lie down, or fly. However, it was still only a <term>Chhâyâ</term>, a shadow without any consciousness. . . .

17. The Breath <note>the spiritual essence or Monad</note> needed a Form; the Fathers <note>the lunar ancestors or Pitris</note> gave it. The Breath needed a physical body; the Earth molded it. The Breath needed the Spirit of Life; the Solar <term>Lhas</term> <note>original Tibetan: "Lhas"; celestial spirits or deities</note> breathed it into its Form. The Breath needed a mirror of its Body; “We gave it our own!”—said the <term>Dhyânis</term> <note>original Sanskrit: "Dhyânis"; Lords of meditation or wisdom</note>. The Breath needed a vehicle for its desires; “It has it!”—said the Drainer of Waters <note>the lunar forces or entities governing the emotional/astral nature</note>. But Breath needs a Mind to embrace the Universe; “We cannot give that!”—said the Fathers. “I never had it!”—said the Spirit of the Earth. “The Form would be consumed were I to give it mine!”—said the Great Fire <note>the higher spiritual intelligences or Solar Angels</note>. Man remained an empty, senseless <term>Bhûta</term> <note>original Sanskrit: "Bhûta"; an elemental or ghostly form without a mind</note>. Thus, the “Boneless” beings have given Life to those who became Men with Bones in the Third <note>the Third Root Race</note>.

## STANZA V.

18. The First <note>the First Root Race</note> were the Sons of Yoga. Their sons were the children of the Yellow Father and the White Mother <note>symbolizing the Sun and Moon, or spiritual and material forces</note>.

19. The Second Race was produced by budding and expansion—the asexual from the sexless.* Thus, O <term>Lanoo</term> <note>original Tibetan: "Lanoo"; a disciple or student</note>, was the Second Race produced.

20. Their Fathers were the Self-born. The Self-born are the <term>Chhâyâ</term> <note>original Sanskrit: "Chhâyâ"; meaning "Shadow" or "Image"</note> from the brilliant Bodies of the Lords—the Fathers, the Sons of Twilight.

## STANZA X.
38. # COMMENTARIES
## ON THE TWELVE STANZAS AND THEIR TERMS, ACCORDING TO THEIR NUMBERING, IN STANZAS AND VERSES <note>original: "shlokas"</note>.

### STANZA I.
### BEGINNINGS OF CONSCIOUS LIFE <note>original: "sentient life"</note>.

->1. The Lha, or Spirit of the Earth. 2. The Earth’s plea to the Sun.<-
->3. The Sun’s response. 4. The Earth’s transformation.<-

->1. THE LHA (*a*) WHO TURNS THE FOURTH* IS SERVANT TO THE LHAS OF THE SEVEN† (*b*). THESE ARE THEY WHO REVOLVE, DRIVING THEIR CHARIOTS AROUND THEIR LORD, THE ONE EYE‡ OF OUR WORLD. HIS BREATH GAVE LIFE TO THE SEVEN.§ IT GAVE LIFE TO THE FIRST (*c*).<-

> "*They are all Dragons of Wisdom*," *the Commentary adds* (*d*).

(*a*) "Lha" is the ancient term used in the regions across the Himalayas <note>original: "Trans-Himâlayan"</note> for "Spirit"—any heavenly or superhuman Being. It encompasses the entire range of heavenly rankings <note>original: "hierarchies"</note>, from an Archangel (or Dhyani <note>original: "Dhyâni"; highly evolved celestial beings in Buddhist and esoteric thought</note>) down to an Angel of darkness or a spirit tied to the Earth.

(*b*) This phrase indicates in straightforward language that the Guardian Spirit of our globe—which is the fourth in our planetary sequence <note>original: "Chain"</note>—is lower in rank than the primary Spirit (or God) of the Seven Planetary Spirits <note>original: "Genii"</note>. As previously explained, the ancients included seven major spirits in their list of deities <note>original: "Kyriel of Gods"</note>...

\* The Fourth Globe, which is our Earth. The Seven—who have now, in the Christian religion, become the “Seven Eyes of the Lord”—were the Rulers <note>original: "Regents"</note> of the seven *chief* planets. However, these were not counted according to the list created later by people who had forgotten, or who had an incomplete understanding of, the true Mysteries; that later list included neither the Sun, the Moon, nor the Earth. Publicly, the Sun was the chief of the twelve Great Gods, or zodiacal constellations. Secretly, he was the Messiah, the Christ <note>original: "Christos"</note>—the "Anointed" subject of the Great Breath, or the One—surrounded by his twelve subordinate powers, who were themselves subordinate, in turn, to each of the seven Mystery-Gods of the planets.

“*The Seven Higher beings make the Seven Spirits <note>original: "Lhas"</note> create the world*,” states a Commentary. This means that our Earth—leaving aside the rest of the universe—was “created” or shaped by Earthly Spirits, while the Rulers were simply the supervisors. This is the first seed of what later grew into the systems of Astrology and Star-worship <note>original: "Astrolatry"</note>. The Higher Ones were the World-builders <note>original: "Cosmocratores"</note>, the fabricators of our Solar System. This is supported by all ancient accounts of the universe's origin <note>original: "Cosmogonies"</note>, such as those of Hermes, the Chaldeans, the Aryans, the Egyptians, and even the Jews.

The Signs of the Zodiac—the “Sacred Animals” or “Heaven’s Belt”—are just as much the Sons of the Gods <note>original: "Bne’ Alhim"; Hebrew: B'nei HaElohim</note> or the Divine Powers <note>original: "Elohim"</note> as the Spirits of the Earth; but they existed before them. But these, in their turn, are subordinate to their own “Fathers” and “Mothers”—terms that are interchangeable and vary with each nation—the Gods and their Planets, such as Jupiter, Saturn, Bel, Brihaspati <note>original: "Brihaspati"; the Hindu name for the planet Jupiter and the teacher of the gods</note>, and others.

# COSMIC ULTIMATES

Hierarchies—each represented or personified by its chief Angel or Ruler <note>original: "Rector"</note>—form one POWER, the inner and the invisible; so, in the world of Forms, the Sun and the seven chief Planets constitute the visible and active power <note>original: "potency"</note>. This latter Hierarchy is, so to speak, the visible and objective Word <note>original: "Logos"</note> of the Invisible and—except in the lowest levels—always-subjective Angels.

Thus—to look ahead slightly for illustration—every Race in its evolution is said to be born under the direct influence of one of the Planets. The First Race received its breath of life from the Sun, as will be seen later; while the Third Humanity—those who fell into physical reproduction <note>original: "generation"</note>, or changed from being unified male-female beings <note>original: "androgynes"</note> into separate entities, one male and the other female—is said to be under the direct influence of Venus, the ‘*little sun*’ in which the solar orb stores his light.”

The summary of the Stanzas in Volume I showed the origin <note>original: "genesis"</note> of Gods and men taking rise in, and from, one and the same Point, which is the One Universal, Unchangeable <note>original: "Immutable"</note>, Eternal, and Absolute UNITY. In its primary manifested aspect, we have seen it become: (1) in the sphere of physical objects <note>original: "objectivity and Physics"</note>, PRIMORDIAL SUBSTANCE and FORCE—inward-pulling and outward-pushing <note>original: "centripetal and centrifugal"</note>, positive and negative, male and female, etc.; (2) in the world of Metaphysics, the SPIRIT OF THE UNIVERSE, or Cosmic Ideation, called by some the LOGOS <note>The "Word" or the first manifestation of the divine mind</note>.

This Logos is the top <note>original: "apex"</note> of the Pythagorean Triangle. When the Triangle is complete, it becomes the Tetraktys <note>A sacred Pythagorean symbol of ten points arranged in a triangle, representing the organization of the universe</note>, or the Triangle in the Square. It is the dual symbol of the four-lettered Name of God <note>original: "Tetragrammaton"</note> in the manifested Universe <note>original: "Kosmos"</note>, and of its fundamental triple Ray in the unmanifested—its spiritual essence <note>original: "Noumenon"</note>.

Put more philosophically <note>original: "metaphysically"</note>, the classification of "Cosmic Ultimates" given here is more for convenience than for absolute philosophical accuracy. At the start of a great Cosmic Cycle <note>original: "Manvantara"</note>, the Absolute Reality <note>original: "Parabrahman"</note> manifests as Root-Nature <note>original: "Mûlaprakriti"</note> and then as the Logos. This Logos is equivalent to the “Unconscious Universal Mind,” etc., of Western Pantheists. It forms the basis of the subjective side of manifested Being and is the source of all manifestations of individual consciousness. Root-Nature <note>original: "Mûlaprakriti"</note>, or Primordial Cosmic Substance, is the foundation of the objective side of things—the basis of all physical evolution and the birth of the universe <note>original: "cosmo-genesis"</note>. Force, then, does not emerge with Primordial Substance from the Absolute—

# DRAGON AND SERPENT.

<margin>Published by J. B. Alden in New York, 1888; Volume 2, pages 432 and 434.</margin>

Every planet] has its own Logos,” says the Doctrine. The Egyptians always called the Sun the “Eye of Osiris,” and the Sun himself was the Logos—the first-born, or the light made visible to the world, “which is the Mind and divine Intellect of the Concealed” <note>The "Concealed" refers to the hidden, unmanifested absolute reality or Godhead</note>. It is only through the seven-fold ray of this light that we can become aware of the Logos through the Demiurge <note><term>Demiurge</term>: a term for a "creator" or "artisan" figure responsible for fashioning the physical world, often seen as subordinate to a higher, purely spiritual deity</note>. We regard the Demiurge as the “Creator” of our planet and everything belonging to it, and the Logos as the guiding force behind that Creator. This force is both good and bad at the same time—it is the origin of both good and evil. This “Creator” is neither good nor bad in itself <note>original: "per se"</note>, but its different forms in nature make it take on one character or the other. 

The Sun-Gods had nothing to do with the invisible and unknown universes scattered throughout space. This idea is expressed very clearly in the *Books of Hermes* <note>Ancient Egyptian-Greek wisdom texts attributed to Hermes Trismegistus</note> and in all ancient folklore. It is generally symbolized by the Dragon and the Serpent—the Dragon representing Good and the Serpent representing Evil. On Earth, these are represented by right-hand and left-hand magic <note>Often referred to as white and black magic</note>. In the Finnish epic poem, the *Kalevala*, the origin of the Serpent of Evil is described: it is born from the saliva of Suoyatar and given a living soul by Hisi, the principle of evil. A struggle is described between these two: the “thing of evil” (the Serpent or Sorcerer) and Ahti (the Dragon or white magician, also known as Lemminkainen). 

Lemminkainen is one of the seven sons of Ilmatar, the virgin “daughter of the air.” She is the one “who fell from heaven into the sea” before creation—meaning <note>original: "i.e."</note> spirit transformed into the material substance of life perceived by the senses. There is a wealth of meaning and esoteric <note>original: "Occult"</note> thought in the following few lines, beautifully translated by Dr. J. M. Crawford of Cincinnati. The hero Lemminkainen:

> Hews the wall with the power of magic,
> Breaks the defensive wall in pieces,
> Hews seven fence-posts into atoms,
> Chops the wall of serpents into fragments.
> . . . . . . . . . .
> When the monster, paying little attention,
> Pounces with his venomous mouth
> At the head of Lemminkainen.
> But the hero, quickly remembering,
> Speaks the master-words of knowledge,
> Words that came from distant ages,
> Words his ancestors had taught him.

# THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

(d) In China, the men of Fohi <note>Also known as Fu Xi, a culture hero in Chinese mythology</note>, or the "Heavenly Man," are called the twelve *Tien-Hoang*. These are the twelve Hierarchies of *Dhyânis* <note>Celestial beings or "Lords of Meditation"</note> or Angels, who are depicted with human faces and dragon bodies. In this context, the Dragon represents Divine Wisdom or Spirit. These beings create humans by incarnating themselves into seven figures of clay—made of earth and water—which were modeled after the shape of these *Tien-Hoang*. This is a third version of the creation allegory. The twelve *Æsers* <note>The primary gods of Norse mythology, such as Odin and Thor</note> of the Scandinavian *Eddas* perform a similar act. In the *Secret Catechism* of the Druses of Syria—a legend repeated word-for-word by the oldest tribes living around the Euphrates River—men were created by the "Sons of God." These beings descended to Earth and, after gathering seven Mandragoras <note>Mandrake plants</note>, they gave life to the roots, which immediately became men.

---

All these allegories point to one and the same origin—the dual and triple nature of man. We are dual in that we are male and female; we are triple because we possess a spiritual and psychic essence *within* and a material physical structure without.

<margin>* It has been repeatedly stated that the Serpent is the symbol of wisdom and of secret <note>original: "Occult"</note> knowledge. "The Serpent has been connected with the god of wisdom from the earliest times of which we have any historical notice," writes C. Staniland Wake. "This animal was the special symbol of Thoth or Taut... and of all those gods, such as Hermes and Seth, who can be connected with him. This is true also of the third member of the primitive Chaldean triad <note>A group of three major Babylonian gods</note>, Hea or Hoa." According to Sir Henry Rawlinson, "the most important titles of this deity refer to his functions as the source of all knowledge and science." Not only is he "the intelligent fish," but his name may be read as signifying both "life" and a "serpent" [referring to an initiated master or <term>Adept</term>]. He may be considered as "represented by the great serpent which occupies such a prominent place among the symbols of the gods on the black stones recording Babylonian gifts" (*The Great Pyramid*, p. 75). Esculapius, Serapis, Pluto, Esmun, and Kneph are all deities with the attributes of the serpent, says Dupuis. "They are all *healers*, givers of health, both spiritual and physical, and of *enlightenment*." The crown formed of an asp, the *Thermutbis*, belongs to Isis, the Goddess of Life and Healing. The *Upanishads* <note>Ancient Sanskrit texts of spiritual Hindu philosophy</note> contain a treatise on the *Science of Serpents*—in other words, the Science of Secret Knowledge. Furthermore, the *Nâgas* of mainstream <note>original: "exoteric"</note> Buddhism are not "the fabulous creatures, like serpents... being superior to men, and regarded as protectors of the law of Buddha," as the scholar Schlagintweit believes. Instead, they were real living men. Some were superior to ordinary men because of their secret knowledge and protected Buddha's law by correctly interpreting his metaphysical teachings. Others were morally inferior, acting as "<term>black magicians</term>." Therefore, it is truly declared that Gautama Buddha "is said to have taught them a more philosophical religious system than he taught to ordinary men, who were not advanced enough to understand it at the time" <note>original: "ibid." referring to Wake's book</note> (*The Great Pyramid*, p. 72).</margin>

Its magical and mysterious properties have been celebrated in fables and plays since the most ancient <note>original: "archaic"</note> ages. However, on the Island of Crete <note>original: "Candia"</note> and in Karamania near the city of Adana, they have a wonderfully human form and are highly valued as protective charms <note>original: "amulets"</note>. They are also worn by women as a <term>charm against sterility</term> and for other purposes. They are considered especially effective in "<term>Black Magic</term>."

> 2. THE EARTH SAID, "LORD OF THE SHINING FACE <note>The Sun</note>, MY HOUSE IS EMPTY. SEND YOUR SONS TO POPULATE THIS WHEEL <note>The Earth</note>. (a) The "Lord of Wisdom" is Mercury, or Budha <note>In Hindu mythology, Budha is the deity associated with the planet Mercury, not to be confused with Gautama Buddha</note>.

(b) The modern Commentary explains these words as a reference to a well-known astronomical fact: Mercury receives seven times more light and heat from the Sun than the Earth does—or even the beautiful Venus, which receives only twice the amount that falls on our insignificant globe. Whether this fact was known in antiquity may be inferred from the prayer of the "Earth Spirit" to the Sun as given in the text. <note>Copernicus wrote his theories on the *Revolution of the Heavenly Bodies* in the sixteenth century. (*Zohar*, iii, folio 10a, quoted in Myer's *Qabbalah*, p. 139.)</note> The Sun, however, refuses to populate the Globe, as it is not yet ready to receive life.

Mercury, as an astrological planet, is even more hidden <note>original: "Occult"</note> and mysterious than Venus. He was the leader and caller of souls, the great Magician, and the High Priest <note>original: "Hierophant"</note>. Virgil depicts him taking his wand to call forth from the underworld <note>original: "Orcus"</note> the souls trapped there—"then he takes his wand; with this he calls souls out from the underworld" <note>original: *tum virgam capit, hac animas ille evocat Orco*</note>. <note>See also the 21st Fargard of the *Vendidâd* <note>a Zoroastrian holy text</note> regarding the celestial army.</note> He is the Golden-shining Mercury <note>original: Χρυσοφαὴς Ἑρμῆς</note> whom the High Priests forbade people to name. ### THE THREE KINDS OF LIGHT.

Now, there are three kinds of Light in occultism, as there are in the Kabbalah <note>The Kabbalah is an esoteric method and school of thought in Jewish mysticism.</note>:

2.  The **Light of the Manifested-Unmanifested**, called by some the **Logos** <note>original: Logos; the "Word" or divine reason</note>.
3.  The **reflected Light** found in the **Dhyân Chohans** <term>Dhyân Chohans</term> <note>original: Dhyân Chohans; High spiritual beings or "Lords of Meditation" who oversee the cosmos</note>, also known as the minor Logoi—collectively called the **Elohim**—who, in turn, cast this light upon the physical universe.

1.  The **clear and penetrating light**, belonging to **Jehovah**.

Therefore, Nature (within a human) must become a mixture of Spirit and Matter before a person becomes what they are; and the Spirit lying hidden in Matter must be awakened to life and consciousness gradually. 

The Monad <note>The individual spiritual spark or ultimate unit of being</note> must pass through its mineral, vegetable, and animal forms before the Light of the *Logos* <note>The Divine Word or Reason</note> is awakened in the "animal-man." Until that moment, the latter cannot be called a "man," but must be regarded as a Monad imprisoned in ever-changing forms. *Evolution, not Creation*, by means of "Words" (or vibrations) is recognized in the philosophies of the East, even in their public records. "Light comes from the East" <note>original: *Ex oriente lux*</note>. Even the name of the first man in the Mosaic Bible had its origin in India, despite the denial of Professor Max Müller <note>A famous 19th-century scholar of comparative religion and linguistics</note>. The Jews received their "Adam" from Chaldea; and "Adam-Adami" is a compound word and therefore a complex symbol that proves the secret (Occult) dogmas.

# THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

If this is correct, it becomes rather difficult to limit Adam to the Mosaic Bible <note>The first five books of the Old Testament, traditionally attributed to Moses</note> alone, or to see it simply as a Jewish name.

There is frequent confusion in the attributes and genealogies of the Gods in their Theogonies <note>theories or stories concerning the origin and family tree of the gods</note>—the beginning and the end <note>original: "Alpha and the Omega"</note> of the records of that symbolical science, as given to the world by half-initiated writers, both Brahmanical <note>Hindu</note> and Biblical. Yet there could be no such confusion made by the earliest nations, who were the descendants and pupils of the Divine Instructors. For them, both the attributes and the genealogies were inseparably linked with symbols of how the universe was formed <note>original: "cosmogonical symbols"</note>, the "Gods" being the life and animating "soul-principle" of the various regions of the Universe. Nowhere and by no people was speculation allowed to wander beyond those manifested Gods. The boundless and infinite Unity remained for every nation a virgin, forbidden soil—untrodden by man’s thought and untouched by fruitless speculation. The only reference made to it was the brief concept of its expansion and contraction <note>original: "diastolic and systolic property"</note>, like a periodic breathing or pulse. In the Universe, with all its incalculable millions of systems and worlds disappearing and reappearing in eternity, the human-like <note>original: "anthropomorphized"</note> Powers, or Gods (their Souls), had to disappear from view along with their Bodies. As our Catechism says:

> "The Breath returning to the Eternal Bosom which exhales and inhales them."

Ideal Nature—the Abstract Space in which everything in the Universe is mysteriously and invisibly generated—is the same female side of the procreative power in Nature in the Vedic <note>Ancient Indian</note> tradition as in every other system of world-origins. *Aditi* <note>The Hindu infinite mother of the gods</note> is the same as *Sephira* <note>In the Kabbalah, the first emanation of the divine</note>, and the *Sophia* of the Gnostics, and *Isis*, the Virgin Mother of Horus. In every system of world-origins, behind and higher than the "Creative" Deity, there is a Superior Deity—a Planner or Architect—of whom the Creator is but the executive agent. And still higher, over and around, within and without, there is the Unknowable and the Unknown, the Source and Cause of all these divine outpourings <note>original: "Emanations"</note>.

It thus becomes easy to account for the reason why "Adam-Adami" is found in the Chaldean scripture, which is certainly earlier than the Books of Moses. In Assyrian, *Ad* is "father," and in Aramaic *Ad* is "one," and *Ad-ad* the "only one," while *Ak* is "creator" in Assyrian. Thus:

# ADAM KADMON.

*Ad-am-ak-ad-mon* became **Adam-Kadmon** in the *Kabbalah* (*Zohar*), where it meant the "One (Son) of the divine Father, or the Creator." This is because the words *am* and *om* at one time meant "the divine" or "the deity" in nearly every language. Thus, **Adam-Kadmon** and **Adam-Adami** came to mean "The first Emanation <note>something that flows out from a divine source</note> of the Father-Mother or Divine Nature," and literally the "first Divine One." 

It is easy to see that *Ad-Argat* (or *Astarte* <note>original: "Aster’t"</note>, the Syrian Goddess and consort of *Ad-on*, the Lord God of Syria or the Jewish *Adonai*), along with Venus, Isis, Ishtar <note>original: "Ister"</note>, Mylitta, Eve, and others, are identical to the *Aditi* and *Vach* of the Hindus. They are all the "Mothers of all living" and "Mothers of the Gods." 

On the other hand—from cosmic and astronomical perspectives—all the male Gods first became "Sun-Gods." Later, in theology, they were called the "Suns of Righteousness" and the *Logoi* <note>original: "Logoi," meaning Divine Words or Reason</note>, all symbolized by the Sun. They are all *Protogonoi* <note>original: "Protogonoi," meaning First-born</note> and *Mikroprosopoi* <note>original: "Mikroprosopoi," meaning the "Lesser Countenance," a Kabbalistic term for the manifested world</note>. 

Among the Jews, **Adam-Kadmon** was the same as *Athamaz*, *Tammuz* <note>original: "Tamaz"</note>, or the *Adonis* of the Greeks—"the One with, and of his Father." This "Father" became, during the later eras <note>original: "Races"</note>, *Helios*, the Sun—as seen in *Apollo Karneios*, for instance, who was "Sun-born." Figures like *Osiris* and *Ormazd* were followed by, and eventually transformed into, even more earthly types: such as *Prometheus* (the crucified one of Mount Caucasus <note>original: "Mount Kajbee"</note>), *Hercules*, and many other Sun-Gods and Heroes, until all of them eventually came to be viewed as nothing more than phallic symbols.

## TWO PRE-FLOOD ASTRONOMERS <note>original: antediluvian</note>

To the mind of the Eastern student of Occultism, two figures are indissolubly connected with mystic astronomy, chronology, and their cycles. Two grand and mysterious figures, towering like two giants in the ancient past, emerge before him whenever he has to refer to <term>Yugas</term> <note>original: Yugas; world ages in Hindu cosmology</note> and <term>Kalpas</term> <note>original: Kalpas; vast periods of time, often called a "day of Brahma"</note>. When, or at what period of pre-history they lived, none save a few men in the world know, or ever can know, with the certainty that is required by exact chronology. It may have been 100,000 years ago, it may have been 1,000,000, for all that the outside world will ever know. The mystic West and Freemasonry talk loudly of Enoch and Hermes. The mystic East speaks of Nârada, the old Vedic Sage <note>original: Rishi</note>, and of Asuramaya, the Atlantean.

It has already been hinted that of all the incomprehensible characters in the *Mahâbhârata* and the *Purânas* <note>ancient Indian texts containing mythology and history</note>, Nârada—the son of the creator God Brahmâ in the *Matsya Purâna*, and the offspring of Kashyapa and the daughter of Daksha in the *Vishnu Purâna*—is the most mysterious. He is referred to by the honorable title of <term>Deva-Rishi</term> <note>original: Deva-Rishi; Divine Sage, rather than a Demi-God</note> by the sage Parâshara, and yet he is cursed by Daksha and even by Brahmâ. He informs Kamsa <note>original: Kansha</note> that the Lord <note>original: Bhagavân</note>, or Vishnu in public religious teaching <note>original: exotericism</note>, would incarnate in the eighth child of Devakî. This news brings the wrath of the "Indian Herod" <note>A reference to King Kamsa, who, like the biblical King Herod, attempted to kill a divine child to prevent a prophecy</note> upon Krishna's mother. Then, from the cloud on which he is seated—invisible as a true <term>Mind-born Son</term> <note>original: Mânasaputra; beings who represent the higher intellectual nature of humanity</note>—he praises Krishna, in delight at the divine incarnation's <note>original: Avatâr</note> feat of killing the monster Keshin. Nârada is here, there, and everywhere; and yet, none of the *Purânas* gives the true characteristics of this great enemy of physical procreation. ...and the executor of the universal decrees of Karma <note>original: Karma; the law of cause and effect</note> and Adi-Buana <note>original: Adi-Buana; the spiritual foundation of the world</note>: a kind of active and ever-incarnating <term>Logos</term> <note>original: Logos; the divine Word or creative reason</note>, who leads and guides human affairs from the beginning to the end of the <term>Kalpa</term> <note>original: Kalpa; a vast period of time in Hindu cosmology, often called a "Day of Brahma"</note>.

Pesh-Hun <note>an esoteric name for Nârada</note> is a universal figure, not a specifically Hindu possession. He is the mysterious, guiding, intelligent power that provides the impulse for and regulates the momentum of Cycles, Kalpas, and universal events.* He is the visible adjuster of Karma on a broad scale, as well as the inspirer and leader of the greatest heroes of this <term>Manvantara</term> <note>original: Manvantara; a major period of manifestation or a world-cycle</note>. In public <note>original: exoteric</note> religious works, he is referred to by some very uncomplimentary names, such as *Kali-kâraka* (Strife-maker), *Kapi-vaktra* (Monkey-faced), and even *Pishuna* (the Spy), though elsewhere he is called *Deva-Brahmâ* <note>Divine Brahma</note>. Even Sir William Jones <note>a famous 18th-century orientalist and jurist</note> was strongly impressed by this mysterious character based on what he gathered from his Sanskrit studies. He compares him to the Greek god Hermes and the Roman god Mercury, calling him “the eloquent messenger of the gods.”† All this—along with the fact that Hindus believe him to be a great <term>Rishi</term> <note>original: Rishi; a sage or inspired poet</note> “who is forever wandering the earth, giving good counsel”—led the late Dr. Kenealy‡ to see him as one of his twelve Messiahs. He was, perhaps, not as far off the right track as some might imagine.

What Nârada *really is* cannot be explained in print, nor would modern generations of the uninitiated <note>original: profane</note> gain much from the information. However, it should be noted that if there is any deity in the Hindu pantheon who resembles the biblical Jehovah—in terms of tempting people through the "suggestion" of thoughts and "hardening" the hearts of those he intends to make his tools and victims—it is Nârada. But in Nârada's case, it is not out of a desire to find an excuse for "plaguing" people or to prove that "*I am the Lord God.*" Nor is it motivated by ambition or selfishness; rather, it is truly to serve and guide universal progress and evolution.

Nârada is one of the few prominent characters in the *Purânas* <note>ancient Indian texts of history and mythology</note> (aside from certain gods) who visit the so-called nether or infernal regions, *Pâtâla*. Whether or not Nârada learned all that he knew from his interaction with the thousand-headed *Shesha*—the Serpent who supports the seven regions of *Pâtâla* and the entire world like a crown upon his heads, and who is the great teacher of Astronomy§—is certain...

-> THE MIRROR OF FUTURITY. <-

Indeed, he surpasses Garga’s teacher in his knowledge of the complexities of cosmic cycles. It is he who oversees our progress and our national prosperity or misfortune. In the ancient Stanzas, Pesh-Hun is credited with calculating and recording all the astronomical and cosmic cycles of the future, and with teaching this science to the first observers of the stars. It is also said that Asuramaya <note>an ancient astronomer-magician often associated with Atlantis</note> based all his astronomical works on those records, determining the length of all past geological and cosmic periods, as well as the length of all future cycles until the end of this current Life-Cycle, or the end of the Seventh Race <note>in Theosophical chronology, the final stage of human evolution on this planet</note>.

There is a work among the Secret Books called the *Mirror of Futurity*, in which all the <term>Kalpas</term> <note>vast periods of time</note> within Kalpas, and the cycles within the heart of Shesha <note>the cosmic serpent representing infinite Time</note>, are recorded. This work is attributed to Pesh-Hun-Nârada. There is another ancient work attributed to various Atlanteans. These two records provide us with the figures for our cycles and the ability to calculate the dates of future cycles. The chronological calculations that will be provided shortly are, however, those of the Brahmins, as explained further on; yet most of them also align with the Secret Doctrine.

The chronology and calculations of the Brahmin Initiates are based upon the zodiacal records of India and the works of the previously mentioned astronomer and magician, Asuramaya. The Atlantean zodiacal records cannot be in error, as they were compiled under the guidance of those who first taught astronomy, among other things, to humanity.

But here again, we are deliberately and recklessly facing a new difficulty. We will be told that our statement is contradicted by modern science, specifically by a man regarded in the West as a great authority on all subjects of Sanskrit literature—Professor Albrecht Weber of Berlin. This, to our great regret, cannot be helped, and we are prepared to defend what is stated here. Asuramaya, whom epic tradition identifies as the earliest astronomer in <term>Âryâvarta</term> <note>the ancient "land of the Aryans," or northern India</note>—one to whom "the Sun-God revealed the knowledge of the stars" in person <note>original: *in propriâ personâ*</note>, as Dr. Weber himself states—is identified by Weber in a very mysterious way with the "Ptolemaios" <note>Ptolemy</note> of the Greeks. No better reason is given for this identification than the following:

> This latter name (Ptolemy), as we see from the inscription of Piyadasi <note>King Ashoka</note>, became the Indian "Turamaya," from which the name "Asura Maya" could very easily have evolved.

No doubt it "could," but the vital question is: Are there any good reasons to believe it did?

After Brahmâ concentrated his mind within himself and within the Quality of Darkness that filled his assumed body, the **demons <note>original: Asuras</note>** were first produced, emerging from his thigh. After this, he abandoned that body, and it was transformed into Night.

There are two important points involved here:

(**a**) Originally, in the ***Rig Veda*** <note>the oldest collection of Sanskrit hymns</note>, the **demons <note>original: Asuras</note>** are shown as **spiritual, divine beings**. The origin of their name comes from ***Asu*** <note>breath</note>, meaning the "Breath of God," and they represent the same concept as the Supreme Spirit or the Zoroastrian ***Ahura*** <note>the Wise Lord</note>. It was only later, for the purposes of religious doctrine and dogma, that they were depicted emerging from Brahmâ’s thigh, and their name began to be defined as "not-a-god" (from ***a***, meaning "not," and ***Sura***, meaning "god"), making them the enemies of the gods.

(**b**) Every ancient account of the origin of the gods <note>original: Theogony</note> without exception—from the Indian and Egyptian traditions down to those of the Greek poet Hesiod—places Night before Day in the order of cosmic evolution. Even the biblical book of ***Genesis*** describes "darkness upon the face of the deep" before the "first day." The reason for this is that every account of creation—except for the ***Secret Doctrine***—begins with what is called "Secondary Creation." This refers to the **manifested universe**, the beginning of which requires a clear distinction between the eternal light of "Primary Creation" (a mystery that must always remain "darkness" to the prying, limited minds of the uninitiated) and the "Secondary Evolution" of the visible, material world. The ***Veda*** <note>ancient Sanskrit scriptures</note> contains the complete philosophy of this division, though it has never been correctly explained by Western scholars of the East <note>original: Orientalists</note>, since they have never understood it.

The positions of the stars—with Bentley calculating the year 945 B.C. as the nearest date for such a planetary alignment—show that:

> All the planets, except Saturn, were on the same side of the heavens as the Sun and Moon.

And therefore, they were his opponents. And yet it is Saturn, or the Jewish "Moon-God," who is shown as winning the battle by both Hesiod and Moses, neither of whom was properly understood. In this way, the real meaning became distorted.

# COSMOGONY AN INTELLIGENT PLAN.

As the whole cycle of prehistoric events—such as the evolution and transformation of races and the extreme antiquity of man—depends upon the aforementioned chronology, it becomes extremely important to verify it by comparing it with other existing calculations. As Professor Max Müller expresses it, it is often as useful to prove what a thing is not as to show what it may be. # THE VARIOUS CLASSES OF CREATORS.

13. THEY\* WENT EACH ON HIS ALLOTTED LAND: SEVEN OF THEM, EACH ON HIS LOT. THE LORDS OF THE FLAME REMAIN BEHIND. THEY WOULD NOT GO, THEY WOULD NOT CREATE.

The Secret Teachings show the divine Progenitors <note>original: "Progenitors"; spiritual ancestors or creators</note> creating men on seven portions of the Globe “each on his lot”—that is, each creating a different Race of men, distinct both externally and internally, and located on different Zones. This polygenistic <note>The theory that different human races have different origins</note> claim is considered elsewhere, in Stanza VII. But who are “They” who create, and who are the “Lords of the Flame” who “would not”? Occultism divides the “Creators” into Twelve Classes. Of these, four have reached “Liberation” <note>original: "Moksha" or "Nirvana"; freedom from the cycle of rebirth</note> until the end of the “Great Age” <note>original: "Maha-Kalpa"; a vast period of cosmic time</note>; the fifth class is ready to reach it but remains active on the intellectual planes; while seven classes are still under the direct Law of Karma <note>The law of cause and effect</note>. These last seven act upon the life-bearing Globes of our planetary Chain.

Exoteric <note>Public or traditional, as opposed to secret or "esoteric"</note> Hindu books mention Seven Classes of *Pitris* <note>original: "Pitris"; ancestors or fathers</note>, and among them two distinct kinds of Progenitors: the *Barhishad* and the *Agnishvatta*; or, those possessed of the “sacred fire” and those devoid of it. Hindu ritualism seems to connect them with sacrificial fires and with *Grihastha* Brahmans <note>Householder priests</note> in earlier incarnations—those who have, and those who have *not*, properly attended to their household sacred fires in their previous births. This distinction, as mentioned, is derived from the *Vedas* <note>The oldest scriptures of Hinduism</note>. 

The first and highest class (Esoterically), the *Agnishvatta*, are represented in the public allegory as *Grihastha* or Brahman householders who failed to maintain their domestic fires and offer burnt sacrifices in their past births during other *Manvantaras* <note>Great cycles of manifestation</note>; because of this, they are said to have lost the right to receive fire-offerings. In contrast, the *Barhishad*, being Brahmans who kept up their household sacred fires, are honored to this day. Therefore, the *Agnishvatta* are described as lacking fire, and the *Barhishad* as possessing it.

However, Esoteric Philosophy explains that these original qualifications are actually due to the difference between the natures of the two Classes. The *Agnishvatta Pitris* are devoid of “fire”—meaning creative passion—because they are too divine and pure. On the other hand, the *Barhishad*, being the Lunar Spirits more closely connected with Earth, became the creative *Elohim* <note>A Hebrew term for divine beings or creators</note> of form, or the “Adam of dust.”

The Barhishad <note>A class of "Lunar Ancestors"</note>, though possessed of “creative fire,” lacked the higher element of Mahat <note>Universal Mind or intelligence</note>. Some Rishi-Yogis are shown in the *Purânas* <note>Ancient Hindu texts containing mythology and history</note> to be far more powerful than the Gods. Secondary Gods or temporary Powers in Nature (the Forces) are doomed to disappear; it is only the spiritual Potentiality in man which can lead him to become one with the INFINITE and the ABSOLUTE.

# THE LIVING SPIRITUAL FIRE.

The Universal Divine Mind—the "Mystery of Creation"—is repeated on Earth, only in an inverted sense, as if seen in a **mirror**.

It is those beings who are unable to create the spiritual, immortal man who project the senseless model—the **Astral** <note>The subtle, energetic blueprint of the physical body</note>—of the physical Being. As will be seen, it was those who would not multiply physically who sacrificed themselves for the benefit and salvation of Spiritual Humanity. To complete the **seven-fold man** <note>original: "septenary man"</note>, and to add to his three lower principles and cement them with the **Spiritual Monad** <note>The eternal, divine spark of a human being</note>—which could never dwell in such a physical form except in an absolutely **hidden state** <note>original: "latent state"</note>—two connecting "Principles" are needed: **Manas** <note>The Mind or intellect</note> and **Kama** <note>Desire or emotion</note>. 

This requires a living Spiritual Fire of the middle Principle from the Fifth and Third States of the **Pleroma** <note>Greek: "Fullness"; the totality of divine powers</note>. But this Fire is the possession of the "Triangles," not of the (perfect) "Cubes," which symbolize the Angelic Beings. <note>The Triangle becomes a five-fold Pentagon on Earth.</note> The Triangles, from the First Creation, possessed themselves of this fire; they are said to have appropriated it for themselves, as seen in the allegory of **Prometheus** <note>The Greek Titan who stole fire from the gods to give to humanity</note>. These are the active Beings, and therefore—in the heavenly realm—they are no longer considered "pure" or passive. They have become independent and free Intelligences, shown in every **Theogony** <note>An account of the origin or genealogy of the gods</note> as fighting for that independence and freedom. Consequently, in the ordinary sense, they are viewed as "rebellious to the divine passive law." 

These are the "Flames"—the **Agnishvatta** <note>Sanskrit: A class of solar deities or ancestors who possess spiritual fire but lack physical creative power</note>—who, as shown in the **verse** <note>original: "shloka"</note>, "remain behind" instead of going along with the others to create physical men on Earth. But the true inner <note>original: "Esoteric"</note> meaning is that most of them were destined to incarnate as the **Egos** <note>The permanent, reincarnating individuality</note> of the forthcoming crop of Mankind.

The human Ego is neither **Atman** <note>The supreme universal Self</note> nor **Buddhi** <note>The spiritual soul or intuition</note>, but the **Higher Manas**; it is the intellectual fruit and the flowering of intellectual self-conscious individuality—in the higher spiritual sense. Ancient works refer to it as the **Karana Sharira** <note>Sanskrit: "Causal Body"</note> on the plane of the **Sutratma**, which is the "golden thread" on which the various personalities of this Higher Ego are strung like beads. 

If the reader were told, as in the **partially-hidden** <note>original: "semi-Esoteric"</note> allegories, that these Beings were returning **Nirvanis** <note>Those who have attained Nirvana</note> from preceding **Great Cycles** <note>original: "Maha-Manvantaras"; ages of incalculable duration</note>—which rolled away in Eternity a still more incalculable time ago—he would hardly understand the text correctly. Meanwhile, some **Vedantins** <note>Followers of Vedanta, a school of Hindu philosophy</note> might say: "This is not so; the *Nirvani* can never return." This is true during the specific Great Cycle to which he belongs, but it is incorrect where Eternity is concerned. For it is said in the Sacred Verses:

> "*The Thread of Radiance which is imperishable and dissolves only in...*"

# THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

The Monads <note>the eternal, individual spiritual sparks</note> which incarnated in those *empty Shells* remained as unconscious as when they were separated from their previous incomplete forms and vehicles. The answer is difficult to understand unless one is well acquainted with the philosophical metaphysics of a beginningless and endless series of Cosmic Rebirths. The one Divine Principle, the nameless THAT of the *Vedas* <note>ancient sacred Hindu texts</note>, is the Universal Total. Neither in its spiritual aspects and emanations, nor in its physical Atoms, can it ever be at "Absolute Rest" except during the Nights of Brahma <note>original: Brahmâ; periods of cosmic inactivity between universes</note>. 

Hence, also, the "First-born" are those who are first set in motion at the beginning of a Period of Activity <note>original: Manvantara</note>, and are thus the first to fall into the lower spheres of materiality. Those who are called in Theology the "Thrones," and are the "Seat of God," must be the first incarnated men on Earth. It becomes understandable, if we think of the endless series of past Periods of Activity, why the last had to come first, and the first last. We find, in short, that the higher Angels had broken through the "Seven Circles" countless ages <note>original: æons</note> before, and thus "robbed" them of the Sacred Fire. # MAN A GOD IN ANIMAL FORM.

The human mind is a reflection of *Mahat* <note>The universal intelligence or "Great Mind" in Hindu philosophy</note> in its various degrees of intensity. No Entity, whether angelic or human, can reach the state of *Nirvâna* <note>A state of liberation from suffering and the cycle of rebirth</note>, or of absolute purity, except through eons of suffering and the *knowledge* of evil as well as of good; otherwise, goodness would remain incomprehensible.

Between man and the animal—whose *Monads* <note>The fundamental, eternal spiritual spark</note>, or *Jîvas* <note>Individual living souls</note>, are fundamentally identical—there is the impassable abyss of Mentality and Self-consciousness. What is the human mind in its higher aspect, and where does it come from, if it is not a portion of the essence—and, in some rare cases of incarnation, the *very essence*—of a higher Being from a higher and divine plane? Can man—a God in animal form—be the product of Material Nature by evolution alone, just like the animal? The animal differs from man in external shape, but not at all in the materials of its physical structure, and it is animated by the same *Monad*, though in an undeveloped state. Yet, the intellectual potential of the two differs as much as the sun does from a glow-worm. What is it that creates such a difference, unless man is an animal *plus a living God* within his physical shell? Let us pause and ask ourselves this question seriously, regardless of the deceptive arguments and false reasoning of both materialistic and psychological modern sciences.

To some extent, it is admitted that even the Esoteric <note>intended for or likely to be understood by only a small number of people with a specialized knowledge</note> Teaching is allegorical. To make these teachings comprehensible to the average intelligence, it is necessary to use symbols cast in an understandable form. This is the reason for the allegorical and semi-mythical narratives in the public teachings, and the only semi-metaphysical and objective representations in the inner Esoteric Teachings. Purely and transcendently spiritual concepts are suited only to the perceptions of those who “*see without eyes, hear without ears, and sense without organs*,” according to the vivid expression of the Commentary. The overly strict Idealist is free to interpret this doctrine spiritually, whereas the modern Psychologist would simply try to dismiss our “fallen,” yet still divine, human Soul—divine because of its connection with *Buddhi* <note>The faculty of higher spiritual intuition and discernment</note>.

The mystery surrounding the highly spiritual Ancestors of the *Divine Man* within the earthly man is very great. His dual creation is hinted at in the *Purânas* <note>Ancient Indian texts containing mythology and history</note>, though its inner meaning can only be understood by comparing many varying accounts and reading them for their symbolic and allegorical character. It is the same in the Bible, both in *Genesis* and even in the *Epistles of Paul*. For that “Creator,” who is called in the second chapter of *Genesis* the “Lord God,” is in...

# THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

In the original text, the *Elohim* <note>original: "Elohim" — a Hebrew word for God or Gods, which is plural in form</note>, or Gods (the Lords), are referred to in the plural. While one of them makes the earthly Adam out of dust, another breathes into him the Breath of Life, and a third makes him a Living Soul. All of these interpretations are implied by the plural form of the word *Elohim*. Or again, as Paul says:

> The first man is of the earth, the second [the last, or rather highest] is the Lord from heaven. <margin>1 Corinthians 15:47.</margin>

In the Aryan allegory, the rebellious Sons of Brahma are all represented as holy Ascetics and Yogis. Reborn in every *Kalpa* <note>original: "Kalpa" — a vast period of time in Hindu cosmology, often called a "Day of Brahma"</note>, they generally try to impede the work of human procreation. When Daksha, the chief of the *Prajapatis* <note>original: "Prajapatis" — Progenitors or "Lords of Creatures"</note> or Creators, brings forth 10,000 sons for the purpose of peopling the world, Narada—a son of Brahma, the great *Rishi* <note>Sage</note>, and essentially a *Kumara* <note>original: "Kumara" — the "virgin youths" or mind-born sons of Brahma who refused to procreate</note> even if not called so by name—interferes with and twice frustrates Daksha’s aim. He does this by persuading those sons to remain holy Ascetics and to avoid marriage. For this, Daksha curses Narada to be "reborn as a man," just as Brahma had cursed him before for refusing to marry and produce offspring, saying: "Perish in your present [Devic or Angelic] form and take up your abode in the womb"—that is, become a human being. <margin>*Vayu Purana*; *Harivamsha*, 170.</margin>

Despite several conflicting versions of the same story, it is easy to see that Narada belongs to that class of Brahma’s "First-born" who have all proven rebellious to the law of animal procreation, for which they had to incarnate as *men*. Of all the Vedic Rishis, Narada, as already shown, is the most incomprehensible because he is the most closely connected with the Occult Doctrines—especially with the Secret Cycles and *Kalpas*.

Certain contradictory statements about this Sage have greatly distracted Orientalist scholars. For instance, he is shown positively refusing to "create" or have offspring, and even calling his father Brahma a "false teacher" for advising him to get married (as related in the *Narada-Pancha-Ratra*). Nevertheless, he is referred to as one of the *Prajapatis* or Progenitors! In the *Naradiya Purana*, he describes the—

## STANZA IV.
## CREATION OF THE FIRST RACES.

---

14. Creation of men. 15. They are empty shadows. 16. The Creators are perplexed how to create a *thinking* man. 17. What is needed for the formation of a perfect Man.

---

14. THE SEVEN HOSTS, THE WILL-BORN <note>original: "Mind-born"</note> LORDS, PROPELLED BY THE SPIRIT OF LIFE-GIVING <note>original: "Fohat," the vitalizing force in the universe</note>, SEPARATE MEN FROM THEMSELVES, EACH ON HIS OWN ZONE.

They threw off their “Shadows” or Astral Bodies—if such an ethereal being as a “Lunar Spirit” may be supposed to possess an Astral body in addition to a body that is already hardly tangible. In another Commentary, it is said that the Ancestors *breathed* out the first man, just as Brahma is explained to have breathed out the *Suras* (Gods) when they became *Asuras* (from *Asu*, meaning breath). In a third Commentary, it is said that these newly-created Men were the “shadows of the Shadows.”

With regard to this sentence—“They were the shadows of the Shadows”—a few more words may be said and a fuller explanation attempted. This first process of the evolution of mankind is far easier to accept than the one which follows it, though all such processes will be rejected and doubted even by some Kabbalists—especially those in the West, who study present effects but have neglected to study their primary causes. Nor does the writer feel competent to explain a mode of procreation so difficult to appreciate for anyone except an Eastern Occultist. # MAN NOT CREATED PERFECT.

A certain class of students will always prefer the idea of man being made from the dust of the ground over the idea of man being projected out of the ethereal body of his creator. This is despite the fact that the former process has never been observed, while the latter is familiar to many Spiritualists in Europe and America—who, of all people, should understand it. For anyone who has witnessed the phenomenon of a "materializing form" oozing out of the pores of a medium or, at other times, out of his *left side*, how can they fail to believe in the possibility of such a *birth*? 

If there are beings in the Universe such as Angels or Spirits, whose *incorporeal essence* <note>original: "incorporeal essence"; meaning a non-physical substance</note> may constitute an intelligent entity despite lacking a solid organism (as we understand it); and if there are those who believe that a God made the first man out of dust and breathed into him a living Soul—and there are millions upon millions who believe both—what is so impossible about our doctrine? 

Very soon the day will dawn when the world must choose its path. It must either accept the miraculous creation of man (and the Universe) out of *nothing*, according to the literal "dead letter" of the Book of *Genesis*, or believe that the first man was born from a fantastic "missing link"—which remains absolutely missing so far—the common ancestor of both man and the "true ape." Between these two fallacies, Occult Philosophy steps in. It teaches that the first human stock was projected by higher and semi-divine Beings out of their own essences. Even if this process is considered abnormal or inconceivable today—because it is obsolete in Nature at this current stage of evolution—it is still proven possible by the authority of certain "spiritualistic" facts. Which, then, of these three hypotheses is the most reasonable and the least absurd? Certainly no one—provided they are not a soul-blind Materialist—can ever object to the Occult Teaching.

Now, as has been shown, we gather from this teaching that man was not "created" as the complete being he is now, however imperfect he still remains.

# THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

There was a spiritual, a psychic, an intellectual, and an animal evolution, descending from the highest to the lowest, as well as a physical development—rising from the simple and uniform <note>original: "homogeneous"</note> up to the more complex and diverse <note>original: "heterogeneous"</note>. However, this did not occur quite along the lines traced for us by modern Evolutionists. This double evolution, moving in two contrary directions, required various ages of different natures and degrees of spirituality and intellect to manufacture the being now known as man. 

Furthermore, there is one absolute, ever-acting, and never-erring law which proceeds along the same lines from one Eternity to another <note>original: "Manvantara," a Sanskrit term for a vast period of cosmic activity</note>. This law constantly provides an ascending scale for the manifested world—which we call the "Great Illusion" <note>original: "Mahâ-Mâyâ"</note>—while on the other hand plunging Spirit deeper and deeper into materiality, and then *redeeming it through flesh* and liberating it. This law, we say, uses Beings from other and higher planes—men, or "Minds" <note>original: "Manus"</note>—to achieve these purposes, in accordance with their "Karmic requirements" <note>original: "exigencies," referring to the results of past actions</note>.

### ON THE IDENTITY AND DIFFERENCES OF THE INCARNATING POWERS.

The hidden <note>original: "Esoteric"</note> name of these Solar Angels is, literally, the "Lords" <note>original: "Nâth"</note> of "persevering, ceaseless devotion" <note>original: "Pranidhâna"</note>. Therefore, those of the <term>Fifth Principle</term> <note>The "Manas," or the human mind/intellect in the seven-fold classification of man.</note> seem to be connected with, or to have originated, the system of the Yogis who make this "ceaseless devotion" their *fifth observance*. # PITRIS OF THE GODS AND DEMONS

How philosophical was Plato's remark on the (Human) Soul or Ego when he defined it as “a compound of the *same* and the *other*.” And yet, how little this hint has been understood, since the world took it to mean that the Soul was the Breath of God, or of Jehovah. It is “the *same* and the *other*,” as the great Initiate-Philosopher <note>Plato</note> said; for the Ego—the “Higher Self” when merged with and in the Divine Monad <note>The fundamental unit of spiritual reality</note>—is Man, and yet the *same* as the “*other*.” The Angel incarnated within him is one and the same with the Universal Mahat <note>term: Mahat; the Universal Mind or cosmic intelligence</note>. The great classical writers and philosophers felt this truth when they said:

> There must be something within us which produces our thoughts. Something very subtle; it is a breath; it is fire; it is ether; it is quintessence; it is a slender likeness; it is an intellection; it is a number; it is harmony.*

All these are the Mânasas and Râjasas; the Kumâras, Asuras, and other Rulers and Pitris <note>term: Pitris; "Fathers" or ancestral spirits who assist in the creation of humanity</note>, who incarnated in the Third Race <note>The third major stage of human evolution in this system</note>, and in this and various other ways endowed mankind with Mind.

There are Seven Classes of Pitris, as shown below: three Incorporeal <note>without physical bodies</note> and four Corporeal <note>having physical bodies</note>; and two main kinds, the Agnishvâtta and the Barhishad. And we may add that, just as there are two kinds of Pitris, there is a double and a triple set of Barhishad and Agnishvâtta. The former, having given birth to their Astral Doubles <note>The subtle, energetic blueprint of the body</note>, are reborn as Sons of Atri and are the “Pitris of the Demons,” or Corporeal Beings, according to the authority of Manu;† while the Agnishvâtta are reborn as Sons of Marichi (a Son of Brahmâ) and are the “Pitris of the Gods.”‡

> *The Vâyu Purâna* declares the Seven Orders of Pitris to have been originally the *first* Gods, the Vairâjas, whom Brahmâ beheld with the eye of Yoga in the eternal spheres, and who are the *gods of the gods*. . . . . . . The *Matsya Purâna* . . . . . adds that the Gods worshipped them.§

The *Harivamsha* distinguishes the Vairâjas as only one class of the Pitris,‖ a statement corroborated in the Secret Teachings. These teachings, however, identify the Vairâjas with the elder Agnishvâttas¶ and the Râjasas (or Abhûtarajasas), who are Incorporeal without even an Astral Phantom.

Sambhûti was a daughter of Daksha and the wife of Marîchi, the father of the Agnishvâtta <note>A class of "Solar Pitris" or spiritual ancestors who lack the physical "fire" to create bodies but possess the intellectual "fire"</note>.
