"All the Sons of Virâja are Mânasa," says Nîlakantha. And Virâja is Brahmâ; therefore, the Incorporeal Pitris <note>Ancestors or spiritual progenitors who do not possess physical bodies</note> are called Vairâjas because they are the Sons of Virâja, according to the *Vayu Purâna*.

We could multiply our proofs to infinity <note>original: *ad infinitum*</note>, but it is useless. The wise will understand our meaning; the unwise are not required to. There are thirty-three *crores* <note>A crore is ten million; thus, 330 million</note>, or three hundred and thirty millions, of Gods in India. But, as remarked by the learned lecturer on the *Bhagavad Gîtâ*:

> They may all be *devas* <note>Celestial beings or "shining ones"</note>, but they are by no means all "gods" in the high spiritual sense one attributes to the term.

This is an unfortunate blunder generally committed by Europeans. A *Deva* is a kind of spiritual being, and because the same word is used in ordinary speech to mean "god," it by no means follows that Hindus have and worship three hundred and thirty million gods. These beings, as may be naturally inferred, have a *certain affinity* with one of the three component *Upâdhis* [basic principles or foundations] into which we have divided man.<margin>See *Theosophist*, February, 1887, page 360.</margin>

The names of the deities of a certain mystic class change with every Manvantara. Thus the twelve Great Gods, the Jayas—created by Brahmâ to assist him in the work of creation at the very beginning of the *Kalpa* <note>An eon or "Day of Brahma," lasting 4.32 billion years</note>, and who, lost in *Samâdhi* <note>A state of intense concentration or spiritual ecstasy</note>, neglected to create—whereupon they were cursed to be repeatedly born in each Manvantara until the seventh—are respectively called Ajitas, Tushitas, Satyas, Haris, Vaikunthas, Sâdhyas, and Adityas.<margin>See Wilson, volume 2, page 26.</margin> They are called Tushitas in the second Kalpa, and Âdityas in this current Vaivasvata Period,<margin>See *Vâyu Purâna*.</margin> besides other names for each age. But they are identical with the Mânasas or Râjasas, and these are identical with our incarnating Dhyân Chohans <note>High spiritual beings or "Lords of Meditation" who guide the evolution of the cosmos</note>.

# THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

The Pitris <note>Sanskrit: "Fathers" or ancestors; in this context, celestial progenitors of humanity</note> are divided into *seven Classes*, giving us the mystic number once again. Nearly all the *Puranas* <note>Ancient Hindu texts containing mythology and cosmology</note> agree that three of these classes are *Arupa* (formless), while four are *Corporeal* (having bodies). The former are intellectual and spiritual, while the latter are material and lack intellect. Esoterically, it is the *Asuras* <note>In later tradition, "demons," but here referring to high spiritual beings</note> who form the first three Classes of Pitris—"born in the *Body of Night*"—whereas the other four were produced from the "*Body of Twilight*." According to the *Vayu Purana*, their Fathers, the Gods, were doomed to be born as fools on Earth. These legends are purposely mixed up and made very hazy: in one account, the Pitris are the Sons of the Gods; in another, they are the sons of *Brahma* <note>The Creator deity in Hinduism</note>; while a third makes them the instructors of their own Fathers. It is the hosts of the four material Classes who create men simultaneously across the seven Zones of the Earth.

Now, regarding the *seven Classes* of Pitris—each of which is again divided into seven—I offer a word to students and a question to the uninitiated. That Class of the "*Fire Dhyanis*" <note>Enlightened beings associated with spiritual fire and intellect</note>, which we identify on undeniable grounds with the *Agnishvattas* <note>A specific class of Pitris who lack a physical "fire" and thus do not create the physical body, but rather the spiritual intellect</note>, is called in our school the "Heart" of the *Dhyan-Chohanic Body* <note>The collective body of celestial beings</note>. It is said that they incarnated in the Third Race of men and made them perfect. Esoteric Mystagogy <note>The interpretation of mystery or sacred rituals</note> speaks of the mysterious relation existing between the sevenfold essence of this angelic Heart and that of man. Every physical organ, as well as every psychic and spiritual function in man, is a reflection—a copy on the terrestrial plane—of the model or prototype above. 

Why, it is asked, should there be such a strange repetition of the number seven in the anatomical structure of man? Why should the heart have *four lower cavities and three higher divisions*, answering so strangely to the sevenfold division of human principles? These are separated into two groups, the higher and the lower. Why should the same division be found in the various classes of Pitris, and especially our *Fire Dhyanis*? For, as already stated, these Beings fall into four *Corporeal* (or grosser) and three *Incorporeal* (or subtler) "Principles." Why do the seven nervous plexuses of the body radiate seven rays? Why are there these seven plexuses, and why are there seven distinct layers in the human skin?

The Commentary says:
*Having projected their Shadows and made men of one Element [Ether], the Progenitors ascend again to Maha-Loka <note>A high celestial plane or world in Hindu cosmology</note>. From there, they descend periodically when the World is renewed to give birth to new Men.*

*The Subtle Bodies remain without understanding [Manas, or the mind] until the arrival of the Suras [Gods], who are now called Asuras [Not-Gods].*

# THE REFUSAL TO CREATE.

They are "Not-Gods" to the Brahmans, perhaps, but they are the highest "Breaths" <note>original: *Prana* or life-forces</note> to the Occultist. These Progenitors (*Pitaras*), who are formless and purely intellectual, refuse to build the physical form of man. Instead, they endow him with Mind, while the four lower, physical classes of beings create only his body.

This is shown very clearly in various texts of the *Rig Veda*—the highest authority for a Hindu of any sect. In that text, *Asura* means "spiritual" or "divine," and the word is used as a synonym for the Supreme Spirit. The term *Asura*, in the sense of a "God," is applied to Varuna, Indra, and preeminently to Agni. These three were the three *highest* Gods in ancient times, before Brahmanical Theo-Mythology <note>The author's term for the later religious myths created by the priestly caste</note> distorted the true meaning of almost everything in the Ancient Scriptures. But, because the key to understanding them is now lost, the *Asuras* are hardly mentioned today.

The same is found in the *Zend Avesta*. In the Mazdean (or Magian) religion, *Asura* is the Lord *Asura Vishvavedas*, the "all-knowing" or "omniscient Lord." *Asura Mazdha*—which later became *Ahura Mazda*—is, as the scholar Benfey shows, "the Lord who bestows *Intelligence*" (*Asura Medha* and *Ahura Mazda*). <note>See *Sacred Books of the East*, Vol. IV, *The Zend-Avesta*, Part I, page lviii, translated by James Darmesteter.</note> Elsewhere in this work, it is shown on equally good authority that the Indo-Iranian *Asura* was always regarded as *sevenfold*. This fact, combined with the name *Mazdha* (as mentioned above), makes the sevenfold *Asura* the "Lord" or "Lords" collectively "who bestow *Intelligence*." This connects the *Amshaspends* <note>The seven divine spirits in Zoroastrianism</note> with the *Asuras* and with our incarnating *Dhyan Chohans* <note>High spiritual beings or "Lords of Light"</note>, as well as with the *Elohim* <note>The divine creators mentioned in Genesis</note> and the seven informing Gods of Egypt, Chaldea, and every other country.

The reason these "Gods" refused to create physical men is not because their pride was too great to share their celestial power with the "Children of Earth" (as claimed in public religious accounts), but for reasons already suggested. However, allegory has indulged in endless fancies, and Theology in every country has taken advantage of this to build a case against these "First-born" beings (the *Logoi* <note>original: *Logoi*, the "Words" or creative principles</note>). They have done this to impress a certain "truth" upon the minds of the ignorant and gullible. <note>Compare also what is said about *Makara* and the *Kumaras* in connection with the Zodiac.</note>

The Christian system is not the only one that has degraded these Gods into Demons. Zoroastrianism and even Brahmanism have used this tactic to gain a hold over the people's minds. Even in Chaldean public religion, those Beings who refuse to create—and are said to thereby oppose the *Demiurge* <note>The subordinate deity who fashions the physical world</note>—are denounced as Spirits of Darkness. # THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

Suras <note>original: *Suras*; divine beings or deities</note>, who are devoid of intelligence and are shown as passing their lives in profitless ceremonial worship based on blind faith—a hint now ignored by the *orthodox* Brahmans—and immediately the former become *Asuras* <note>original: *A-Suras*; literally "not-gods," often depicted as demons in later theology, but here implying a shift in spiritual status</note>. The First-born and Mind-born Sons of the Deity refuse to create progeny, and are *cursed* by Brahma to be *born as men*. They are hurled down to *Earth*, which, later on, is transformed in theological dogma into the *Infernal Regions* <note>Hell</note>. Ahriman <note>The spirit of evil in Zoroastrianism</note> destroys the Bull created by Ormazd <note>Ahura Mazda, the spirit of good</note>—which is the emblem of terrestrial *illusive life*, the “germ of sorrow.” Forgetting that the perishing finite seed must die so that the plant of immortality—the plant of spiritual, eternal life—should sprout and live, Ahriman is proclaimed the enemy, the opposing power, the Devil. Typhon <note>The Greek monster/giant</note> cuts Osiris into fourteen pieces in order to prevent him from peopling the world and thus creating misery; and Typhon becomes, in the public, theological teaching, the Power of Darkness. But all this is the external shell. It is the worshippers of this outer shell who attribute to disobedience and rebellion the effort and self-sacrifice of those who would help men to reach their original status of divinity through *self-conscious efforts*; and it is these worshippers of *form* who have made Demons out of the Angels of Light.

# WHAT PROMETHEUS SYMBOLIZED.

The concept, which was too philosophical and metaphysical for the masses to grasp, was—as already stated—distorted by the priesthood. Their goal was to maintain control over the people through superstitious fear.

The supposed “Rebels,” then, were simply those who—compelled by the Law of Karma to drink the cup of bitterness to its last drop—*had to incarnate once more*. In doing so, they turned the “astral statues” <note>The mindless, ethereal forms of early humanity</note> projected by their lesser brothers into responsible, thinking entities. Some are said to have refused because they did not possess the necessary materials—that is, an astral body—for they were *Arûpa* <note>original: *Arûpa*; formless, or existing without a physical or subtle shape</note>. The refusal of others was due to their status as Adepts and Yogis from vast, preceding *Manvantaras* <note>original: *Manvantaras*; cycles of cosmic manifestation lasting millions of years</note>; this is another deep mystery. But later on, as *Nirmânakâyas* <note>original: *Nirmânakâyas*; spiritually advanced beings who forgo the peace of Nirvana to remain in the earthly sphere and help humanity</note>, they sacrificed themselves for the benefit and salvation of the Monads <note>The eternal, spiritual sparks that constitute the core of every soul</note> which were waiting for their turn. Otherwise, these Monads would have had to linger for countless ages in irresponsible, animal-like forms—human in appearance, but lacking reason. This story may be a parable and an allegory *within an allegory*. Its solution is left to the intuition of the student, provided they read what follows with their *spiritual eye*.

As for their Fashioners or Ancestors—those Angels who, in the traditional legends, obeyed the law—they must be identical with the *Barhishad Pitris*, or the *Pitri-Devatâs* <note>original: *Pitri-Devatâs*; ancestral spirits or lunar deities responsible for the physical and astral human form</note>, who are possessed of the *physical creative fire*. They could only create, or rather clothe, the human Monads with their own astral Selves. However, they could not make man in their own image and likeness. “Man must not be like one of us,” say the Creative Gods entrusted with the construction of the lower animal—but higher <note>meaning the physical human form</note>.* The fact that they created the appearance of men out of their own divine Essence means, *Esoterically*, that they are the ones who became the First Race, thereby sharing its destiny and further evolution. They *would not—simply because they could not*—give to man 그 sacred *spark* which burns and expands into the flower of human reason and self-consciousness; they did not have it to give. This task was left to that Class of *Devas* <note>original: *Devas*; gods or divine beings</note> who were symbolized in Greece by the name Prometheus. These were the beings who had nothing to do with the physical body, yet everything to do with the purely spiritual man.

Each Class of Creators endows man with what it has to give: one builds his external form; the other provides its essence, which later becomes the Human Higher Self due to the *personal exertion of the individual*. But they could not make men exactly as they were themselves—perfect because they were sinless; and sinless because they possessed only the first—

# THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

These beings were merely pale, shadowy outlines of attributes, and all of them were perfect—from a human perspective—white, pure, and cold as virgin snow. However, where there is no struggle, there is no merit. Humanity, being "of the earth, earthy," <note>A reference to 1 Corinthians 15:47, implying a physical, material nature.</note> was not destined to be created by the Angels of the First Divine Breath. Therefore, it is said that they *refused* to create, and man had to be formed by more material Creators. These Creators, in turn, could only give what they possessed in their own natures and nothing more. 

Subservient to eternal law, the pure Gods could only project out of themselves *shadowy* men, who were a little less ethereal and spiritual, and less *divine* and perfect than themselves—but still only shadows. The first Humanity, therefore, was a pale copy of its Progenitors. It was too material, even in its ethereality, to be a hierarchy of Gods, yet too spiritual and pure to be Men—endowed as it was with every *negative* perfection (known as *nirguna* <note>term: nirguna; a Sanskrit term meaning "without attributes" or "devoid of qualities," often used to describe the absolute state before manifestation.</note>). 

Perfection, to be truly complete, must be born out of imperfection; the *incorruptible* must grow out of the corruptible, using the latter as its vehicle, basis, and contrast. Absolute Light is the same as absolute Darkness, and vice versa. In fact, there is neither Light nor Darkness in the realms of Truth. Good and Evil are twins, the offspring of Space and Time under the influence of *Maya* <note>term: Maya; the power of illusion or the deceptive nature of the material world.</note>. If you separate them by cutting one off from the other, they will both die. Neither exists by itself (*per se*), since each must be generated and created out of the other in order to exist. Both must be known and appreciated before they can be perceived; therefore, in the mortal mind, they must be divided.

<margin>* Despite all efforts to prove otherwise, Christian Theology has burdened itself with the Hebrew Esoteric <note>term: Esoteric; intended for or likely to be understood by only a small number of people with specialized knowledge.</note> account of the creation of man, which it interprets *literally*. Because of this, it cannot find any reasonable excuse for its "God, the Creator," who produces a man lacking mind and sense. Nor can it justify the punishment following an act for which Adam and Eve might plead "not of sound mind" (*non compos mentis*). For if the couple is admitted to be ignorant of good and evil before eating the forbidden fruit, how could they be expected to know that *disobedience was evil*? If primeval man was meant to remain a half-witted, or rather witless, being, then his creation was aimless and even *cruel*, if produced by an omnipotent and perfect God. But even in *Genesis*, Adam and Eve are shown to be created by a class of lower divine beings, the *Elohim* <note>term: Elohim; a Hebrew word for "gods" or "powers," used in the Old Testament.</note>, who are so jealous of their personal privileges as reasonable and intelligent creatures that they will not allow man to become "as one of us." This is clear even from the literal meaning of the Bible. The Gnostics <note>term: Gnostics; early Christian-era mystics who believed in salvation through secret knowledge and distinguished between a supreme God and a lower creator of the material world.</note>, then, were right in regarding the Jewish God as belonging to a class of lower, material, and not very holy inhabitants of the invisible world.</margin>

Nevertheless, as this illusionary distinction exists, it requires a *lower* order of Creative Angels to "create" inhabited worlds—especially ours—or to deal with matter on this earthly plane. The philosophical Gnostics were the first to think so during the historical period, and they invented various systems based on this theory. Therefore, in their schemes of creation, one always finds their "Creators" occupying a place at the very bottom of the ladder of Spiritual Being. ## THE SVASTIKA.

This represents the conscious *Manas* <note>Sanskrit: the mind or intellect</note>, the connecting link between Spirit and Matter, Heaven and Earth.

Everywhere, the story is the same. The "Creating" Powers produce Man, but fail in their final object. All these *Logoi* <note>Greek: "Words" or divine creative principles</note> strive to endow man with *conscious* immortal Spirit, which is reflected in the Mind (*Manas*) alone. They fail, and they are all represented as being punished for the failure, if not for the attempt itself. What is the nature of this punishment? It is a sentence of imprisonment in the lower or nether region, which is our Earth—the lowest world in its planetary chain. They are sentenced to an "Eternity"—meaning the entire duration of the Life-cycle—in the *darkness* of Matter, or *within animal Man*. 

It pleased the half-ignorant and half-scheming Church Fathers to disfigure this graphic symbol. They took advantage of the metaphors and allegories in every ancient religion to turn them to the benefit of their new one. Thus, the "darkness" of a material existence was transformed into the darkness of a literal Hell. Man's divine consciousness, obtained from his indwelling Principle—the *Manasa* <note>The spiritual ego or "mind-born" entity</note>, or the incarnated *Deva* <note>Sanskrit: a deity or celestial being</note>—became the glaring flames of the Infernal Region, and our Globe became that Hell itself. *Pippala* <note>The sacred fig tree of India</note> and *Haoma* <note>The sacred plant of Zoroastrianism</note>, the fruit of the Tree of Knowledge, were denounced as the *forbidden fruit*. Furthermore, the "*Serpent of Wisdom*," the voice of reason and consciousness, remained identified for ages with the *Fallen Angel*, who is the old Dragon, the Devil!

The same has happened to other high symbols. The Svastika—the most sacred and mystic symbol in India, now called the "*Jaina Cross*" by the Masons—has been dishonored in the same manner, despite its direct connection and even identity with the Christian Cross. It is the "devil's sign," we are told by the Indian missionaries. Does it not shine on the head of the great Serpent of Vishnu, on the thousand-headed *Shesha-Ananta*, in the depths of *Patala* <note>The underworld or nether regions</note>, the Hindu *Naraka* or Hell? 

It does; but what is *Ananta*? As *Shesha*, it represents the almost endless *Manvantaric* <note>Relating to a Manvantara, a vast period of cosmic activity</note> Cycle of Time. It becomes *Infinite Time* itself when called *Ananta*, the great Seven-headed Serpent upon which rests Vishnu, the *Eternal Deity*, during *Pralayic* inactivity <note>Pralaya: the period of cosmic rest between cycles of manifestation</note>. What has Satan to do with this highly metaphysical symbol? 

The Svastika is the most philosophically scientific of all symbols, as well as the most comprehensible. It is the summary in a few lines of the entire work of "creation"—or evolution, as one should rather say—from *Cosmo-theogony* <note>The generation of the gods and the universe</note> down to *Anthropogony* <note>The study of human origins</note>; from the indivisible, unknown *Parabrahman* <note>The supreme, boundless reality in Hindu philosophy</note> to the humble *Moneron* <note>A term used in 19th-century biology for the simplest form of life</note> of materialistic Science, whose *origin* is as unknown to that Science as is the origin of the All-Deity Itself. The Swastika is found heading the religious symbols of every ancient nation. It is the “Worker’s Hammer” in the Chaldean *Book of Numbers* <note>A Kabbalistic text attributed to ancient Babylon</note> and the “Hammer” referred to in the *Book of Concealed Mystery* <note>original: Siphra Dzeniouta; a core text of the Zohar</note>, “which strikes sparks from the flint” (Space)—those sparks becoming Worlds. It is Thor’s Hammer, the magic weapon forged by the Dwarfs against the Giants, or the pre-cosmic Titanic forces of Nature. These forces rebel and, while active in the region of Matter, will not be subdued by the Gods—the agents of Universal Harmony—but must first be destroyed. This is why the World is formed out of the relics of the murdered Ymir <note>In Norse mythology, the first giant from whose body the world was created</note>. The Swastika is the Mjölnir, the “Storm-hammer”; and therefore it is said that when the Aesir <note>original: Ases; the principal gods of the Norse pantheon</note>, the holy Gods, have been purified by fire—the fire of passions and suffering in their life-incarnations—and become fit to dwell in Ida <note>A plain in Norse myth where the gods gather after Ragnarok</note> in eternal peace, then Mjölnir will become useless. This will happen when the bonds of Hel—the Goddess-queen of the region of the Dead—will bind them no longer, for the kingdom of evil will have passed away.

The flames of Surtur <note>The fire-giant who destroys the world during Ragnarok</note> had not destroyed them, nor yet had the raging waters <insert>[of the several deluges]</insert>. . . . There were . . . the sons of Thor. They brought Mjölnir with them, not as a weapon of war, but as the hammer with which to consecrate the new heavens and the new earth.\*

Verily many are its meanings! In the macrocosmic <note>The "great world" or the universe as a whole</note> work, the “Hammer of Creation,” with its four arms bent at right angles, refers to the continual *motion* and revolution of the invisible Cosmos of Forces. In the manifested Cosmos and our Earth, it points to the rotation in the Cycles of Time of the world’s axes and their equatorial belts; the two lines forming the Swastika <image-desc>A swastika symbol</image-desc> mean Spirit and Matter, while the four hooks suggest the motion in the revolving cycles. Applied to the microcosm <note>The "small world," referring here to Man as a reflection of the universe</note>, Man, it shows him to be a link between Heaven and Earth; the right hand being raised at the end of a horizontal arm, the left pointing to the Earth. In the *Emerald Tablet of Hermes* <note>original: Smaragdine Tablet; a foundational text of Hermeticism and alchemy</note>, the uplifted right hand is inscribed with the word “Dissolve” <note>original: Solve</note>, the left with the word “Congeal” <note>original: Coagula</note>. It is at one and the same time an Alchemical, Cosmogonical, Anthropological, and Magical sign, with seven keys to its inner meaning. It is not too much to say that the compound symbolism of this universal and most suggestive of signs contains the key to the seven great mysteries of the Cosmos. # A PROPHECY OF THE SEVENTH RACE

At the very threshold of eternity, on the head of the serpent Ananta <note>In Hindu mythology, the celestial serpent representing infinity or the "endless."</note>, it found its spiritual death in the scholastic interpretations of medieval Anthropomorphists <note>Those who attribute human form or personality to God.</note>. It is the Alpha and the Omega <note>The beginning and the end.</note> of universal Creative Force, evolving from pure Spirit and ending in gross Matter. It is also the key to the Cycle of Science, both divine and human; and he who comprehends its full meaning is forever liberated from the snares of *Maha-Maya*, the great Illusion and Deceiver. The Light that shines from under the Divine Hammer <note>The Swastika or Thor’s Hammer, symbolizing creative motion.</note>—now degraded into the mallet or gavel of the Grand Masters of Masonic Lodges—is sufficient to dissipate the darkness of any human schemes or fictions.

How prophetic are the songs of the three Norse Goddesses <note>The Norns: Urd (Past), Verdandi (Present), and Skuld (Future).</note>, to whom the ravens of Odin whisper of the past and the future as they flutter around their crystal abode beneath the flowing river. These songs are all written down in the "Scrolls of Wisdom," of which many are lost but some still remain; they repeat in poetical allegory the teachings of the Archaic Ages. To summarize from Dr. Wagner’s *Asgard and the Gods* concerning the "Renewal of the World"—which is a prophecy about the Seventh Race <note>The final, most spiritually evolved stage of humanity in the current planetary cycle.</note> of our Round told in the past tense:

The *Mjolnir* <note>Thor’s hammer.</note> had done its duty in this Round, and:

> On the field of Ida, the field of resurrection [for the Fifth Round], the sons of the highest gods assembled, and in them their fathers rose again [the Egos of all their past incarnations]. They talked of the Past and the Present, and remembered the wisdom and prophecies of their ancestors which had all been fulfilled. Near them, but *unseen by them*, was the strong, the mighty One, who rules all things, makes peace between those who are angry with each other, and ordains the eternal laws that govern the world. *They all knew he was there, they felt his presence and his power, but were ignorant of his name.* At his command the *new earth rose out of the waters* [of Space]. To the south above the Field of Ida, he made another heaven called Audlang, and further off, a third, known as Widblain. Over Gimil’s cave a wondrous palace was erected, which was covered with gold and *shining bright in the sun*. Had not the “Sons of Mahat”—speaking allegorically—skipped the Intermediate Worlds in their impulse toward intellectual freedom, the animal man would never have been able to reach upward from this Earth and attain his ultimate goal through self-exertion. The Cyclic Pilgrimage <note>The soul's long journey through various stages of evolution.</note> would have had to be performed through all the planes of existence half-unconsciously, or even entirely so, as is the case with animals. 

It is owing to this rebellion of intellectual life against the morbid inactivity of pure spirit that we are what we are—self-conscious, thinking men, with the capabilities and attributes of Gods within us, for good as much as for evil. Hence, the Rebels are our Saviors. Let the Philosopher ponder well over this, and more than one mystery will become clear to him. It is only by the attractive force of contrasts that the two opposites—Spirit and Matter—can be cemented together on Earth. Smelted in the fire of self-conscious experience and suffering, they find themselves wedded in Eternity. This will reveal the meaning of many hitherto incomprehensible allegories, which have been foolishly called “fables.”

### WHAT HYDROGEN REALLY IS.

This element has as decided an influence upon human gestation and reproduction, which it regulates, as it has on the growth of plants and animals. The "Wind" or Ether—standing in this case for the agent of transmission by which those influences are carried down from the two luminaries <note>The Sun and Moon</note> and diffused upon earth—is referred to as the "Nurse";<margin>See Verse 22.</margin> while "Spiritual Fire" alone makes of man a divine and perfect entity.

Now what is that "Spiritual Fire"? In Alchemy, it is Hydrogen in general; while in Esoteric reality, it is the emanation, or the Ray which proceeds from its *Noumenon* <note>original: "Noumenon"; the spiritual essence or "thing-in-itself" behind a physical phenomenon</note>, the "Dhyân <note>A high-ranking celestial being or meditative intelligence</note> of the First Element." Hydrogen is *gas* only on our terrestrial plane. But even in Chemistry, Hydrogen "would be the only existing form of matter, in our sense of the term,"<margin>See *Genesis of the Elements*, by W. Crookes, p. 21.</margin> and is very nearly allied to *Protyle* <note>A hypothetical primordial substance from which all elements are derived</note>, which is our *Layam* <note>A state of zero-point or undifferentiated matter</note>. It is the father and generator, so to speak—or rather the *Upâdhi* (basis)—of both Air and Water. It is "fire, air, and water" in fact: *one* substance under three aspects; hence the chemical and alchemical trinity. In the world of manifestation, or Matter, it is the objective symbol and the material emanation from the subjective and purely spiritual Being in the region of *Noumena*. 

Godfrey Higgins <note>An 18th-century archaeologist and writer on ancient religions</note> might well have compared Hydrogen to, and even identified it with, the *To On* <note>original: "To On"; Greek for "The Being" or "The One"</note>, the "One" of the Greeks. For, as he remarks, Hydrogen is *not* water, though it generates it; Hydrogen is *not* fire, though it manifests or creates it; nor is it air, though air may be regarded as a product of the union of water and fire—since Hydrogen is found in the moisture of the atmosphere. It is three in one.

If one studies comparative *Theogony* <note>The study of the origin and genealogy of the gods</note>, it is easy to find that the secret of these "Fires" was taught in the Mysteries of every ancient people, preeminently in Samothrace. There is not the smallest doubt that the *Kabiri* <note>Ancient mystery gods of Greece</note>—the most secret of all the ancient Deities, Gods and Men, great Deities and Titans—are identical with the *Kumâras* and *Rudras* headed by *Kârttikeya* (who is also a *Kumâra*). This is quite evident even in public teachings; and these Hindu Deities were, like the *Kabiri*, the *personified sacred Fires of the most Occult Powers of Nature*. The several branches of the Aryan Race—the Asiatic and the European, the Hindu and the Greek—did their best to conceal their true nature, if not their importance. As in the case of the *Kumâras*, the number of the *Kabiri* is uncertain. Some say that there were three or four only; others say...

### THE EVOLUTION OF THE SENSES.

Priests. And both exist to this day in their respective sacred symbolisms, because the Ancients associated Sound or Speech with the Ether of Space, of which Sound is the characteristic property. Hence Fire, Water, and Air are the primordial Cosmic Trinity.

<note>original: "I am thy Thought, thy God, more ancient than the Moist Principle, the Light that radiates within Darkness [Chaos], and the shining Word of God [Sound] is the Son of the Deity."</note>
"I am your Thought, your God, more ancient than the Moist Principle <note>The "Moist Principle" refers to the watery chaos or primordial matter from which the world was formed</note>, the *Light that radiates within Darkness* [Chaos], and the shining Word of God [Sound] is the Son of the Deity."*

Thus, we must study the "Primary Creation" thoroughly before we can understand the Secondary. The first Race had three *rudimentary* Elements within it, and *no Fire as yet*. This is because, according to the Ancients, the evolution of man—and the growth and development of his spiritual and physical senses—was subordinate to the evolution of the Elements on the Cosmic plane of this Earth. Everything proceeds from *Prabhavapyaya* <note>Sanskrit: The place from which all things originate and to which they return at the end of an age</note>, the evolution of the creative and sentient principles in the Gods, and even of the so-called Creative Deity himself. This is found in the names and titles given to Vishnu in the public <note>original: "exoteric"</note> Scriptures. Like the Orphic *Protologos* <note>Greek: The "First-Born" or first manifestation of the divine</note>, he is called *Purvaja*, meaning "pre-genetic" or "born before all others," and his other names connect him in descending order more and more with Matter.

The following order on parallel lines may be found in the evolution of the Elements and the Senses; or in Cosmic Terrestrial "Man" (Spirit) and mortal physical man:

1. **Ether** ... Hearing ... Sound.
2. **Air** ... Touch ... Sound and Touch.
3. **Fire, or Light** ... Sight ... Sound, Touch, and Color.
4. **Water** ... Taste ... Sound, Touch, Color, and Taste.
5. **Earth** ... Smell ... Sound, Touch, Color, Taste, and Smell.

As shown, each Element adds the characteristics of its predecessor to its own; just as each Root-Race <note>In Theosophy, a "Root-Race" is one of the seven stages of human evolution on Earth</note> adds the characterizing sense of the preceding Race. The same is true in the seven-fold <note>original: "septenary"</note> "creation" of man, who evolves gradually in seven stages and on the same principles, as will be shown further on.

Thus, while Gods, or *Dhyan Chohans* (Devas) <note>High-ranking celestial beings or "Lords of Meditation"</note>, proceed from the—

# THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

The First Cause—which is not *Parabrahman* <note>The Supreme Infinite, beyond all thought or description</note>, for the latter is the **All Cause** and cannot be referred to as merely the "First Cause"—is called in the Brahmanical books *Jagad-Yoni*, the "Womb of the World." Mankind emanates from these active agents in the Cosmos. However, during the First and Second Races, men were not physical beings, but merely *rudiments* of future men. They were *Bhutas* <note>original: "Bhûtas"; here meaning "shadows" or "elementary forms"</note>, which proceeded from *Bhutadi* <note>original: "Bhûtâdi"</note>, the "origin" or the "original place from which the Elements sprang." 

Hence, they proceeded along with everything else from *Prabhavapyaya* <note>original: "Prabhavâpyaya"</note>, "the place from which all things originate and into which they are resolved," as explained by the commentator on the *Vishnu Purana*. This is the source of our physical senses and even the highest "created" Deity itself in our philosophy. As one with the Universe—whether we call him Brahma, Ishvara, or Purusha—he is a Manifested Deity, and therefore "created," or limited and conditioned. This is easily proven, even from the exoteric <note>public or non-secret</note> teachings.

After being called the *incognizable* <note>unknowable</note>, eternal Brahma (the neuter or abstract principle) and the *Pundarikaksha* <note>original: "Pundarîkâksha"; the "Lotus-eyed" or supreme glory</note>, he changes. Instead of being *Sadaika-Rupa* <note>original: "Sadaika-Rûpa"</note>, the "changeless" or "immutable" Nature, he is addressed as *Ekaneka-Rupa* <note>original: "Ekâneka-Rûpa"</note>, meaning "both single and manifold." At this point, he, the Cause, becomes merged with his own effects. His names, if placed in the Esoteric <note>inner or secret</note> order, show the following descending scale:

| Name | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- |
| *Mahapurusha* or *Paramatman* | Supreme Spirit. |
| *Atman* or *Purvaja* (*Protologos*) | The Living Spirit of Nature <note>original: "Protologos"; Greek for "First Word" or "First-born"</note>. |
| *Indriyatman* or *Hrishikesha* | Spiritual or Intellectual Soul (one with the senses). |
| *Bhutatman* | The Living, or Life Soul. |
| *Kshetrajna* | Embodied Soul, or the Universe of Spirit and Matter. |
| *Bhrantidarshanatah* | False Perception—the Material Universe. |

The last name, *Bhrantidarshanatah*, means something perceived or conceived of due to false and erroneous apprehension as a material form; in fact, it is only *Maya* <note>original: "Mâyâ"</note>, or Illusion, as is everything in our physical universe.

The evolution of the *Dhyan-Chohanic* Essences <note>High spiritual beings or "Lords of Light"</note> takes place in strict analogy with the attributes of this Brahma in both the spiritual and material worlds. The characteristics of these Essences are reflected, in turn, in Humanity collectively and in each of a human being's principles. *Every one of these principles contains within itself, in the same progressive order, a portion of their various "Fires" and Elements.*

# THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

The growth and development of Man toward perfection depends on two factors: *(a)* the Monad, or that which acts in it unconsciously through a force inherent in itself; and *(b)* the lower Astral Body or the *Personal Self*. The former, whether imprisoned in a vegetable or an animal body, is endowed with—is indeed itself—that Force. Because of its identity with the "All-Force," which is inherent in the Monad, it is all-powerful on the <term>Arûpa</term> <note>original: "Arûpa"; the formless or spiritual plane of existence</note>, or formless plane. On our physical plane, its essence is too pure, so it remains a potential power but becomes individually inactive. 

For instance, the rays of the Sun, which contribute to the growth of vegetation, do not select this or that specific plant to shine upon. If you uproot the plant and transfer it to a piece of soil where the sunbeam cannot reach it, the sunbeam will not follow it. It is the same with the <term>Âtman</term> <note>The supreme universal Self</note>: unless the Higher Self or Ego gravitates toward its Sun—the Monad—the Lower Ego, or *Personal Self*, will have the upper hand in every case. For it is this Lower Ego, with its fierce selfishness and animal desire to live a senseless life (<term>Tanha</term> <note>The "thirst" or craving for material existence</note>), which is the "maker of the tabernacle," as <term>Buddha</term> calls it in the *Dhammapada*.

Hence the expression: "the Spirits of the Earth clothed the shadows and expanded them." To these "Spirits" belong, temporarily, the human Astral Selves; and it is they who give, or build, the physical "tabernacle" (the body) of man, for the Monad and its conscious principle, <term>Manas</term> <note>The mind or thinking faculty</note>, to dwell in. 

But the "Solar" <term>Lhas</term> <note>Tibetan term for spirits or celestial beings</note>, or Spirits, warm the Shadows. This is physically and literally true; metaphysically, or on the psychic and spiritual plane, it is equally true that the <term>Âtman</term> alone *warms the Inner Man*. That is, it enlightens the Inner Man with the Ray of Divine Life and is the only power able to grant immortality to the Inner Man, or the Reincarnating Ego. 

Thus, we shall find that for the first three and a half Root-Races, up to the middle or turning point of evolution, it is the Astral Shadows of the "Progenitors"—the Lunar <term>Pitris</term> <note>Ancestral spirits associated with the Moon who provided the model for the human form</note>—which are the formative powers. They build and gradually force the evolution of the physical form toward perfection, though this happens at the cost of a proportionate loss of Spirituality. 

Then, from the turning point onward, it is the Higher Ego, or Incarnating Principle—the <term>Nous</term> <note>original: "Nous"; Greek for Mind or Intellect</note> or Mind—which reigns over the Animal Ego. It rules the animal nature whenever it is not dragged down by it. In short, Spirituality is on its ascending arc. The animal or physical nature only hinders it from steadily progressing on the path of its evolution when the selfishness of the Personality has so strongly infected the real Inner Man with its lethal *virus* that the upward attraction has lost all its power over the thinking, reasonable man. # THE "SHELLS" OF SHEBA HACHALOTH

Wickedness is an abnormal, unnatural manifestation at this period of our human evolution—at least it ought to be so. The fact that mankind was never more selfish and vicious than it is now—civilized nations having succeeded in making the former an ethical characteristic and the latter an art—is additional proof of the exceptional nature of this phenomenon.

The entire scheme is found in the *Chaldean Book of Numbers*, and even in the *Zohar* <note>The foundational work of Jewish mysticism</note>, if one only understands the meaning of the apocalyptic hints. First comes *Ain Suph* <note>The Infinite or Boundless</note>, the “Concealed of the Concealed,” then the *Point*, *Sephira*, and the later *Sephiroth* <note>The ten attributes or emanations in Kabalah</note>. Then follows the Atzilatic World, a *World of Emanations* that gives birth to three other Worlds:
1. The first is the Briatic World, called the Throne, the abode of pure Spirits.
2. The second is the *World of Formation*, or Jetziratic, the habitat of the Angels who sent forth the third.
3. The third is the *World of Action*, the Asiatic World, which is the Earth or *our World*.

And yet it is said of this World—also called *Kli-photh* <note>original: קליפות; literally "husks" or "shells," representing evil forces</note>, containing the six other Spheres and Matter—that it is the residence of the “Prince of Darkness.” This is as clearly stated as can be; for Metatron, the Angel of the second Briatic World (the first habitable World), means Messenger <note>original: Ἄγγελος (Angelos)</note>, called the Great Teacher. Under him are the Angels of the third World, or Jetziratic, whose ten and seven classes are the Sephiroth,* of whom it is said that:

* It is symbolized in the Pythagorean Triangle: the ten *yods* <note>The tenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet, used here as points</note> within, and the seven points of the Triangle and the Square.

They inhabit or give life to this world as essential entities and intelligences; their correlates and logical opposites inhabit the third habitable world, called the Asiatic.

These “opposites” are called the “Shells” <note>original: קליפות (Kliphoth)</note>, or Demons,† who inhabit the seven habitations called *Sheba Hachaloth*, which are simply the seven Zones of our Globe.‡ Their prince is called in the Kabalah *Samael*, the Angel of Death, who is also the seducing Serpent, Satan. But this Satan is also Lucifer, the bright Angel of Light, the Light- and Life-bringer, the “Soul” alienated from the Holy Ones (the other Angels) for a period, anticipating the time when they would descend to Earth to incarnate in their turn.

# MODES OF REPRODUCTION

Perhaps even more difficult to understand is the Third Race, the "Egg-born" Hermaphrodites <note>original: "Androgynes"; beings possessing both male and female characteristics</note>. These two modes of procreation are the most difficult to comprehend, especially for the Western mind. It is evident that no explanation can be attempted for those who are not students of Occult Metaphysics. European languages have no words to express things which Nature no longer repeats at this stage of evolution—things which, therefore, can have no meaning for the Materialist. 

But there are analogies. It is not denied that in the beginning of physical evolution there must have been processes in Nature—such as spontaneous generation, for instance—which are now extinct but are repeated in other forms. Thus, we are told that microscopic research shows no permanence of any particular mode of reproducing life. For it shows that:

> The same organism may run through various transformations <note>original: "metamorphoses"</note> in the course of its life-cycle. During some of these stages it may be *sexual*, and in others *asexual*; that is, it may reproduce itself alternately by the cooperation of two beings of opposite sex, and also by division <note>original: "fissure"</note> or *budding* from only one being, which has no sex.*

"Budding" is the very word used in the Stanza <note>referring to the Stanzas of Dzyan, the core archaic text of this work</note>. How else could these Shadows <note>original: "Chhâyâs"; the ethereal, image-like forms of the First Race</note> reproduce themselves? How could they procreate the Second Race, since they were ethereal, asexual, and even lacked, as yet, the vehicle of desire—the *Kama Rupa* <note>Sanskrit: "Desire-Form"; the seat of animal impulses and physical desires</note>—which evolved only in the Third Race? They evolved the Second Race unconsciously, just as some plants do. Or, perhaps, they functioned like the Amoeba, only on a more ethereal, impressive, and larger scale. 

If, indeed, the cell-theory applies equally to Botany and Zoology, and extends to the study of form <note>original: "Morphology"</note> as well as the functions of living systems <note>original: "Physiology"</note>, and if microscopic cells are looked upon by Physical Science as independent living beings—just as Occultism regards the "Fiery Lives" <note>the vital, invisible "atoms" or energies that compose all matter</note>—then there is no difficulty in conceiving this primitive process of procreation.

Consider the first stages of the development of a germ-cell. Its nucleus grows, changes, and forms a double cone or spindle, like this: <image-desc>a stylized 'X' symbol representing a spindle during cell division</image-desc> within the cell. This spindle approaches the surface of the cell, and one half of it is pushed out <note>original: "extruded"</note> in the form of what are called "polar cells." These polar cells then die, and the embryo develops from the growth and division <note>original: "segmentation"</note> of the remaining part of the nucleus, which is nourished by the substance of the cell. Why, then, could beings not have lived and been created in this way at the very beginning of human and mammalian evolution?

In the problem being dealt with here, however, the need for a more satisfactory explanation is evident. These biological facts are of a much more prominent and important character than the mere superficial details with which they are compared by Darwin.

## THE DIVINE HERMAPHRODITE.

An impenetrable veil of secrecy was thrown over the Occult and Religious Mysteries after the submersion of the last remnant of the Atlantean Race, some 12,000 years ago, lest they should be shared by the unworthy and thus desecrated. Of these Sciences, several have now become exoteric <note>term: exoteric; knowledge intended for or likely to be understood by the general public.</note>—such as Astronomy, for instance, in its purely mathematical and physical aspects. But their dogmas and tenets, being all symbolized and left to the sole guardianship of parable and allegory, have been forgotten, and hence the meaning has become perverted. Nevertheless, one finds the Hermaphrodite in the scriptures and traditions of almost every nation; and why is there such unanimous agreement if the statement is only a fiction?

### THE ESOTERIC CAIN.

The latter is a mistranslation, whether deliberate or not. Again, the well-known passage:
> I have gotten a man from the Lord,

should read:
> I have gotten a man, even Jehovah.*

Luther translated the passage one way, while the Roman Catholics translated it quite differently. Bishop Wordsworth renders it:
> *Cain—I have gotten—Kain, from Ka’nithi <note>original: "Ka’nithi," a Hebrew root meaning to acquire or create</note>, I have gotten.*

Luther:
> I have gotten a man—even the Lord [Jehovah].

And the author of *The Source of Measures*:
> *I have measured a man, even Jehovah.*

The last is the correct rendering because: (a) a famous Rabbi, a Kabbalist <note>a practitioner of Jewish mysticism</note>, explained the passage to the writer in precisely this way; and (b) this rendering is identical with that found in the Secret Doctrine of the East regarding Brahma <note>the creator god in Hinduism</note>.

> Cain . . . is the son of the “Lord,” not of Adam.

### THE JEWISH GOD-NAME.

Just as Eve issues from the left rib of the second Adam (the Adam made of dust), the pure Virgo <note>The zodiac sign of the Virgin</note> is separated. Theodoret says that the Samaritans pronounced it *Yahva* and the Jews *Yaho*. ### 23. THE SELF-BORN WERE THE SHADOWS <term>Chhâyâs</term>, THE SHADOWS FROM THE BODIES OF THE SONS OF TWILIGHT. NEITHER WATER NOR FIRE COULD DESTROY THEM. THEIR SONS WERE.*

This verse cannot be understood without the help of the Commentaries. It means that the First Root-Race—the "Shadows" of the Progenitors—could not be injured or destroyed by death. Being so ethereal <note>ethereal: extremely light and airy, lacking solid physical form</note> and so little human in their makeup, they could not be affected by any element, whether flood or fire. 

But their "Sons," the Second Root-Race, could be and were so destroyed. Just as the Progenitors merged entirely into their own Astral Bodies <note>Astral Body: a subtle, non-physical double of the physical body</note> (which were their offspring), so that offspring was absorbed into its own descendants, the "Sweat-born." These were the Second Humanity—composed of the most diverse, gigantic, semi-human monsters—the first attempts of material nature at building human bodies.

The majority of the Second Race perished in this first great upheaval of the evolution and solidification of the Globe during the human period. There have already been four such great cataclysms.† And we may expect a fifth for ourselves in the due course of time.

### A FEW WORDS ABOUT “DELUGES” AND “NOAHS.”

The accounts in the various *Puranas* <note>Ancient Indian texts containing mythology and history</note> regarding our Progenitors are as contradictory in their details as everything else in these records. For example, while in the *Rig Veda*, Ida (or Ila) is called the instructor of Vaivasvata Manu, the commentator Sayana describes her as a Goddess presiding over the Earth. Furthermore, the *Shatapatha Brahmana* portrays her as Manu’s daughter—born from his sacrificial offering—and later as his wife, with whom he fathered the race of Manus. In the *Puranas*, she is again Vaivasvata’s daughter, yet also the wife of Budha (representing Wisdom), who was the illegitimate son of the Moon (Soma) and Tara, the wife of the planet Jupiter (Brihaspati). All of this, which appears to be a confused jumble to the uninitiated, is full of philosophical meaning to the Occultist. A secret and sacred meaning is visible on the very surface of the narrative; however, all the details are so intentionally mixed up that only the experienced eye of an Initiate can follow them and place the events in their proper order.

The story as told in the *Mahabharata* sets the fundamental tone, yet it must be explained by the secret sense contained in the *Bhagavad Gita*. It serves as the prologue to the drama of our current (Fifth) Humanity. While Vaivasvata was engaged in his devotions on the river bank, a small fish begged for his protection from a larger fish. He saved it and placed it in a jar. As it grew larger and larger, the fish informed him of the coming Deluge. This Fish is the well-known *Matsya Avatara*, the first incarnation of Vishnu—the same as the Dagon\* of the Chaldean Xisuthrus <note>The Babylonian Noah</note>, and many other symbolic figures. The story is too well known to need repeating here. Vishnu orders a ship to be built, in which Manu is saved along with the seven *Rishis* <note>Sages or celestial beings</note>, according to the *Mahabharata*; however, this detail is absent from other texts. In this context, the seven *Rishis* represent the seven Root-Races, the seven Principles of man, and various other concepts; for there is a double mystery involved in this multifaceted allegory.

We have stated elsewhere that the Great Flood had several meanings. Like the "Fall of Man," it refers to both spiritual and physical events, and both cosmic and terrestrial occurrences: as it is above, so it is below. The Ship or Ark—*Navis* in Latin—is, in short, the symbol of the female principle.

The generative principle <note>the power of procreation and life-giving</note> is symbolized in the heavens by the Moon and on Earth by the Womb. # THE “WHITE ISLAND”

<margin>* One must remember that in Hindu Philosophy, every differentiated unit exists only through the Cycles of *Maya* <note>original: *Mâyâ*; the illusion of the phenomenal world</note>, being one in its essence with the Supreme or One Spirit. This explains the apparent confusion and contradiction in the various *Puranas* <note>ancient Hindu texts</note>, and sometimes regarding the same individual. Vishnu—appearing as the many-formed Brahma (the creator) and as *Brahma* (the impersonal Absolute)—is one, and yet he is said to be all twenty-eight *Vyasas* <note>the title for the "compilers" of sacred knowledge</note>.
“In every *Dvapara* (or third) age, Vishnu, in the person of *Vyasa*, divides the Veda, which is properly only one, into many portions. . . . Twenty-eight times have the Vedas been arranged by the great *Rishis* <note>sages</note> in the *Vaivasvata Manvantara* <note>the current great life-cycle</note>, in the *Dvapara* age; and, consequently, twenty-eight *Vyasas* have passed away.” (*Vishnu Purana*, iii. 3; Wilson’s Translation, iii. 33, 34.) “[They who were all] in the form of *Veda-Vyasa*; who were the *Vyasas* of their respective eras.” (*Ibid.*, loc. cit., p. 33.) “This world is *Brahma*, in *Brahma*, from *Brahma* . . . nothing further to be known.”

This is clear: the Humanity of the First [Root-Race] is the same as the seventh and all the intermediate ones. In the exoteric <note>public or literal</note> legends it is said that Manu Vaivasvata, desiring to create sons, instituted a sacrifice to Mitra and Varuna; but, through a mistake of the officiating Brahman <note>priest</note>, a daughter only was obtained—Ila or Ida. Then, “through the favor of the two deities,” her *sex is changed* and she becomes a man, Sudyumna. Then she is again turned into a woman, and so on; the fable adding that Shiva and his consort were pleased that “she should be a male one month and a female another.” This has a direct reference to the Third Root-Race, whose people were androgynes. # ADAM-GALATEA

Successive floods, the upheaval of valleys, and the constant shifting of the great waters and seas—none of these circumstances could form an impediment to human life and organization, such as *is assigned by them* <note>referring to conventional scientists or theologians</note> to early mankind. Neither the diversity of surrounding regions, full of harmful gases, nor the perils of an earth-crust that was hardly solidified, could prevent the First and Second Races from making their appearance even during the Carboniferous or the Silurian Age itself.

Thus the Monads <term>Monad: In this context, an eternal, spiritual spark or individual soul-unit that evolves through different kingdoms of nature</term> destined to animate future Races were ready for the new transformation. They had passed through their phases of "immetalization" <note>the stage of existing within the mineral kingdom</note>, of plant life, and of animal life—from the lowest to the highest—and were waiting for their human, more intelligent form. Yet what could the Plastic Modelers <note>the celestial beings or forces that shape physical forms</note> do but follow the laws of evolutionary Nature? Could they—as claimed by the literal interpretation of the Bible—form a "Lord-God"-like figure, or like Pygmalion in the Greek allegory, create an "Adam-Galatea" <note>a reference to Pygmalion's statue, Galatea, brought to life; here used to mock the idea of a clay man suddenly becoming alive</note> out of volcanic dust and breathe a "Living Soul" into Man? No; because the Soul was already there, latent in its Monad, and needed only a "coating." 

Pygmalion, *who fails to animate his statue* <note>in some versions of the myth or philosophical interpretations</note>, and Bahak Zivo of the Nazarean Gnostics <note>a Gnostic sect; Bahak Zivo is a light-giving spirit</note>, who fails to construct "a human soul in the creature," are, as concepts, far more philosophical and scientific than Adam (taken in the literal sense) or the biblical Elohim-Creators <note>Elohim: a Hebrew name for God, interpreted here as a group of divine builders</note>. Esoteric Philosophy—which teaches spontaneous generation after the Shishta <note>Sanskrit: "remnants" or survivors who seed a new world-period</note> and Prajapati <note>Sanskrit: "Lord of Creatures," progenitor deities</note> have cast the seed of life on the Earth—shows that the Lower Angels are able to construct the *physical man* only. Even then, they do so with the help of Nature, after having evolved the Ethereal Form out of themselves and leaving the physical form to evolve gradually from its ethereal (or what would now be called "protoplasmic") model.

This will again be objected to; we shall be told that "spontaneous generation" is an exploded theory. Louis Pasteur’s experiments supposedly disposed of it twenty years ago, and Professor Tyndall is against it. Well, suppose he is? He ought to know that even if spontaneous generation were indeed proven impossible in our present world-period and current conditions—which the Occultists deny—it would still be no proof that it could not have taken place under different cosmic conditions. This applies not only to the seas of the Laurentian Period <note>a very early geological period</note> but even on the then-convulsed Earth. It would be interesting to know how Science could ever account for the appearance of species and life on Earth, especially of Man, once it rejects both the biblical teachings and spontaneous generation. Pasteur’s observations, however, are far from being perfect or proven. Blanchard and Dr. Lutaud reject their importance.

And, in fact, these theories show that they have no answer. As for the idea that Ernst Haeckel’s <term>Moneron</term>—a mere pinch of salt!—has solved the problem of the origin of life, it is simply absurd.

Those <term>Materialists</term> <note>Philosophers who maintain that nothing exists but matter and its movements</note> who feel inclined to dismiss the theory of the “<term>Self-existent</term>,” the “<term>Self-born Heavenly Man</term>” (represented as an <term>Ethereal, Astral Man</term>), must excuse even a beginner in <term>Occultism</term> for laughing, in turn, at some speculations of <term>Modern Thought</term>. If <term>spontaneous generation</term> <note>The obsolete theory that living organisms can originate from non-living matter</note> has changed its methods now—perhaps owing to the accumulation of material already on hand—so as to almost escape detection, it was, nevertheless, in full swing during the beginning of terrestrial life. Even the simple physical form and the evolution of species show how Nature proceeds. The scale-covered, gigantic <term>Saurian</term>, the winged <term>Pterodactyl</term>, the <term>Megalosaurus</term>, and the hundred-foot-long <term>Iguanodon</term> of the later period are the transformations of the earliest representatives of the animal kingdom found in the sediments of the primary epoch.

There was a time when all the above-mentioned “<term>antediluvian</term>” <note>Literally "before the flood"; referring here to prehistoric animals</note> monsters appeared as thread-like <term>Infusoria</term> <note>A collective term for various microscopic organisms</note> without shell or crust, with neither nerves, muscles, organs, nor sex, and reproduced their kind by <term>gemmation</term> <note>Asexual reproduction by budding</note>. ### WHAT IS EVOLUTION?

Evolution—or rather nature, viewed through the lens of evolution—has only been studied for about twenty-five years. This is, of course, a mere fraction of time in the history of human thought.

Because of this brevity, we do not lose all hope that materialistic science will amend its ways. We hope it will gradually accept the Esoteric Teachings—even if, at first, science strips away the elements it considers too metaphysical <note>Metaphysical: relating to the fundamental nature of reality and being, often beyond the physical world.</note>.

Has the final word on the subject of human evolution been spoken yet? As Professor Huxley says:

> Each such answer to the great question [man’s real place in nature] is invariably asserted to be **complete** and **final** by the followers of its proposer, if not by the man himself. It remains in high authority and esteem, perhaps for one century, perhaps for twenty. But, just as invariably, Time proves each reply to have been a *mere approximation* of the truth—*acceptable mainly because of the ignorance of those who believed it, and completely unacceptable when tested by the greater knowledge of their successors*."*

Will this eminent Darwinian admit the possibility that his theory of "Pithecoid Ancestry" <note>original: "Pithecoid Ancestry"; referring to the theory that humans descended from ape-like ancestors.</note> might eventually be assigned to the list of "completely unacceptable beliefs" when faced with the "greater knowledge" of Occultists? But what of the savage? Simply "rising to a civilized state" does not explain the evolution of physical form.

In the same letter, titled "The Evolution of Man," Dr. Wilson makes other strange admissions. For instance, he observes in response to questions sent to the journal *Knowledge* by "G. M.":

> "Has evolution caused any change in man? If so, what change? If not, why not?" . . . . If we refuse to admit [as science does] that man was created as a perfect being and then became degraded, there is only one other possibility—that of evolution. If man has risen from a savage to a civilized state, that is surely evolution. *We do not yet know if the human body is subject to the same influences as those of lower animals, because such knowledge is difficult to obtain.* But there is little doubt that the rise from savagery to civilized life means and implies "evolution," and to a considerable extent. Mentally, man’s evolution cannot be doubted; the ever-widening sphere of thought has grown from small and primitive beginnings, just like language itself. But man’s way of life, his power to adapt to his surroundings, and countless other circumstances have made the facts and the path of his "evolution" very difficult to trace.

This very difficulty should make Evolutionists more cautious in their assertions. But why is evolution considered impossible if "man was created as a perfect being and then became degraded"? ## “SPONTANEOUS GENERATION.”

# OCEANS OF CARBONIC ACID?

Could there have been an incipient physical form—that is, a race of beings adapted for that geological period and its surroundings? Besides, Science confesses that it knows nothing of the real length of geological periods.

But the chief question before us is whether it is quite certain that, from the time of what is called the <term>Azoic Age</term> <note>The earliest geological age, then thought to be devoid of life</note>, there ever was such an atmosphere as the one hypothesized by the <term>Naturalists</term>. Not all <term>Physicists</term> agree with this idea. Were the writer anxious to corroborate the teachings of the <term>Secret Doctrine</term> <note>The author's primary source of esoteric wisdom</note> by exact Science, it would be easy to show, by the admission of more than one Physicist, that the atmosphere has changed little, if at all, since the first condensation of the oceans—that is, since the <term>Laurentian Period</term> or the <term>Pyrolithic Age</term> <note>The age of "fire-stone" or igneous rock formation</note>. Such, at any rate, is the opinion of <term>Blanchard</term>, <term>S. Meunier</term>, and even of <term>Bischof</term>—as the experiments of the latter scientist with basalts have shown.

For if we were to take the word of the majority of scientists regarding the quantity of deadly gases, and of elements entirely saturated with carbon and nitrogen, in which the vegetable and animal kingdoms are said to have lived, thrived, and developed, then one would have to come to the curious conclusion that there were, in those days, oceans of *liquid carbonic acid* <note>Carbon dioxide</note> instead of water. In such an environment, it becomes doubtful whether the <term>Ganoids</term> <note>An ancient order of bony-scaled fish</note>, or even the <term>Primitive Trilobites</term> themselves, could live in the oceans of the <term>Primary Age</term>—let alone in those of the <term>Silurian</term> period, as shown by Blanchard.

The conditions that were necessary for the earliest race of mankind, however, required no elements, whether simple or compound. What was stated at the beginning is maintained: the spiritual, ethereal entity which lived in spaces unknown to Earth—before the first sidereal "jelly-speck" evolved in the ocean of crude <term>Cosmic Matter</term>, and billions and trillions of years before our globular speck in infinity called Earth came into being and generated the <term>Monera</term> <note>The simplest form of life hypothesized by Ernst Haeckel</note> in its drops called oceans—needed no "elements." 

The "<term>Manu</term> <note>In Hindu mythology, the progenitor of humanity</note> with soft bones" could well dispense with <term>calcium phosphate</term>, as he had no bones, except in a figurative sense. And while even the Monera, however uniform their organism, still required physical conditions of life to help them toward further evolution, the being which became <term>Primitive Man</term> and the "Father of Man"—after evolving on planes of existence undreamed of by Science—could well remain unaffected by any state of atmospheric conditions around him. This is like the primitive ancestor in <term>Brasseur de Bourbourg</term>’s translation of the *<term>Popol Vuh</term>* <note>The sacred narrative of the Kʼicheʼ Maya people</note> who—in the <term>Mexican legends</term>—could act and live with equal ease underground and...

# THE “BLACK FIRE” OF THE *ZOHAR*.

This Stanza contains within itself the entire key to the mysteries of evil, the so-called "Fall of the Angels," and the many problems that have puzzled the minds of philosophers since the beginning of human memory. It solves the secret of the subsequent inequalities in intellectual capacity, birth, or social position, and gives a logical explanation for the incomprehensible course of Karma <note>The law of cause and effect</note> throughout the ages that followed. The best explanation possible, considering the difficulties of the subject, will now be attempted.

(a) Up to the Fourth Round <note>A "Round" is a cycle of evolutionary development on a planetary chain</note>, and even until the later part of the Third Race in this current Round, "Man" was only an animal intellectually. This is assuming we can even use that misleading name for the ever-changing forms that clothed the Monads <note>The eternal, divine sparks or individual souls</note> during the first three Rounds and the first two and a half Races of the present cycle. It is only in the present *midway Round* that man entirely develops within himself the Fourth Principle <note>Kama, or the emotional/desire nature</note> as a suitable vehicle for the Fifth <note>Manas, or the Mind</note>. However, *Manas* (the Mind) will be relatively *fully* developed only in the following Round, when it will have the opportunity to become entirely divine until the end of the cycles. As Christian Schœttgen says in *Hebrew Hours* <note>original: *Horæ Hebraicæ*</note>, the first terrestrial Adam
> “had only the breath of life”—*Nephesh* <note>The animal soul or vital breath</note>, but not the *living Soul* <note>The higher intellectual or spiritual soul</note>.

(b) Here, the "inferior races" are meant—of which there are still some examples left, such as the Australians (now fast dying out) and some African and Oceanic tribes.
> “They were not ready” means that the Karmic development of these Monads had not yet prepared them to occupy the human forms destined for incarnation in the higher intellectual races. This will be explained further later on.

(c) The *Zohar* <note>A foundational work of Jewish Kabbalah</note> speaks of “Black Fire,” which is Absolute Light—Wisdom. To those who, driven by old theological prejudice, might say: "But the *Asuras* <note>In Hindu mythology, often depicted as demons, but here interpreted as spiritual beings of a different order</note> are the rebel *Devas* <note>Gods or celestial beings</note>, the opponents of the Gods—therefore they are Devils and Spirits of Evil," the answer is: Esoteric Philosophy admits neither good nor evil *in themselves* <note>original: *per se*</note> as existing independently in Nature. The cause for both is found, regarding the Cosmos, in the necessity of contraries or contrasts; and regarding man, in his human nature, his ignorance, and his passions. There are no "Devils" or the utterly depraved, just as there are no "Angels" who are absolutely perfect, though there may be Spirits of Light and of Darkness. Thus, Lucifer—the Spirit of Intellectual Enlightenment and Freedom of Thought—is metaphorically the guiding beacon that helps man find his way through the rocks and sandbanks of Life. For Lucifer is the *Logos* <note>The Divine Word or Reason</note> in his highest aspect, and the “Adversary” in his lowest—both of which...

# PRIMAL MODES OF REPRODUCTION

The Second Race, as stated above, being also sexless, evolved out of itself at its beginning the Third, **Androgyne** <note>original: "Androgyne"; meaning hermaphroditic or possessing both male and female characteristics</note> Race by an analogous, but already more complicated process. As described in the Commentary, the very earliest of that Race were:

<margin>The gradual evolution of man in the *Secret Doctrine* shows that all the later Races (which the uninitiated consider the earliest) have their *physical* origin in the early Fourth Race. However, it is the sub-race that preceded the one that separated into two sexes which must be regarded as the *spiritual* ancestors of our present generations, and especially of the Eastern Aryan Races. The idea held by Weber <note>Albrecht Weber (1825–1901), a German Indologist</note> that the Indo-Germanic Race preceded the Aryan Vedic Race is, to the Occultist, utterly absurd.</margin>

The "Sons of Passive Yoga." They issued from the Second **Manushyas** <note>Sanskrit: human beings or the Human Race</note> and became **oviparous** <note>egg-laying</note>. The emanations that came out of their bodies during the seasons of procreation were ovulary; the small spheroidal nuclei developed into a large, soft, egg-like vehicle, which gradually hardened. Then, after a period of gestation, it broke and the young human animal issued from it unaided, just as birds do in our own Race.

This must seem to the reader ludicrously absurd. Nevertheless, it follows the exact lines of evolutionary analogy which Science perceives in the development of living animal species. First, there is the **moneron**-like <note>referring to the Monera, a kingdom of single-celled organisms without a nucleus</note> procreation by "self-division"; then, after a few stages, the oviparous method, as seen in reptiles followed by birds; then, finally, the mammals with their **ovoviviparous** <note>producing eggs that are hatched within the body</note> modes of producing their young.

If the term "ovoviviparous" is applied to some fish and reptiles that hatch their eggs within their bodies, why should it not be applied to female mammals, including women? The ovule in which the development of the fetus takes place after impregnation is, in fact, an egg. At all events, this conception is more philosophical than the story of Eve—possessing a suddenly created placenta—giving birth to Cain because of the "apple," especially when even the marsupial, the earliest of mammals, does not yet have a placenta.

<margin>Compare especially Schmidt’s *The Doctrine of Descent and Darwinism*, pages 39 and following, and Samuel Laing’s *A Modern Zoroastrian*, pages 102-111.</margin>

### II. *Budding.*

A small portion of the parent structure swells out at the surface and finally separates, growing to the size of the original organism; for example, many vegetables, the sea anemone, etc. (Compare with the Second Root-Race.)<margin>*</margin>

### III. *Spores.*

A single cell cast off by the parent organism, which develops into a multicellular organism reproducing the features of the parent—for example, bacteria and mosses.

### IV. *Intermediate Hermaphroditism.*

Male and female organs existing in the same individual; for example, the majority of plants, worms, and snails; this is related to budding. (Compare with the Second and early Third Root-Races.)

Now we turn to the curious and little-understood corroboration in the *Purânas* concerning the "Sweat-born."

2. Kandu is a sage and a Yogi <term>Yogî: a practitioner of yoga and spiritual disciplines</term>, eminent in holy wisdom and pious self-discipline <term>austerities</term>. His actions finally awaken the jealousy of the Gods, who are represented in the Hindu Scriptures as being in never-ending conflict with the ascetics. Indra, the "King of the Gods,"\* finally sends one of his female Apsarases <term>Apsaras: a celestial nymph or water spirit</term> to tempt the sage. This is no worse than Jehovah sending Sarah, Abraham's wife, to tempt Pharaoh; but in truth, it is these Gods (and God) who are always trying to disturb ascetics and cause them to lose the fruit of their spiritual practices. They ought to be regarded as "tempting demons," rather than applying that term to the Rudras, Kumâras, and Asuras, whose great sanctity and celibacy seem a constant reproach to the womanizing <note>original: "Don Juanic"</note> Gods of the Pantheon. But we find the reverse in all the Puranic allegories, and not without a good hidden <note>original: "esoteric"</note> reason.

The King of the Gods, or Indra, sends a beautiful nymph <note>original: "Apsaras"</note> named Pramlochâ to seduce Kandu and disturb his penance. She succeeds in her unholy purpose, and "nine hundred and seven years, six months, and three days"† spent in her company seem to the sage like a single day. When this psychological or hypnotic state ends, the sage <note>original: "Muni"</note> bitterly curses the creature who has seduced him and disturbed his devotions. The nymph traveled from tree to tree, and as she dried her limbs with the dark shoots that crowned their summits, the child she had conceived by the Sage <note>original: Rishi</note> emerged from the pores of her skin in drops of sweat. The trees received these living dews, and the winds collected them into one mass. “This,” said the Moon <note>original: Soma</note>, “I ripened with my rays; and gradually it increased in size, until the vapor that had rested on the treetops became the lovely girl named Mârishâ.”*

Now, Kandu represents the First Race. He is a son of the Ancestors <note>original: Pitris</note>, and is therefore one “devoid of mind.” This fact is hinted at by his being unable to tell the difference between a period of nearly one thousand years and a single day; therefore, he is shown to be easily deceived and blinded. Here is a variation of the allegory in *Genesis* concerning Adam, who is born as an image of clay into which the “Lord God” breathes the “breath of life,” but not the breath of intellect and judgment <note>original: discrimination</note>. These are developed only after he has tasted the fruit of the Tree of Knowledge. In other words, they develop when he has acquired the first growth of Mind, and has had implanted in him *Manas* <note>the faculty of mind</note>. The earthly aspect of this mind is tied to the world, though its highest faculties connect it with Spirit and the Divine Soul. Pramlochâ is the Hindu Lilith of the Aryan Adam; and Mârishâ, the daughter born from the sweat of her pores, is the “Sweat-born,” and stands as a symbol for the Second Race of mankind.

In the ancient texts <note>original: Purânas</note>, it is not actually Indra who figures in this case, but Kâmadeva, the God of love and desire, who sends Pramlochâ to Earth. Logic, as well as the Secret Teachings <note>original: Esoteric Doctrine</note>, shows that it must be so. For Kâma is the king and lord of the celestial nymphs <note>original: Apsarases</note>, and Pramlochâ is one of them. Therefore, when Kandu curses her and exclaims, “You have performed the task assigned by the monarch of the gods, now go!”—he must mean that monarch is Kâma, and not Indra, whom the nymphs do not serve. For Kâma, again, is described in the *Rig Veda*† as the personification of that feeling which leads and drives toward creation. He was the *First Movement* that stirred the <term>ONE</term>, after its manifestation from the purely Abstract Principle, to begin creating.

Desire first arose in <term>IT</term>, which was the Primal Seed <note>original: Germ</note> of Mind; and which Sages, searching with their intellect, have discovered to be the bond which connects existence <note>original: Entity</note> with non-existence <note>original: Non-Entity</note>.
