A hymn in the *Atharva Veda* exalts <term>Kâma</term> <note>the god of love or desire</note> into a supreme God and Creator, saying:
<term>Kâma</term> was born first. Neither the Gods, nor the Ancestors [<term>Pitris</term>], nor Men have equaled him.

The *Atharva Veda* identifies him with <term>Agni</term> <note>the god of fire</note>, but makes him superior to that God. The *Taittirîya Brâhmana* allegorically describes him as the son of <term>Dharma</term> <note>moral religious duty, piety, and justice</note> and of <term>Shraddhâ</term> <note>faith</note>. Elsewhere, <term>Kâma</term> is said to be born from the heart of <term>Brahmâ</term>; therefore, he is <term>Âtmabhû</term> (“Self-Existent”) and <term>Aja</term> (“the Unborn”). The account of him sending the nymph <term>Pramlochâ</term> carries a deep philosophical meaning; however, the version where she is sent by the god <term>Indra</term> has no such significance. Just as <term>Eros</term> was associated with the creation of the world in early Greek mythology and only later became the sexual <term>Cupid</term>, so was <term>Kâma</term> in his original Vedic character. The *Harivansha* makes him a son of <term>Lakshmî</term>, who is the equivalent of <term>Venus</term>. 

As previously stated, the allegory shows the psychic element developing the physiological element before the birth of <term>Daksha</term>—the *ancestor* of *actual physical men*. <term>Daksha</term> is said to be born from <term>Mârishâ</term>, and before his time, living beings and men were procreated “by will, by sight, by touch, and by <term>yoga</term> <note>spiritual union or discipline</note>,” as will be shown.

This, then, is the allegory regarding the mode of reproduction for the Second Race, or the “Sweat-born.” The same applies to the Third Race in its final development. <term>Mârishâ</term>, through the influence of <term>Soma</term> (the Moon), is taken as a wife by the <term>Prachetases</term>. These characters are also the offspring of the “Mind-born” sons of <term>Brahmâ</term>,* and from them, they father the Patriarch <term>Daksha</term>. The *Purânas* explain and add that <term>Daksha</term> was also a son of <term>Brahmâ</term> in a former <term>Kalpa</term> <note>a vast period of time or life-cycle</note>; they do this to mislead the reader, yet they are still speaking the truth.

3. The early Third Race, therefore, is formed from drops of “Sweat,” which, after many transformations, grow into human bodies. This is no more difficult to imagine or understand than the growth of a fetus.

# “SWEAT-BORN” AND ANDROGYNES.

It is said to have released a formative force <note>original: "*vis formativa*"</note>, which transformed drops of perspiration into larger drops; these grew, expanded, and became ovoid bodies—essentially huge eggs. Within these, the human fetus developed <note>original: "gestated"</note> for several years. 

In the <term>Purânas</term> <note>ancient Hindu texts containing mythology, history, and philosophy</note>, Mârishâ—the daughter of the sage Kandu—becomes the wife of the Prachetases and the mother of Daksha. The meaning of the last sentence in the previously quoted commentary on Verse <note>original: "Shloka"</note> 27—namely, that the Fourth Race were the children of Padmapâni—can be explained by a certain letter from the inspiration behind the book *Esoteric Buddhism*:

> *The majority of humanity belongs to the seventh sub-race of the Fourth Root-Race—the previously mentioned Chinese people and their various descendants and branches (Malays, Mongolians, Tibetans, Hungarians, Finns, and even the Eskimos are all remnants of this final branch).*

Padmapâni or Avalokiteshvara in Sanskrit is known as Chenresi in Tibetan. Avalokiteshvara is the great <term>Logos</term> <note>the divine Word or creative principle</note> in its higher aspect and in the divine realms. However, on the visible planes of existence, he is the spiritual progenitor of humanity, much like Daksha. In hidden <note>original: "esoteric"</note> teachings, Padmapâni-Avalokiteshvara is called the <term>Bodhisattva</term> <note>a being on the path to becoming a Buddha</note> (or <term>Dhyân Chohan</term> <note>a "Lord of Meditation" or celestial being</note>) Chenresi Vanchug, "the powerful and all-seeing." He is currently regarded as the greatest protector of Asia in general, and of Tibet in particular. In order to guide the Tibetans and <term>Lamas</term> <note>spiritual teachers in Tibetan Buddhism</note> toward holiness and to keep the great <term>Arhats</term> <note>enlightened beings who have reached nirvana</note> in the world, this heavenly being is said to manifest in human form throughout the ages. 

A popular legend claims that whenever faith begins to fade from the world, Padmapâni Chenresi (the "Lotus-bearer") shines a brilliant ray of light and immediately incarnates as one of the two great Lamas—the Dalai Lama or the Teschu <note>now known as the Panchen Lama</note> Lama. Finally, it is believed he will incarnate as the "most perfect Buddha" in Tibet rather than in India. In India, his predecessors—the great <term>Rishis</term> <note>ancient sages or seers</note> and <term>Manus</term> <note>the mythological progenitors of mankind</note>—appeared at the start of our Race, but they no longer do so. 

Even the public <note>original: "exoteric"</note> appearance of the celestial <note>original: "Dhyânî"</note> Chenresi hints at the hidden teachings. Like Daksha, he is clearly the synthesis of all previous races and the ancestor of all human races following the Third Race (which was the first complete human race). Thus, he is shown as the peak of the four primeval races through his eleven-faced form. This is depicted as a column built in four rows, with each row having three faces or heads of different complexions; the three faces for each race represent its three fundamental physical transformations. The first row is white (moon-colored); the second is yellow; the third is red-brown. The fourth row has only two faces—the third face being left blank as a reference to the early destruction of the <term>Atlanteans</term> <note>the Fourth Root-Race in theosophical chronology, said to have lived on a lost continent</note>—and is brown-black. ## THE BIRTHDAYS OF THE DHYÂNÎS <note>Dhyânîs: Enlightened celestial beings or "Lords of Meditation" who oversee the evolution of the world.</note>

[He] is seated on the column and forms the summit. In this regard, compare Verse <note>original: "Shloka"</note> 39. The <term>Dhyân Chohan</term> <note>a celestial being or "Lord of Meditation"</note> is represented with four arms, which is another reference to the four human races. While two arms are folded, the third hand holds a lotus—this is <term>Padmapâni</term>, the "Lotus-bearer"; the flower symbolizes the power of creation <note>original: "generation"</note>. The fourth hand holds a serpent, a symbol of the wisdom at his command. Around his neck is a rosary, and on his head is the symbol for water <note>two parallel horizontal zigzag lines</note>, representing matter and the great flood <note>original: "deluge"</note>. On his forehead rests the "third eye," the eye of Shiva, which represents spiritual insight. His name is "Protector" (of Tibet) and "Savior of Humanity." On other occasions, when he is shown with only two arms, he is known as <term>Chenresi</term> the <term>Dhyânî</term>, and the <term>Bodhisattva</term> <note>a being on the path to enlightenment</note> <term>Chakna Padma Karpo</term>, which means "he who holds a white lotus." Another name for him is <term>Chantong</term>, "he of the thousand eyes." In this form, he is gifted with a thousand arms and hands; on the palm of each hand is an eye of Wisdom, with these arms spreading out from his body like a forest of light rays. Another of his names in Sanskrit is <term>Lokapati</term> or <term>Lokanâtha</term>, meaning "Lord of the World"; and in Tibetan, he is called <term>Jigten Gonpo</term>, the "Protector and Savior" against every kind of evil.*

<term>Padmapâni</term>, however, is the "Lotus-bearer" only symbolically for the uninitiated <note>original: "profane"</note>. In the hidden <note>original: "esoteric"</note> teachings, it means the supporter of the <term>Kalpas</term> <note>vast cycles of time or "Great Ages"</note>. The last of these cycles is called <term>Pâdma</term> (the Lotus), and it represents one half of the life of <term>Brahmâ</term> <note>the Hindu creator deity</note>. Although it is actually a minor cycle, it is called <term>Mahâ</term>, meaning "Great," because it encompasses the age in which Brahmâ emerged from a lotus. In theory, these cycles of time are infinite, but in practice, they are divided and subdivided across Space and Time. Each division—down to the smallest—has its own <term>Dhyânî</term> acting as its patron or ruler. In China, <term>Padmapâni</term> (<term>Avalokiteshvara</term>) becomes, in his female aspect, <term>Kwan-yin</term>, "who takes any form she chooses in order to save humanity." 

Knowing the astrological alignment of the constellations during the respective "birthdays" of these <term>Dhyânîs</term>—including <term>Amitabha</term> (known in China as <term>A-mi-to Fo</term>)—gives the student of hidden wisdom <note>original: "Occultist"</note> the greatest ability to perform what are called "magical" feats. For example, these dates include the 19th day of the second month, the 17th day of the eleventh month, and the 7th day of the third month,† etc. Using a magic mirror placed under the light of certain constellations, the future of an individual can be seen, with all coming events arranged in order. But—beware the dark side of this knowledge: **SORCERY**.

### STANZA VIII.
## EVOLUTION OF THE ANIMAL MAMMALS: THE FIRST FALL.
---
->28. How the first mammals were produced. 29. A somewhat <term>Darwinian evolution</term> <note>original: "quasi-Darwinian"</note>. 30. The animals gain solid bodies. 31. Their separation into sexes. 32. The first sin of the mindless men.<-

28. FROM THE DROPS OF SWEAT, FROM THE RESIDUE OF THE SUBSTANCE, MATTER FROM DEAD BODIES OF MEN AND ANIMALS OF THE PREVIOUS CYCLE <note>original: "Wheel before"; referring to the previous Third Round</note>, AND FROM CAST-OFF DUST, THE FIRST ANIMALS <note>Specifically, the animals of this Fourth Round.</note> WERE PRODUCED.

The <term>Occult Doctrine</term> maintains that, in this <term>Round</term> <note>Round: a full cycle of evolutionary development on a chain of worlds</note>, mammals were a later work of <term>evolution</term> than humans. <term>Evolution</term> proceeds in <term>Cycles</term>. The great <term>Manvantaric Cycle</term> <note>Manvantara: a vast period of cosmic manifestation</note> of <term>Seven Rounds</term> begins in the <term>First Round</term> with the mineral, vegetable, and animal kingdoms. It brings its evolutionary work on the descending arc to a complete stop in the middle of the <term>Fourth Race</term>, at the close of the first half of the <term>Fourth Round</term>. 

It is on our <term>Earth</term>, then—the <term>Fourth Sphere</term> and the lowest point—and in the present <term>Round</term>, that this middle point has been reached. The <term>Monad</term> <note>Monad: the eternal, spiritual part of a being that reincarnates</note> has passed through the mineral, vegetable, and animal worlds in every degree of the three states of matter. This began with its first “<term>immetallization</term>” <note>the process of the spirit or Monad entering the mineral state</note> on <term>Globe A</term>. However, it did not reach the last degree of the third or solid state until the “mid-point of evolution.” 

Therefore, it is logical and natural that at the beginning of the <term>Fourth Round</term> on <term>Globe D</term> <note>Globe D: the physical Earth in the planetary chain</note>, <term>Man</term> should be the first to appear. It is also natural that his frame should be made of the most refined <note>original: "tenuous"</note> matter that is still capable of being physical <note>original: "compatible with objectivity"</note>. To make it even clearer: if the <term>Monad</term> begins its <term>cycle of incarnations</term> through the three physical kingdoms on the descending curved line, it must necessarily enter the reascending curved line of the <term>Sphere</term> as a human as well. 

On the descending arc, the spiritual gradually transforms into the material. On the middle line at the base, <term>Spirit</term> and <term>Matter</term> are balanced <note>original: "equilibrized"</note> in <term>Man</term>. On the ascending arc, <term>Spirit</term> is slowly reclaiming its place at the expense of the physical, or <term>Matter</term>. Because of this, at the close of the <term>Seventh Race</term> of the <term>Seventh Round</term>, the <term>Monad</term> will find itself completely free from <term>Matter</term> and all its limitations.

### WHAT MAY BE THE OBJECTIONS TO THE FOREGOING.

Our teachings show that, while it is quite correct to say that Nature had, at one time, built around the human <term>astral form</term> <note>the subtle, energetic body that precedes the physical body</note> an ape-like *external shape*, it is also just as correct that this shape was no more the "missing link" than were the many other coverings of that astral form during the course of its natural evolution through all the kingdoms of Nature. Nor was it, as has been shown, on this <term>Fourth Round</term> <note>the current major cycle of life on Earth</note> Planet that such evolution took place, but only during the First, Second, and Third Rounds, when Man was, in turn, "a stone, a plant, and an animal" until he became what he was in the First Root-Race of present Humanity. The real line of evolution differs from the Darwinian theory, and the two systems are irreconcilable unless the latter is separated from the dogmas of "natural selection" and similar ideas.

This explains some of the supposed physical proofs brought forward by anthropologists to try to demonstrate that humans descended from animals.

The point emphasized most by evolutionists is that, "The history of the embryo is a summary <note>original: "epitome"</note> of the history of the species." They argue that:

> Every organism, as it develops from the egg, passes through a series of forms that its ancestors also passed through in the same order during the long course of Earth's history.* The history of the embryo . . . . . is a miniature picture and outline of the history of the species. *This concept is the core of our fundamental biogenetic law <note>the theory that an individual's development repeats the evolutionary history of its species</note>, which we must place at the forefront of the study of the fundamental law of organic development.†*

This modern theory was known as a fact to the ancient Sages and Occultists—and expressed much more philosophically by them—from the earliest times...

What is the primitive shape of the future human? A grain or a corpuscle, say some physiologists; a molecule or an "egg of the egg," say others. The stone has now changed, through "metempsychosis," into a plant.

The eyes are visible as two black dots; the ears, nose, and mouth form indentations, like the points of a pineapple, before they begin to project. The embryo develops into an animal-like fetus—the shape of a tadpole—and, like an amphibious reptile, lives in and develops from water.

### EDENS, SERPENTS, AND DRAGONS.

Where did the idea and the true meaning of the term "Eden" come from? Christians will maintain that the Garden of Eden is the holy Paradise, the place desecrated by the *sin* of Adam and Eve. The Occultist, however, will deny this "dead-letter" <note>An interpretation that focuses only on the literal, surface meaning of words, ignoring their deeper symbolic spirit</note> interpretation and demonstrate the opposite. > The Garden of Eden as a specific location is not a myth at all; it belongs to those landmarks of history which occasionally reveal to the student that the *Bible* is not entirely composed of mere allegory. "Eden, or the Hebrew Garden of Eden <note>original: גַן־עֵדֶן, Gan-Eden</note>, meaning the Park or the Garden of Eden, is an ancient name for the country watered by the Euphrates and its many branches, stretching from Asia and Armenia to the Erythraean Sea <note>The ancient name for the body of water including the Red Sea and the Persian Gulf</note>."* In the Chaldean *Book of Numbers*, its location is designated using numerals, and it is fully described in the secret Rosicrucian manuscript left by the Count St. Germain. # FLYING CAMELS.

...the ancient nature of the symbolism is obvious on its face, showing that it was not a Jewish idea but a universal one.

In the *Zohar* <note>a foundational work of Jewish mysticism</note>, we find a very strange assertion—one likely to provoke the reader to laughter because of its apparent absurdity. It claims that the serpent used by Samael <note>original: "Shamaël"</note>, the figure identified as Satan, to seduce Eve was a kind of “flying camel”—*camel-shaped* <note>original Greek: καμηλόμορφον, *kamelomorphon*</note>.*

A “flying camel” is indeed too much to believe even for the most open-minded Fellow of the Royal Society <note>F.R.S.</note>. Nevertheless, the *Zohar*—which can hardly be expected to use the language of a modern scientist like Cuvier—was correct in its description. We find it called “Aschmogh” in the old Zoroastrian manuscripts; in the *Avesta* <note>sacred Zoroastrian texts</note>, this creature is described as having lost its nature and name after the Fall, and is depicted as a huge serpent with a camel’s neck.

Salverte <note>Eusèbe Salverte, a French writer on the "occult sciences"</note> asserts that:

> There are no winged serpents or true dragons. . . . Grasshoppers are still called "winged serpents" by the Greeks, and this metaphor may have created several stories about the existence of winged serpents.†

There are none *now*; but there is no reason why they could not have existed during the Mesozoic Age. Cuvier, who reconstructed their skeletons, serves as a witness to these “flying camels.” After finding simple fossils of certain saurians, the great naturalist wrote:

> If anything can justify the legends of hydras and other monsters, whose images were so often repeated by medieval historians, it is undeniably the Plesiosaurus.‡

We do not know if Cuvier added anything further by way of an apology <note>original Latin: *mea culpa*, "my fault"</note>, but we can well imagine his embarrassment for having dismissed ancient truthfulness as slander, once he encountered a *flying* saurian: the Pterodactyl. Found in Germany, it was described as being seventy-eight feet long <note>Early paleontological reports sometimes contained dramatic size estimates; modern science places the largest pterosaur wingspans at about 33–36 feet</note> and possessed powerful wings attached to its reptilian body. This fossil is described as a reptile whose "fingers" are so elongated that they support a long, skin-like <note>original: "membranous"</note> wing. Here, then, the “flying camel” of the *Zohar* is proven right. Certainly, between the long neck of the Plesiosaurus and the skin-like wings of the Pterodactyl—or better yet, the Mosasaurus—there is enough scientific probability to support the idea of a “flying camel” or a long-necked dragon. ### HAS SATAN ANY REALITY?

Those who understand these mysteries know that symbols have a seven-fold <note>original: "septenary"</note> meaning. For example, the Sun was the astronomical and cosmic emblem of the two contrasting Lights and the two Serpents of the Gnostics <note>Gnostics: Early mystical groups who believed in a hidden, direct knowledge of the divine and often viewed the material world as being created by a lesser deity</note>—representing good and evil. They also know that when their conclusions are generalized, both *Science* and *Theology* reach two ridiculous extremes. 

On one hand, Science tells us that we only need to trace serpent legends back to their original astronomical source to understand them. It suggests that if we seriously study the Sun (the conqueror of the serpent Python) and the celestial Virgin in the Zodiac forcing back the devouring Dragon, we will have the key to all subsequent religious dogmas. It is easy to see that instead of looking at the big picture, the author of this view is focusing strictly on the Christian religion and its *Revelation*. We call this one extreme. 

We see the other extreme when *Theology*, repeating the famous decision of the Council of Trent <note>Council of Trent: A series of 16th-century meetings that defined the official doctrines of the Catholic Church</note>, seeks to convince the public that:

> From the fall of man until the hour of his baptism, the Devil has full power over him, and possesses him by right—"the devil has dominion and power over men and possesses them by right." <note>original: *diabolum dominium et potestatem super homines habere et jure eos possidere.*</note> *

To this, Occult Philosophy answers: First, prove the existence of the Devil as an actual *entity*, and only then might we believe in such a possession from birth. Even a small amount of observation and knowledge of human nature is enough to prove that this theological dogma is false. If Satan had any reality in the objective world—or even the subjective world (in the church's sense)—it is the poor Devil who would find himself chronically harassed and even possessed by wicked people, and thus by the majority of mankind. It is humanity itself, and especially the clergy—led by the arrogant, unscrupulous, and intolerant Roman Church—which has created, given birth to, and lovingly raised the "Evil One." But this is a digression.

The Church reproaches the entire world of thought for having adored the serpent.

In reality, all of humanity either burned incense to the serpent or threw stones at it. The *Zends* <note>Zends: Referring to the Zend-Avesta, the sacred texts of Zoroastrianism</note> speak of it, as do the *Kings* <note>Kings: Referring to the Chinese "Classic" texts or *Jing*</note> and the *Vedas* <note>Vedas: The oldest sacred scriptures of Hinduism</note>, the *Edda* <note>Edda: Ancient Norse mythological poems</note>, and the *Bible*. Everywhere, the sacred serpent (the Nâga <note>Nâga: A Sanskrit word for a serpent deity or a symbol of high wisdom</note>) has its shrine and its priest. In Rome, it was the Vestal Virgin who prepared the serpent's meal with the same care she gave to the sacred fire. In Greece, Æsculapius <note>Æsculapius: The Greek god of medicine and healing</note> could not cure anyone without the serpent's assistance and even delegated his powers to it. Yes, the author is right. If one wants to have a complete idea of the prestige the serpent enjoys even to this day, he ought to study the matter in India and learn everything that is believed about and still attributed to the Nâgas (cobras) in that country. One should also visit the Africans of Whydah, the Voodoos of Port-au-Prince and Jamaica, the Nagals of Mexico, and the Pâ, or Men-serpents of China, and so on. But why wonder that the serpent is "adored" and at the same time cursed, since we know that from the beginning it was a symbol? In every ancient language, the word *dragon* signified what it still does in Chinese: *long*, or "the being who excels in intelligence," and in Greek, *drakōn* <note>original: δράκων</note>, or "he who sees and watches."† Can any of these descriptions apply to the actual animal of this name? Is it not evident—regardless of where superstition and the forgetting of the original meaning may have led modern-day savages—that the above qualities were intended to apply to the human originals who were symbolized by Serpents and Dragons? These originals—called to this day in China the "Dragons of Wisdom"—were the first disciples of the Dhyânîs <note>Dhyânîs: Celestial or enlightened beings; in this context, the spiritual instructors of early humanity</note>, who were their teachers. In short, they were the Primitive Adepts <note>Adepts: Highly advanced individuals who have attained mastery over spiritual and natural laws</note> of the Third Race, and later, of the Fourth and Fifth Races. The name became universal, and no sane person before the Christian era would ever have confused the man with the symbol.

But as to the *Nagals* and *Nargals*; whence came the similarity of names between the Indian *Nagas* <note>original: "Nâgas"; semi-divine serpent beings in Hindu mythology</note> and the American *Nagals*?

The *Nargal* was the Chaldean and Assyrian chief of the Wise Men <note>original: "Magi [Rab-Mag]"</note>, and the *Nagal* was the chief sorcerer of the Mexican Indians. Both derive their names from *Nergal-Serezer*, the Assyrian god, and the Hindu *Nagas*. Both have the same faculties and the power to have an attendant spirit <note>original: "Dæmon"</note>, with whom they identify themselves completely. The Chaldean and Assyrian *Nargal* kept his spirit, in the shape of some animal considered sacred, inside the temple; the Indian *Nagal* keeps his wherever he can—in the neighboring lake, or wood, or in the house, in the shape of some household animal.*

Such similarity cannot be attributed to *coincidence*. A new world is discovered, and we find that, for our forefathers of the Fourth Race <note>The Atlanteans, according to the author's system of human evolution</note>, it was already an old one; it is said that Arjuna, the companion and disciple <note>original: "Chelâ"</note> of Krishna, descended into the underworld <note>original: "Pâtâla"; here interpreted as the "antipodes" or the other side of the world</note> and there married Ulupi†, a *Naga*—or rather a *Nagi*—the daughter of the king of the *Nagas*, Kauravya.‡

If there were only light, inactive and absolute, the human mind could not appreciate or even realize it. Shadow is what allows light to reveal itself and gives it objective reality. Therefore, shadow is not evil; it is the necessary and indispensable counterpart that completes light or goodness. It is its *creator on Earth*.

According to the views of the Gnostics <note>A diverse group of early religious thinkers who sought "gnosis" or secret spiritual knowledge</note>, these two principles are unchangeable light and shadow. Good and evil are essentially one and have existed through all eternity, just as they will continue to exist as long as there are physical worlds.

This symbolism explains why this sect worshipped the serpent as the Savior. It was depicted either coiled around the holy bread or a Tau <note>original: "Tau (the phallic emblem)"; a T-shaped cross symbolizing life and generation</note>. When they are separated, one represents the Tree of Spiritual Life and the other the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil. This is why we find the Serpent <note>original: "Ophis"</note> urging the first human couple—who were the material creation of the demiurge Ialdabaoth <note>original: "Ilda-baoth"; the Gnostic name for the creator of the physical world</note> but owed their spiritual essence to Higher Wisdom <note>original: "Sophia-Achamoth"</note>—to eat the forbidden fruit, even though the serpent represents divine wisdom.

The serpent, the Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil, and the Tree of Life are all symbols taken from the traditions of India. The sacred fig tree <note>original: "Arasa-maram"; likely the Peepal or Banyan tree</note>, which is so holy to the Hindus—since the god Vishnu, during one of his incarnations, rested under its massive shade and taught human philosophy and science—is called both the Tree of Knowledge and the Tree of Life. Under the protective leaves of this "king of the forests," teachers <note>original: "Gurus"</note> give their students their first lessons on immortality and initiate them into the mysteries of life and death. In Chaldean tradition, the Lord-Gods <note>original: "Java-Aleim"</note> of the Priestly College are said to have taught the sons of men to become like them. To this day, the Lord of Buddha*—who lives in his Buddha-Temple <note>original: "Foh-Maëyu"</note> on the summit of the Great Mountain†—performs his greatest religious miracles under a tree called in Chinese *Sung-Ming-Shŭ*, or the Tree of Knowledge and the Tree of Life. This is because ignorance is death, and knowledge alone provides immortality. This marvelous event occurs every three years, when a massive crowd of Chinese Buddhist pilgrims gathers at the holy site.‡

Now we can understand why the earliest initiates and masters <note>original: "Adepts"</note>—the "Wise Men" who claimed to be instructed in the mysteries of nature by the Universal Mind (represented by the highest angels)—were called "Serpents of Wisdom" and "Dragons." According to the *Kabbalah* <note>a school of Jewish mysticism</note>, the *curse on humanity began with the creation of woman.*† The circle was separated from its diameter line.

<header>THE SECRET DOCTRINE.</header>

It would have indeed been a bold step for anyone, some thirty years ago, to have thought of presenting the public with a collection of stories usually considered fables, and claiming they were genuine realities. It would have been just as bold to advocate for tales, long honored as fictions, as being actual facts—and to claim those from the nursery were, in many instances, legends (more or less distorted) describing real beings or events. Nowadays, it is a less hazardous proceeding.*

Thus opens the introduction to a recent (1886) and most interesting work by Mr. Charles Gould, called *Mythical Monsters*. He boldly states his belief in most of these monsters. He suggests that:

> Many of the so-called mythical animals which, throughout long ages and in all nations, have been the fertile subjects of fiction and fable, fall legitimately within the scope of plain, matter-of-fact Natural History. They may be considered not as the outcome of an overactive fancy, but as creatures which actually once existed. Unfortunately, only imperfect and inaccurate descriptions of them have filtered down to us—probably very distorted <note>original: "refracted"</note> through the mists of time; . . . *traditions of creatures once coexisting with man, some of which are so strange and terrible as to appear at first sight to be impossible.* . . .
>
> For me, the majority of those creatures are not imaginary monsters <note>original: "chimeras"</note> but objects of rational study. The dragon, instead of being a creature invented by the imagination of early humans <note>original: "Âryan man"; referring here to the prehistoric ancestors of Indo-European peoples</note> while contemplating lightning flashing through the caverns where they lived—as is held by some mythologists—is an animal which once lived, dragged its heavy <note>original: "ponderous"</note> coils, and perhaps even flew. . . .
>
> To me, the actual existence of the unicorn seems not incredible; in fact, it is more probable than the theory which attributes its origin to a lunar myth.† . . .
>
> For my part, I doubt the general idea that myths are derived from “observing the visible workings of external nature.” It seems to me easier to suppose that the weakening effect <note>original: "palsy"</note> of time has muffled the telling of these oft-told tales until their original appearance is almost unrecognizable, rather than believing that uncultured "savages" <note>This term was commonly used in the 19th century to describe prehistoric or indigenous peoples</note> should *possess powers of imagination and poetic invention far beyond those enjoyed by the most educated nations of the present day*. It is less hard to believe that these wonderful stories of gods and demigods, of giants and dwarfs, of dragons and monsters of all descriptions are *transformations* of the truth than to believe them to be *inventions*.‡

It is shown by the same geologist that:

> Paleontologists have successfully traced back the existence of humans to periods variously estimated at from *thirty thousand to one million years*—to periods when they lived alongside <note>original: "coëxisted with"</note> animals which have long since become extinct.§

These animals, “weird and terrible,” were, to give a few instances: (1) The genus *Cidastes*, whose huge bones and vertebrae show them to have reached a length of nearly two hundred feet. The remains of—

->## THE "SONS OF GOD" AND THE "SACRED ISLAND."<-

The "legend" given in *Isis Unveiled*‡ in relation to a portion of the globe which Science now concedes to have been the cradle of humanity—though it was but one of the *seven* cradles, in truth—runs as follows:

Tradition says, and the records of the *Great Book* (the *Book of Dzyan*) explain, that long before the days of Adam <note>original: "Ad-am"</note>, and his inquisitive wife, Eve <note>original: "He-va"</note>, in the region where only salt lakes and desolate, barren deserts are found today, there was a vast inland sea. This sea extended over Middle Asia, north of the proud Himalayan range and its western extensions. In it was an island which, for its unparalleled beauty, had no rival in the world; it was inhabited by the last remnant of the Race which preceded ours.

"The last remnant" means the "Sons of Will and Yoga," who, with a few tribes, survived the great cataclysm. For it was the Third Race, inhabiting the great Lemurian Continent, which preceded the true and complete human Races—the Fourth and the Fifth. Therefore it was said in *Isis Unveiled* that:

> This race could live with equal ease in water, air, or fire, for it had an unlimited control over the elements. These were the "Sons of God"; not those who saw the daughters of men <note>A reference to the biblical Nephilim in Genesis 6</note>, but the real Elohim <note>original Hebrew: "divine beings" or "gods"</note>, though in the oriental Kabbalah <note>original: "Kabalah"</note> they have another name. It was they who shared Nature's most mysterious secrets with humans, and revealed to them the ineffable <note>Too great or extreme to be expressed or described in words</note>, and now lost "word."

The "Island," according to belief, exists to the present hour as an oasis surrounded by the dreadful wildernesses of the great Gobi Desert—whose sands "no foot has crossed <note>original: "hath crossed"</note> in the memory of man."

This "word," which is no ordinary word, has traveled once around the globe and still lingers as a far-off, dying echo in the hearts of some privileged men. The high priests <note>original: "hierophants"</note> of all the Priestly Colleges <note>original: "Sacerdotal Colleges"</note> were aware of the existence of this island. However, the "word" was known only to the Java Aleim <note>a title for a high-ranking initiate or priest</note> (known as the Mahâ Chohan in another tongue), the chief Lord of every College, and was passed to his successor only at the moment of death. There were many such Colleges, and ancient classical authors speak of them.

There was no communication with the fair island by sea, but subterranean passages, known only to the chiefs, communicated with it from all directions.*

Tradition asserts—and Archaeology accepts the truth of this legend—that there is more than one city now flourishing in India which is built on several other cities, creating a subterranean city six or seven stories high. Delhi is one of them, and Allahabad is another. Examples are found even in Europe; for instance <note>original: "e.g."</note>, Florence is built on several defunct Etruscan and other cities. 

Why, then, could not Ellora, Elephanta, Karli, and Ajunta have been built over subterranean labyrinths and passages, as is claimed? Of course, we do not refer to the caves that are known to every European—whether from personal observation <note>original: "de visu"</note> or by hearsay—despite their enormous antiquity, though even that is disputed by modern Archaeology. Instead, we refer to a fact known to the initiated Brahmans of India and especially to Yogis: namely <note>original: "viz."</note>, that there is not a cave-temple in the country that does not have subterranean passages running in every direction, and that these underground caves and endless corridors have, in their turn, *their own* caves and corridors.

Who can tell whether the lost Atlantis—which is also mentioned in the *Secret Book*, but again under another name peculiar to the sacred language—did not still exist in those days? We went on to ask this question. It did exist most assuredly, for it was approaching its greatest days of glory and civilization when the last of the Lemurian continents went down.

The great lost Continent might have, perhaps, been situated south of Asia, extending from India to Tasmania.†

And if the existence of Atlantis—which is positively denied by some learned authors who regard it as a joke by Plato—is ever verified, then perhaps scientists will believe that the description of the continent inhabited by gods was not entirely a fable.* They may then realize that Plato's cautious hints, and his decision to credit the story to Solon and the Egyptian priests, were simply a careful way of sharing the facts with the world. By skillfully mixing truth and fiction, he was able to distance himself from a story that the oaths of secrecy imposed during his Initiation forbade him from revealing.

To continue the tradition, we must add that the class of high priests <term>hierophants: high-ranking priests or interpreters of sacred mysteries</term> was divided into two distinct categories.† The first group was taught by the "Sons of God" on the island and was initiated into the divine doctrine of pure revelation. The second group lived on the lost continent of Atlantis—if that is what it must be called. These people belonged to a different race—born through sexual reproduction but from divine parents—and were born with a "sight" that could see all hidden things, unaffected by distance or physical barriers. In short, they were the Fourth Race of men mentioned in the *Popol Vuh* <note>the sacred "Book of the People" of the K'iche' Maya</note>, whose vision was limitless and who understood everything instantly.

In other words, they were the Lemuro-Atlanteans, the first people to have a dynasty of Spirit-Kings. These were not "Manes" or ghosts, as some believe,‡ but actual living deities <note>original: "Devas"</note>, demi-gods, or angels who took on physical bodies to rule over this race and, in turn, taught them the arts and sciences. However, since these spiritual beings <note>original: "Dhyânis"</note> possessed material forms <note>original: "Rûpa"</note>, they were not always good. Their king, Thevetat, was one of the latter, and it was under the evil influence of this demon-king that the Atlantean race became a nation of wicked "magicians."

As a result, war was declared. The full story is too long to tell here, but its core can be found in the distorted symbolic stories <note>original: "allegories"</note> of the descendants of Cain, the giants, and the story of Noah and his virtuous family. The conflict ended with the sinking <note>original: "submersion"</note> of Atlantis, which is mirrored in the Babylonian and biblical <note>original: "Mosaic"</note> flood stories. The giants, magicians, "and all living things died... and every man." The only survivors were Xisuthrus <note>the hero of the Babylonian flood myth</note> and Noah. These figures are essentially the same as the "Great Father" of the Tlingit people <note>original: "Thlinkithians"</note> who, according to legend, also escaped in a large boat, much like the Hindu Noah, Vaivasvata.

If we are to believe the tradition at all, we must also accept the story that a mixed race of both good and evil people arose from the intermarriage between the descendants of the island's high priests and the descendants of the Atlantean Noah. From one side, the world gained its figures like Enoch, Moses, various Buddhas, numerous "Saviors," and great high priests. On the other side, it produced "natural magicians" who, lacking the discipline of true spiritual enlightenment, perverted their gifts for evil purposes.

# THE TESTIMONY OF JACOLLIOT.

We may support this with the testimony of various records and traditions. In *The History of the Virgins: Vanished Peoples and Continents* <note>original: "L'Histoire des Vierges: les Peuples et les Continents Disparus"</note>, Louis Jacolliot says:

> One of the most ancient legends of India, preserved in the temples through oral and written tradition, relates that several hundred thousand years ago, an immense continent existed in the Pacific Ocean. This continent was destroyed by geological upheaval, and its fragments must now be sought in Madagascar, Ceylon <note>now Sri Lanka</note>, Sumatra, Java, Borneo, and the major islands of Polynesia.
>
> According to this hypothesis, the high plateaus of Hindustan <note>India</note> and Asia would only have been represented in those distant eras by great islands neighboring the central continent. . . . According to the Brahmins <note>original: "Brâhmans"</note>, this country had attained a high level of civilization. The peninsula of Hindustan—enlarged by the displacement of the waters at the time of the great cataclysm—has merely continued the lineage of the original traditions born in this place. These traditions give the name of Rutas to the peoples who inhabited this immense equatorial <note>original: "equinoctial"</note> continent, and the *Sanskrit* language was derived from their speech. The Indo-Hellenic tradition, preserved by the highly intelligent population that migrated from the plains of India, also recounts the existence of a continent and a people to which it gives the name of Atlantis and the Atlanteans <note>original: "Atlantides"</note>, and which it locates in the Atlantic in the northern portion of the Tropics. Apart from this fact, the idea of an ancient continent in those latitudes—the remains of which may be found in the volcanic islands and mountainous surfaces of the Azores, the Canaries, and the Cape Verde <note>original: "Cape de Verd"</note> Islands—is not devoid of geographical probability. The Greeks, who, moreover, never dared to pass beyond the <term>Pillars of Hercules: the Strait of Gibraltar</term> due to their fear of the mysterious Ocean, appeared too late in antiquity for the stories preserved by Plato to be anything more than an echo of the Indian legend. Moreover, when we look at a <term>planisphere: a map of the world or the celestial sphere</term> and see the islands and islets scattered from the Malay Archipelago to Polynesia, and from the Straits of Sunda to Easter Island, it is impossible—if we assume that other continents preceded those which we inhabit—not to place the most important of all there.

-># THE COLOSSI OF BAMIAN.<-

All of them were descendants of the Gods through the Rishis <term>Rishis: Ancient sages or "seers" who received the divine wisdom of the Vedas</term>, and thus, like "Titan and his massive offspring," they were all "Heaven's first-born."

They might belong to the same race—but the former are "Sons of Gods," while the latter are the offspring of powerful sorcerers. However, all of these are reincarnations, and despite the inevitable exaggerations of popular legend and tradition, they are *historical characters.*† 

When did they live? How long ago did the two Races, the Third and Fourth, exist? And how long after that did the various tribes of the Fifth Race begin their conflict—the wars between Good and Evil? We are assured by the Orientalists <note>original: "Orientalists" — 19th-century Western scholars who studied the languages and cultures of Asia</note> that chronology is both hopelessly confused and absurdly exaggerated in the *Puranas* <note>ancient Indian texts containing mythology and history</note> and other Hindu scriptures. 

We are quite ready to agree with this accusation. However, if Aryan writers have occasionally let their chronological pendulum swing too far in one direction beyond the facts, the deviation of modern Western scholars in the opposite direction is even greater. In comparison, moderation will be found on the Brahmanical side. In the long run, the Pandit <term>Pandit: a traditional Hindu scholar or teacher</term> will be found to be more truthful and closer to the facts than the Western Sanskrit scholar. The way the Sanskrit scholar shortens timelines—even when it is proven they did so just to fit a personal theory—is viewed by Western public opinion as a "cautious acceptance of facts." Meanwhile, the Pandit is brutally labeled a "*liar*" in print. 

But, surely, this is no reason why everyone should be forced to see things in the same light! An impartial observer might judge the situation differently. It is the ghost of ancient *Chaldea* <note>original: "Chaldæa" — an ancient region in southern Mesopotamia</note> that is coming to the rescue of the truth. In his third Hibbert Lecture (1887), Professor Sayce of Oxford spoke about newly discovered Assyrian and *Babylonian* cylinders. He referred at length to *Ea*, the God of Wisdom, who is now identified with the Oannes of Berosus—the half-man, half-fish being who taught the Babylonians culture and the art of *writing*. The city of *Eridu* stood 6,000 years ago on the shores of the Persian Gulf. The name means "the good city," a particularly holy spot, since it was the center from which the earliest Chaldean civilization moved north. As the god of culture was depicted as coming from the sea, it is possible that the culture centered at *Eridu* was imported from abroad. We now know that there was communication at a very early period between Chaldea, the Sinai Peninsula, and India. The statues discovered by the French at Tel-loh (dating from at least 4,000 BCE) were made of an extremely hard stone known as diorite. The inscriptions on them state that the diorite was brought from *Magan*—that is, the Sinai Peninsula, which was then ruled by the Pharaohs. These statues are known to resemble the general style of the diorite statue of Khafre <note>original: "Kephren"</note>, the builder of the second Pyramid. Furthermore, according to the archaeologist Flinders Petrie, the unit of measurement marked on the city plan held by one of the Tel-loh figures is the same as that used by the Pyramid builders.

This host was too pure to create the inferior worlds or the humans of our globe directly, but it nevertheless *fell* into Matter through that same process of evolution, acting as the "Second Logos" <note>The "Word" or the second aspect of a divine trinity</note> of the "Father."

In a unified sense, every Creative Logos—or "the Son who is one with the Father"—is the Host of the "Rulers of the World" <note>original: "Rectores Mundi"</note> itself. Even Christian Theology views the seven "Angels of the Presence" as the Virtues, or the personified attributes of God. These attributes, being created by Him just as the *Manus* <note>In Hindu mythology, the semi-divine progenitors of humanity</note> were created by Brahma, became Archangels. Roman Catholic theology itself recognizes Christ as the identity behind these angels by calling its creative "Primary Word" <note>original: "Verbum Princeps"</note> the "Head of the Angels" <note>original: "caput angelorum"</note> and the "Angel of the Great Counsel" <note>original: "magni consilii angelus"</note>.

"The *Sura* became *A-Sura*"—the Gods became No-Gods—says the text; that is, if read literally, the Gods became demons—Satan. However, the teachings of the Secret Doctrine will now show that Satan is allegorized as Good and Sacrifice—a God of Wisdom known by different names.

The *Kabbalah* <note>original: "Kabalah"; a school of Jewish mysticism</note> teaches that pride and presumption—the two main drivers of selfishness and ego—are the causes that emptied Heaven of *one-third* of its divine inhabitants, mystically, and of *one-third* of the stars, astronomically. In other words, the first statement is an allegory, while the second is a scientific fact. Nevertheless, the former is intimately connected with humanity, as has been shown.

# "PRINCIPLES" EXPLAINED.

Group Three, the Equatorial Sun, joins the <term>Buddhi</term> <note>the spiritual soul or faculty of intuition</note> to the *Atma* and the higher attributes of <term>Manas</term> <note>the mind or intellect</note>. Meanwhile, Group Four, the Spirit of our visible Sun, provides man with his *Manas* and its vehicle, the <term>Kama Rupa</term> <note>original: "Kâma Rûpa"; literally "desire-form," the seat of animal passions and impulses</note>. Finally, it is the Spirit of the Earth, in its triple unity, that builds the physical body, attracting to it the Spirits of Life and forming his <term>Linga Sharira</term> <note>original: "Linga Sharîra"; the "design body" or astral double that serves as a model for the physical form</note>.

But everything proceeds in cycles, including the evolution of man. The order in which he is generated is described fully in the Eastern Teachings, whereas the Kabbalah only hints at it. > *First, the Breath, then Buddhi, and the Shadow-Son [the Body] were "created." But where was the Pivot [the Middle Principle, Manas]? Man is doomed. # MAN, THE PALE SHADOW OF GOD.

Again:
> The Heavenly Form [<term>Dhyân Chohan</term> <note>original: Dhyân Chohan; a celestial lord or "Lord of Meditation"</note>] creates man in his own form; it is a spiritual concept resulting from the first division and awakening of the universal, manifested Substance. That form is the ideal Shadow of Itself; and this is the Man of the First Race.

To express it in even clearer terms, limiting the explanation to this Earth only: it was the duty of the first "differentiated" Egos—whom the Church calls Archangels—to fill Primordial Matter with the impulse of evolution and to guide its shaping powers in the creation of its products. This is what is referred to in both Eastern and Western traditions when they say "the Angels were *commanded to create*." After the Earth had been prepared by the lower and more material Powers, and its three Kingdoms <note>The mineral, vegetable, and animal kingdoms</note> had successfully started on their way to "be fruitful and multiply," the higher Powers—the Archangels or <term>Dhyânîs</term> <note>celestial beings</note>—were compelled by the Law of Evolution to descend to Earth to build the crowning achievement of its evolution: Man. Thus, the "Self-created" and the "Self-existent" projected their own pale Shadows; but the Third Group, the Fire-Angels, *rebelled and refused to join their fellow <term>Devas</term>* <note>original: Devas; divine beings or deities</note>.

Public Hindu teachings (<term>exotericism</term>) represent all of them as <term>Yogins</term> <note>original: Yogins; ascetic spiritual practitioners</note>, whose piety inspired them to refuse to "create," as they desired to remain eternally <term>Kumâras</term> ("Virgin Youths") in order to potentially reach <term>Nirvâna</term> <note>final liberation from the cycle of rebirth</note> ahead of their peers. However, according to the hidden (<term>esoteric</term>) interpretation, this was an act of self-sacrifice for the benefit of mankind. These "Rebels" would not create mindless, irresponsible men, as the "obedient" Angels did; nor could they grant human beings even the temporary reflections of their own qualities. Because those qualities belonged to a much higher level of consciousness, they would leave man still irresponsible, and therefore block any possibility of higher progress. 

No spiritual or psychological evolution is possible on Earth—the lowest and most physical level—for a being who is inherently perfect on that level and cannot gain merit or experience failure. If Man had remained only the pale Shadow of inert, unchanging, and motionless Perfection—the single negative and passive quality of the real *I am that I am*—he would have been doomed to pass through life on Earth as if in a heavy, dreamless sleep; he would have been a failure on this physical level. It was the Beings, or the collective Being, called the <term>Elohim</term> <note>a Hebrew name for divine beings, often translated as "God"</note>, who first spoke (if they were ever spoken at all) those harsh words: "Behold, the man has become as one of us, to..."

# THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

"...know good and evil; and now, so that he might not reach out his hand and also take from the tree of life, and eat, and live forever . . . ." —this must have indeed been <term>Ildabaoth</term> <note>In Gnostic tradition, an inferior and often arrogant creator god.</note>, the <term>Demiurge</term> <note>The "craftsman" or creator of the physical world.</note> of the <term>Nazarenes</term> <note>An early Jewish-Christian sect.</note>. He was filled with rage and envy against his own creature, the reflection of which created <term>Ophiomorphos</term> <note>original: Ophiomorphos; a Greek term meaning "serpent-formed."</note>. In this case, it is only natural—even from a <term>dead-letter</term> <note>A literal, non-spiritual interpretation of text.</note> standpoint—to view Satan, the Serpent of *Genesis*, as the real creator and benefactor, the Father of Spiritual Mankind. For it is he who was the "Bringer of Light," the bright, radiant Lucifer, who opened the eyes of the <term>automaton</term> <note>A being without a soul or self-will.</note> allegedly "created" by Jehovah. And he who was the first to whisper, "on the day you eat of it, you shall be as <term>Elohim</term> <note>original: Elohim; a Hebrew plural word for "Gods" or "Divine Beings."</note>, knowing good and evil," can only be regarded as a Savior. Though an "Adversary" to Jehovah, the "personating spirit," he remains in <term>Esoteric</term> <note>Hidden or inner spiritual truth.</note> Truth the ever-loving "Messenger," the Angel, the Seraphim, and Cherubim who both "knew" well and "loved" even more. He conferred upon us Spiritual Immortality instead of Physical Immortality—the latter being a kind of *static* immortality that would have transformed man into an undying <term>Wandering Jew</term> <note>A legendary figure from folklore cursed to walk the earth until the Second Coming of Christ.</note>.

As narrated in King’s *Gnostics and their Remains* concerning Ildabaoth, whom several sects regarded as the God of Moses:

> Ildabaoth was far from being a pure spirit; ambition and pride dominated his nature. He therefore resolved to break off all connection with his mother, <term>Achamoth</term> <note>In Gnosticism, a lower form of Sophia (Wisdom).</note>, and to create a world entirely for himself. Aided by his own Six Spirits, he created Man, intending him to be the image of his power. However, he failed utterly in his work; his Man proved to be a vast, soulless monster, crawling upon the earth. The Six Spirits were obliged to bring their work back to their father to be given life. He did so by sharing the ray of Divine Light which he himself had inherited from Achamoth, who punished him for his pride and self-sufficiency by this loss of light.
> 
> Man, thus favored by Achamoth at the expense of her own son, followed the impulse of the Divine Light that she had transferred to him. He collected a further supply from the creation in which it was mingled and began to represent not the image of his creator, Ildabaoth, but rather that of the Supreme Being, the "Primal Man." At this sight, the Demiurge was filled with rage and envy at having produced a being so superior to himself. His looks, inspired by his passions, were reflected in the <term>Abyss</term> <note>The primal void or chaos.</note> as if in a mirror; the image became filled with life, and forth arose "Satan Serpent-formed," Ophiomorphos, the embodiment of envy and cunning.*

This is the <term>exoteric</term> <note>Public or literal version of a story.</note> rendering of the Gnostics, and the allegory, though a sectarian version, is suggestive and seems true to life. It is the natural conclusion drawn from the literal text of Chapter 3 of *Genesis*.

# SATAN, A CENTRIPETAL FORCE.

This leads to the allegory of Prometheus, who steals the Divine Fire to allow humans to proceed consciously on the path of Spiritual Evolution. This transforms the most perfect of *animals* on Earth into a potential God and makes him free to "take the kingdom of heaven by force." Because of this, Zeus pronounced a curse against Prometheus, just as <term>Jehovah-Ildabaoth</term> <note>In Gnostic tradition, the inferior and often arrogant creator of the physical world.</note> cursed his "rebellious son," Satan. The cold, pure snows of the Caucasian mountains and the never-dying, scorching fire and flames of an unquenchable Hell are two extremes of the same idea: the dual aspect of a refined torture. Prometheus is a "Fire-producer"—the personified emblem of *Phosphorus* <note>original: Φωσφόρος (Phôsphoros), meaning "Bringer of Light."</note>, of the Astral Fire and Light in the <term>Soul of the World</term> <note>original: Anima Mundi</note>. This is the element of which the German materialist philosopher Moleschott said: "without phosphorus, there is no thought" <note>original: "ohne Phosphor kein Gedanke"</note>. Prometheus burns in the fierce flames of his terrestrial passions; this conflagration is ignited by his thought, which can now distinguish good from evil, yet he remains a slave to the passions of his earthly nature. He feels the vulture of doubt and full consciousness gnawing at his heart—he is a Prometheus indeed, because he is a conscious, and therefore responsible, entity.* 

The curse of life is heavy, yet—with the exception of some Hindu and <term>Sufi</term> <note>Mystics within the Islamic tradition.</note> mystics—how few would exchange the tortures of conscious life and the burdens of a responsible existence for the unconscious perfection of a passive (objective) incorporeal being, or even for the universal static stillness personified in <term>Brahma</term> <note>The Hindu creator deity, representing cosmic expansion and contraction.</note> during his "Night's" rest. To quote from an insightful article by a writer† who, by confusing different levels of existence and consciousness, fell victim to them:

> Satan [or Lucifer] represents the *Active*, or, as [M. Jules] Baissac calls it, the "Centrifugal" Energy of the Universe [in a cosmic sense]. He is Fire, Light, Life, Struggle, Effort, Thought, Consciousness, Progress, Civilization, Liberty, and Independence. At the same time, he is Pain—which is the reaction to the *pleasure of action*—and *Death*, which is the revolution of *Life*. Satan, burning in his *own* Hell, is produced by the fury of his own momentum—the expansive breaking apart of the <term>nebula</term> <note>A cloud of gas and dust in space, the starting point for the formation of new worlds.</note> which is to concentrate into new worlds. # THE SACRIFICE OF THE FIERY ANGELS.

...nor to spiritualize, but to humanize the Self,"* to do so, the spirit must be born **human**, not **angelic**. Hence, tradition shows the celestial <term>Yogis</term> <note>original: "Yogis"; here referring to advanced spiritual beings or "Fiery Angels" who possess great wisdom and self-discipline.</note> offering themselves as voluntary victims in order to redeem Humanity. Humanity was created god-like and perfect at first, and these beings sought to endow it with human affections and aspirations. To do this, they had to give up their natural status, descend to our Globe, and take up their residence on it for the whole cycle of the **Mahâyuga** <note>Mahâyuga: A "Great Age" in Hindu cosmology, totaling 4,320,000 years.</note>. In doing so, they exchanged their impersonal **Individualities** for individual **Personalities**—the bliss of a celestial <note>original: "sidereal"</note> existence for the curse of terrestrial life.

This voluntary sacrifice of the Fiery Angels, whose nature was **Knowledge** and **Love**, has been interpreted by mainstream <note>original: "exoteric"</note> theologies as a "rebellion." They describe "the Rebel Angels being hurled down from Heaven into the darkness of Hell"—meaning our Earth. Hindu philosophy hints at the truth by teaching that the **Asuras** <note>Asuras: Ancient spiritual beings who, in this context, represent the "fallen" angels of wisdom.</note>, cast down by Shiva, are only in an intermediate state. In this state, they prepare for higher degrees of purification and redemption from their difficult condition. In contrast, Christian Theology—which claims to be based on the divine love, charity, and justice of the one it calls its Saviour—paradoxically enforces its claim by inventing the dreary dogma of Hell. This dogma serves as the "Archimedean lever" <note>A point of total leverage or power, named after the Greek mathematician Archimedes.</note> of Roman Catholic philosophy.

On the other hand, Rabbinical wisdom—which can be quite literal, materialistic, or focused on physical biology as it reduces everything to physiological mysteries—calls these Beings the "Evil One." Similarly, the Kabalists call them **Nahash**, meaning "**Deprived**," as previously mentioned. They are described as the Souls who, after being separated in Heaven from the Holy One, threw themselves into an Abyss at the very dawn of their existence, anticipating the time when they were to descend to Earth.†

Let me explain at once that our argument is not with the **Zohar** <note>A foundational work of Jewish Kabalah.</note> or any other book of the **Kabalah** in its correct interpretation—for the true meaning is the same as our own. Our quarrel is only with the coarse, **pseudo**-esoteric explanations of later periods, and especially those of the Christian Kabalists.

In the picture of this **Nahash**, this spirit was represented by a serpent; because the serpent, lacking bodily limbs, was looked upon as a deprived, depraved, and degraded creature." (*New Aspects of Life*, p. 235.) The **Jod** is the poetic symbol for Jehovah in the **Kabalah**—the God represented by the male symbol of reproduction.

# THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

The Commentary says:
*Our earth and man are the products of the three Fires.*

In Sanskrit, the names of these three correspond to the "Electric Fire," the "Solar Fire," and the "Fire produced by Friction." When explained on cosmic and human levels, these three Fires represent Spirit, Soul, and Body—the three primary Root Groups, along with their four additional divisions. These divisions vary among different schools of thought and—depending on how they are applied—become the <term>Upâdhis</term> <note>Upâdhis: The foundational bases or "vessels" that provide a vehicle for consciousness.</note> and the Vehicles, or the <term>Noumena</term> <note>original: "Noumena"; the underlying reality or essence of things, as opposed to their physical appearance.</note> of these. In public <note>original: "exoteric"</note> accounts, they are personified as the "three sons of surpassing brilliance and splendor" belonging to <term>Agni Abhimânin</term> <note>Agni Abhimânin: The primary fire deity representing the cosmic creative intellect.</note>, the eldest son of <term>Brahmâ</term> <note>Brahmâ: The creator god in Hindu cosmology.</note> (the <term>Cosmic Logos</term>) and <term>Svâhâ</term>, one of the daughters of <term>Daksha</term>*.

In a metaphysical sense, "Fire by Friction" refers to the union between <term>Buddhi</term> <note>Buddhi: The spiritual soul or the faculty of higher intuition.</note> (the sixth principle) and <term>Manas</term> <note>Manas: The mind or intellect, the fifth principle.</note>. In this process, the two are joined or cemented together, and the fifth principle partially merges into and becomes part of the <term>Monad</term> <note>Monad: The unified, eternal spark of divinity within an individual.</note>. In a physical sense, it refers to the "creative spark" or germ that fertilizes and generates the human being. The three Fires—named <term>Pâvaka</term>, <term>Pavamâna</term>, and <term>Shuchi</term>—were supposedly condemned by a curse from the great sage <term>Vasishtha</term> "to be born over and over again."† This meaning is clear enough.

Consequently, these "Flames"—whose roles are often confused in public religious books and are called by various names like <term>Prajâpatis</term> <note>Prajâpatis: "Lords of Creatures," the original progenitors of life.</note>, <term>Pitris</term> <note>Pitris: Ancestors or spiritual fathers of humanity.</note>, <term>Manus</term>, <term>Asuras</term>, <term>Rishis</term> <note>Rishis: Sages or seers.</note>, and <term>Kumâras</term>‡—are said to incarnate personally during the period of the <term>Third Root-Race</term> <note>Third Root-Race: In theosophical teaching, the Lemurian stage of human evolution where consciousness was first awakened.</note>. In this way, they find themselves "reborn over and over again." In the Secret Doctrine, they are generally named <term>Asuras</term>, or the <term>Asura Devatâ</term> or <term>Pitar Devatâ</term> (Gods). As previously stated, they were originally the highest Gods before they became "No-Gods," having fallen from being <term>Spirits of Heaven</term> into <term>Spirits of Earth</term>§—at least, this is how they are described in public, orthodox dogma.

## THE “CONSCIOUS ENTITY.”

No theologian or scholar of Eastern cultures <note>original: "Orientalist"</note> can ever understand the genealogies of the <term>Prajâpatis</term> <note>Prajâpatis: In Hindu tradition, these are the "Lords of Creatures" or progenitors of mankind.</note>, the <term>Manus</term> <note>Manus: The cosmic progenitors and lawmakers who preside over vast cycles of time.</note>, and the <term>Rishis</term> <note>Rishis: Seers or sages who reveal divine knowledge.</note>, or their direct connection—or rather, their correlation—with the Gods, unless they possess the key to the ancient, primitive <term>Cosmogony</term> <note>Cosmogony: A theory or story regarding the origin of the universe.</note> and <term>Theogony</term> <note>Theogony: An account of the origin and genealogy of a group of gods.</note> that all nations originally shared in common. All these Gods and Demi-gods are found reborn on Earth in various <term>Kalpas</term> <note>Kalpas: Vast eons or cycles of time in Hindu cosmology.</note> and in various roles. Moreover, each has their <term>Karma</term> <note>Karma: The universal law of cause and effect.</note> clearly traced, with every effect linked back to its original cause.

Before other Stanzas could be explained, it was absolutely necessary to show that the Sons of “Dark Wisdom”—though identical to the Archangels that Theology has chosen to call the “Fallen”—are just as divine and pure, if not purer, than all the Michaels and Gabriels so glorified in the Churches. -># THE SECRET DOCTRINE.<-

Concerning the variety of human complexions, there is an insightful allegory told in the *Linga Purâna* <note>An ancient Hindu scripture dedicated to the god Shiva</note>. The <term>Kumâras</term> <note>Kumâras: In Hindu philosophy, these are the "mind-born sons" of Brahma; the term means "youths" or "virgin boys"</note>—also known as the Rudra Gods—are described as incarnations of Shiva, the Destroyer (specifically the destroyer *of outward forms*), who is also called Vâmadeva. As a Kumâra, the "Eternal Celibate" or the chaste Virgin Youth, Vâmadeva emerges from Brahmâ during each great <term>Manvantara</term> <note>Manvantara: A vast period of cosmic manifestation or a world-cycle</note> and "again becomes four." This is a reference to the four great divisions of the human races regarding their complexion and type, as well as the three main variations within them. 

Thus, in the twenty-ninth <term>Kalpa</term> <note>Kalpa: A cosmic age or "day of Brahma" lasting millions of years</note>—referring here to the transformation and evolution of the human form, which Shiva continually destroys and remodels periodically until the great turning point in the middle of the Fourth (Atlantean) Race—Shiva appears as <term>Shvetalohita</term> <note>original: "Shvetalohita," meaning White-Red</note>, the original Kumâra. In this cycle, he changes from being moon-colored to **white**. In his next transformation, he is **red** (though in this instance the public version of the story differs from the secret esoteric teaching). In the third transformation, he is **yellow**, and in the fourth, **black**.

Esotericism now classifies these seven variations and four great divisions into only three distinct primeval races. It does not count the First Race, because it had no specific type or color and possessed a form that was hardly physical, though it was massive in size. The evolution, formation, and development of these races proceeded alongside the evolution of three geological layers of the Earth. The human complexion was derived from these layers just as much as it was determined by the climates of these different zones. The Esoteric Teaching names three great divisions: the **red-yellow**, the **black**, and the **brown-white**. 

For example, the **Aryan races**—which currently range from dark brown or almost black, to red-brown-yellow, down to the whitest creamy color—nevertheless all come from the same stock: the Fifth Root-Race. They all spring from a single ancestor, called in Hindu public teaching <note>original: "exotericism"</note> by the general name **Vaivasvata Manu**. Remember, this is a symbolic figure, a Sage said to have lived over 18,000,000 years ago, as well as 850,000 years ago—at the time when the last remnants of the Great Continent of **Atlantis** sank.†

The cycles that have passed since then have already carried us forward on the opposite ascending arc, taking some steps toward our "dematerialization," as Spiritualists would call it. The Earth, ourselves, and all things have softened since then—yes, even our brains.

To this, the following answers are given: 
1. Firstly, what is the actual date assigned by Geology to these "oldest paleozoic rocks"? 
2. Secondly, why couldn't winds blow, rain fall, and waves—perhaps of "carbonic acid"—exist in that era?

->**THE SECRET DOCTRINE.**<-

Almost all branches of modern knowledge were anticipated in ancient science. They were known to ancient philosophers in their general features, even if not in such specific detail as they are today.

Hindu astronomy <note>original: "Paurânic Astronomy"</note>, despite its intentional secrecy and confusion designed to lead the uninitiated <note>original: "profane"</note> off the real track, has been shown even by the researcher John Bentley to be a legitimate science. Those who are skilled in the mysteries of Hindu astronomical treatises can prove that modern theories—such as the gradual condensation of nebulae <note>clouds of gas and dust in space</note>, nebulous stars, and suns—were known perfectly in India. This includes the most minute details about the cyclic progress of constellations <note>original: "asterisms"</note> for tracking time and other purposes, with a level of accuracy far greater than what Europeans possess even now.

If we turn to Geology and Zoology, we find the same thing. What are all the myths and endless genealogies of the seven *Prajapatis* <note>progenitors or "lords of creatures"</note>, of their sons (the seven *Rishis* or *Manus*), and of their wives and offspring, but a vast, detailed account of the progressive development and evolution of animal creation, one species after another? Consider the highly philosophical and intellectual Aryans—the authors of the most perfect system of transcendental psychology, of codes of ethics, and of a grammar as sophisticated as Panini’s. They developed the *Sankhya* and *Vedanta* philosophical systems and a moral code (Buddhism) that Max Müller called the most perfect on earth. Were these people such fools or children that they would waste their time writing "fairy tales," which is how the *Puranas* <note>ancient Hindu texts containing mythology and philosophy</note> appear to those who do not have the slightest idea of their secret meaning?

What is the "fable" of the genealogy and origin of the sage Kashyapa? He is described as having twelve wives by whom he fathered a numerous and diverse progeny of serpents (*Nagas*), reptiles, birds, and all kinds of living things. He was thus the "father" of all kinds of animals. This is actually a *veiled* record of the order of evolution in *this Round* <note>a "Round" is a massive cycle of planetary and biological development in Theosophical teaching</note>. So far, it seems no Western scholar <note>original: "Orientalist"</note> has ever had the slightest grasp of the truths hidden under these allegories and personifications. One scholar remarks that the *Shatapatha Brahmana* <note>a sacred prose text describing Vedic rituals</note> gives "a not very intelligible account" of Kashyapa’s origin.

According to the *Mahabharata*, the *Ramayana*, and the *Puranas*, Kashyapa was the son of Marichi (the son of the creator God Brahma), the father of Vivasvat, and the father of Manu, the ancestor of mankind.

According to the *Shatapatha Brahmana*: Having assumed the form of a tortoise, the Lord of Creatures <note>original: "Prajapati"</note> created offspring. That which he created he made (*akarot* <note>Sanskrit: "he did/made"</note>); hence the word *kurma* (tortoise). Kashyapa means tortoise; therefore men say, "All creatures are descendants of Kashyapa."*

# MILLIONS OF YEARS HENCE.

As the next great cycle of manifestation <note>original: Manvantara; a vast period of cosmic activity</note> approaches, life will develop from the "discarded" types of the human races as they return once again to a spiritual state <note>original: astral</note> out of the depths of physical life. There were no apes before man existed, and they will be extinct before the Seventh Race <note>the final stage of human development in the current planetary cycle</note> develops. Karma <note>the law of cause and effect</note> will guide the souls <note>original: Monads</note> of the unprogressed men of our own Race and place them in the newly evolved human bodies of what will then be physiologically transformed baboons.

This will take place, of course, millions of years from now. But this picture of the cyclic progression of all that lives and breathes on Earth—of each species in its turn—is a true one. It requires no "special creation" or miraculous formation of man, beast, and plant out of nothing <note>original: *ex nihilo*</note>.

This is how Occult Science explains the absence of any "missing link" between ape and man: it shows that the ape actually evolved from the human.

### A PANORAMIC VIEW OF THE EARLY RACES.

There is a period of a few million years to account for between the first "mindless" race and the highly intelligent and intellectual later Lemurians <note>the Third Root-Race, believed to have inhabited a lost continent in the Indian and Pacific Oceans</note>. The only witnesses remaining of the Lemurians are a few silent records in the form of a half-dozen broken, massive statues <note>original: colossi</note> and ancient, giant stone ruins <note>original: cyclopean ruins</note>. These ruins are not allowed to be heard as evidence; some assure us they are merely "products of blind natural forces," while others tell us they are "quite modern." Tradition is contemptuously ignored by the skeptic and the materialist, and it is forced to fit the narratives of the *Bible* in every case by overly-zealous churchmen. Whenever a legend refuses to fit the theory of Noah's Flood <note>original: Noachian Deluge</note>, the Christian clergy declares it to be "the insanely delirious voice of old superstition." Atlantis is denied, or else confused with Lemuria and other lost continents. # THE NATURAL "FALL."

It is difficult through mere calculations to realize the immense periods of time that must have passed since the separation of the sexes, not to mention the era of the First or even the Second Root-Races <note>In Theosophical teaching, these are the earliest stages of human evolution: the First was "self-born" and ethereal, and the Second was "sweat-born."</note>. Because these stages remain beyond the understanding of minds trained in Western thought, it is considered useless to speak in detail about the First, Second, or even the earliest stages of the Third Race. It is only when the Third Race reaches its fully human period that a beginning can be made without the uninitiated reader becoming hopelessly bewildered.

The Third Race *fell*—meaning it no longer "created" through spiritual power, but instead "begot" its offspring physically. Being still without "mind" at the period when the sexes separated, it produced unnatural <note>original: anomalous</note> offspring until its physiological nature had adjusted its instincts in the right direction. Like the "Lord Gods" of the Bible, the "Sons of Wisdom" (the <term>Dhyân Chohans</term> <note>Lords of Wisdom; celestial beings who oversee the evolution of the universe</note>) had warned them to leave alone the "forbidden fruit" of nature, but the warning proved useless. Men realized the unfitness—we should not call it "sin"—of what they had done only when it was too late, after the Angelic Monads <note>Individual units of divine consciousness</note> from higher realms <note>original: Spheres</note> had incarnated within them and gifted them with understanding. Until that day, they had remained simply physical, much like the animals that were generated from them. 

What is the distinction between them? The Doctrine teaches that the only difference on Earth between animate and inanimate objects, or between an animal and a human frame, is that in some, the various "Fires" are latent, while in others they are active. These Vital Fires <note>The spiritual and life-sustaining energies inherent in all matter</note> are in all things, and not a single atom is devoid of them. However, no animal has the three higher "principles" <note>In this context, the higher aspects of consciousness and spirit</note> awakened within it; they are simply potential or latent, and thus practically non-existent. The physical frames of men would have remained in this animal state to this day if they had been left as they first emerged from the bodies of their spiritual ancestors <note>original: Progenitors or Pitris</note>, whose "shadows" they were, to grow only through the powers and forces inherent in matter. But as it is said in the *Pymander* <note>A sacred text from the Hermetic tradition, attributed to Hermes Trismegistus</note>:

> This is a mystery that until this day was sealed and hidden. Nature <note>The physical body, which is the "shadow" of the spiritual ancestors</note> being mingled with Man <note>The "Heavenly Man" or spiritual essence</note> brought forth a wondrous miracle: the harmonious blending of the essence of the *Seven* [the spiritual guides or ancestors known as Pitris] and her own essence; the *Fire*, the *Spirit*, and *Nature* [the spiritual essence <note>original: Noumenon</note> of matter]; which blending produced—
