# THE SYMBOLISM OF CRONUS.

Harmony will reign once more between the two as it did before the "Fall," when even mortal man was "created" by the Elements and was not born.

The above is made clear in all the great Theogonies <note>original: "Theogonies" — accounts of the origins and genealogies of the gods</note>, principally in the Grecian, such as in the work of Hesiod <note>An ancient Greek poet, author of the "Theogony"</note>. The mutilation of Uranus by his son Cronus, which condemns Uranus to impotency, has never been understood by modern mythographers. Yet, it is very plain; as this story was universal* it must have contained a great abstract and philosophical idea that is now lost to our modern scholars. 

In the allegory, this punishment marks "a new period, a second phase in the development of creation," as justly remarked by Decharme†, who, however, does not attempt to explain it. Uranus tried to block that development, or natural evolution, by *destroying all his children as soon as they were born*. Uranus, who personifies all the creative powers of and in Chaos—Space, or the Unmanifested Deity—is thus made to pay the penalty. It is these powers which cause the <term>Pitris</term> <note>Sanskrit: "Fathers" or ancestral spirits who helped bring humanity into existence</note> to evolve primordial "men" from themselves—just as, later on, these men in their turn evolve their own progeny—without any sense or desire for procreation. The work of generation, suspended for a moment, passes into the hands of Cronus (<term>Chronos</term>) Time‡, who unites himself with Rhea (the Earth—in Esotericism, Matter in general), and thus produces celestial and terrestrial Titans. The whole of this symbolism relates to the mysteries of evolution.

This allegory is the exoteric <note>public or literal</note> version of the Esoteric Doctrine given in this part of our work. For in Cronus, we see the same story repeated again. As Uranus destroyed his children by Gæa (who is one in the world of manifestation with Aditi, or the Great Cosmic Deep), by confining—

Then comes Zeus, or Jupiter, who in turn overthrows his father.† Jupiter the Titan is Prometheus, in one sense,‡ and differs from Zeus, the great "Father of the Gods." He is the "disrespectful son" in the works of Hesiod <note>An ancient Greek poet</note>. Hermes calls him the "Heavenly Man" in the *Pymander* <note>A classic Hermetic text</note>; and even in the *Bible* he is found again under the name of Adam, and later—by a transformation—under the name of Ham. Yet these are all personifications of the "Sons of Wisdom." The necessary proof that Jupiter belongs to the purely *human* Atlantean Cycle—if the figures of Uranus and Cronus who precede him are found insufficient—may be read in Hesiod, who tells us that:

> The Immortals made the race of the Golden and Silver Age [the First and Second Root Races]; Jupiter made the generation of Bronze [a mixture of *two* elements], that of the Heroes, and of the Iron Age.§

After this, he sends his fatal present, Pandora, to Epimetheus.|| Hesiod calls this present of the *first woman* "a fatal gift." It was a punishment, he explains, sent to man "for the theft of [divine creative] fire." Her appearance on Earth is the signal for every kind of evil. Before her appearance, the human races lived happy, exempt from sickness and suffering—just as the same races are described as living under Yima’s rule in the Mazdean *Vendîdâd* <note>A primary text of the Zoroastrian tradition</note>.

### THE RACES IN GREEK MYTHOLOGY.

In Slavic mythology, all people are drowned except for two elderly people, a man and his wife. Then Pram’zimas <note>likely a variation of Praamžius, the Lithuanian sky god</note>, the "master of all," advises them to jump seven times onto the rocks of the Earth. From this, seven new races (couples) are born, who become the ancestors of the nine Lithuanian tribes.|| As correctly understood by the author of *Mythology of Ancient Greece* <note>original: *Mythologie de la Grèce Antique* by Paul Decharme</note>, the Four Ages represent periods of time and serve as an allegorical reference to the human Races. As he writes:

> The successive races, destroyed and replaced by others without any transition period, are characterized in Greece by the names of metals to reflect their ever-decreasing value. Gold—the most brilliant and precious of all and a symbol of light—characterizes the first race. . . . The men of the second race, those of the Silver Age, are already far inferior to the first. Passive and weak creatures, their entire lives are nothing more than a long and mindless infancy. . . . They disappear. . . . The men of the Bronze Age are robust and violent [the Third Race]; . . . their strength is immense. "They had weapons made of bronze and dwellings made of bronze; they used nothing but bronze. Iron, the black metal, was as yet unknown."¶ The fourth race, according to Hesiod, consists of the heroes who died at Thebes** or beneath the walls of Troy.††

Since these four Races are mentioned by the earliest Greek poets—even if presented in a confused and chronologically inconsistent way—our doctrines are once again confirmed by the classics. However, all of this is dismissed as "mythology" and poetry. What would modern science have to say about this interpretation of ancient fictions as historical reality <note>original: "euhemerization"—the theory that myths are based on real historical events and people</note>? The verdict is easy to predict. Therefore, we must attempt to respond in advance. We must prove that modern science is so preoccupied with its own fictions and theoretical guesses that its scholars have no right—while ignoring the massive flaws <note>A reference to the biblical metaphor of the "mote and the beam" regarding hypocrisy</note> in their own views—to criticize the minor perceived errors of the Occultist, even if those errors were not simply a product of their own imagination.

As soon as the mental eye of man was opened to understanding, the Third Race felt itself at one with the ever-present—as well as the ever-unknown and invisible—All, the One Universal God. Those who fell victim to their lower natures became the slaves of Matter. Having started as "Sons of Light and Wisdom," they ended by becoming the "Sons of Darkness." They lost the battle of mortal life against Life Immortal.

-># THE GOLDEN AGE.<-

...and all those who fell in this way became the ancestors of the future generations of Atlanteans.*

At the beginning of his conscious awareness, the human of the Third Root-Race <note>The Lemurians, an ancient stage of humanity in theosophical history</note> had no beliefs that could be called religion. That is to say, he was not only ignorant of "joyful religions, full of ceremony and gold," but even of any formal system of faith or external worship. However, if the term "religion" is defined as the bonding together of people in a shared reverence for those they feel are higher than themselves—a sense of piety like the feeling a child has toward a loved parent—then even the earliest Lemurians had a religion from the very start of their intellectual life, and a most beautiful one. Did they not have their bright "Gods of the Elements" around them, and even within themselves?† Was not their childhood spent being nursed and tended by those who had given them existence and called them into intelligent, conscious life? We are assured this was the case, and we believe it. 

The evolution of Spirit into Matter could never have been achieved, nor would it have received its first momentum, if the bright Spirits had not sacrificed their own respective spiritual essences to animate the "man of clay." They did this by endowing each of his inner "principles" with a portion—or rather, a reflection—of that essence. The *Dhyanis* <note>original Sanskrit: *Dhyânîs*, enlightened beings or "Lords of Meditation"</note> of the Seven Heavens—representing the seven planes of Being—are the *Noumena* <note>original Greek: *Noumena*, the underlying spiritual realities or "things-in-themselves" behind physical phenomena</note> of both current and future Elements. In the same way, the Angels of the Seven Powers of Nature—whose physical effects we see in what science calls "modes of motion" or "imponderable forces"—are the even higher *Noumena* of still higher spiritual hierarchies.

It was the "Golden Age" in those ancient days—the age when the "Gods walked the earth and mingled freely with mortals." When that age ended, the Gods departed—meaning they became invisible—and later generations eventually began worshipping their kingdoms instead: the Elements.

It was the Atlanteans—the first offspring of semi-divine humanity after the separation into two sexes, and thus the first humanly-born mortals—who became the first "sacrificers" to the *God of Matter*. They stand in the dim, distant past—in ages far older than history—as the original model upon which the great symbol of Cain was built.‡

# NO DEVILS OUTSIDE HUMANITY.

This section is dedicated to an attempt to clarify this difficult and mysterious subject every time it arises. A great deal must necessarily be said about its symbolic aspect; by doing so, clues are given to the thoughtful student for their own investigations. In this way, more insight can be suggested than is possible to convey using the technical phrases of a more formal, philosophical explanation. The so-called "Fallen Angels" are Humanity itself. The demons of Pride, Lust, Rebellion, and Hatred had no existence before the appearance of physical, conscious humans. It is man who has fathered and nurtured the fiend, allowing it to develop in his own heart; it is he, again, who has contaminated the "Indwelling God" within himself by linking pure Spirit with the impure Demon of Matter. And, if the Kabbalistic <note>Relating to Jewish mysticism and its later Western adaptations</note> saying, "The Devil is God reversed" <note>original Latin: *Demon est Deus inversus*</note>, finds its theoretical support in the dual nature of the manifested universe, its practical application is found in Mankind alone.

Thus, it has now become self-evident that our teachings have very few chances of receiving a fair hearing, as we claim:
* (**a**) that Man appeared before other mammals, and even before the age of the giant reptiles;

* and chiefly (**c**) that man was born from a Superior Being—what Materialism would call a "supernatural" Being, though it is actually only "super-human."

### ARE GIANTS A FICTION?

Once again, we find ourselves at odds with modern science. So far, science denies that humans were ever significantly larger than the tallest and most powerful people we occasionally see today. Dr. Henry Gregor dismisses traditions of giants as being based on poorly understood facts, citing cases of mistaken identity to disprove these legends. For example, in 1613, in a place long known as the "Field of Giants" in Lower Dauphiné, France (four miles from St. Romans), massive bones were discovered deep in the sandy soil. They were initially thought to be human remains—even identified as those of Teutobodus, the Teuton chief killed by the Roman general Marius. However, later research by the naturalist Cuvier proved they were actually the fossil remains of a *Dinotherium Giganteum* <note>An extinct, giant relative of modern elephants</note>, which was 18 feet long. Since this *umsîmi* was located "on the seat" of the god Bel, it could hardly be a crown. A fourth version of this story is found in the Bible: Ham is the same as the Chaldæan Zu, and both are cursed for the same crime, which is described through allegory.</margin>

# MAN, THE STOREHOUSE OF ALL THE SEEDS OF LIFE.

We should not hesitate at the threshold of every new revelation. Everything that is supported by the possibilities and landmarks discovered by modern science is provided here; everything that exact knowledge knows nothing about and is unable to speculate upon—and therefore denies as a fact in nature—is withheld.

But even statements such as these will be contested: that man was the earliest of all mammals, that man is the indirect ancestor of the ape, and that he was a kind of <term>Cyclops</term> <note>Referring to the one-eyed giants of Greek mythology; here used to describe the "Third Eye" mentioned on the previous page.</note> in ancient days. Man was the storehouse, so to speak, of all the seeds of life for this <term>Round</term> <note>In Theosophical cosmology, a "Round" is one of seven cycles of evolutionary development on a planet.</note>, both vegetable and animal alike.* Just as <term>Ain Suph</term> <note>original: "Ain Suph"; a Hebrew Kabbalistic term for the Infinite or the Boundless Godhead.</note> is "One, notwithstanding the innumerable forms which are in him,"† so is man on Earth the <term>microcosm</term> <note>A "little world" that mirrors the larger universe (the macrocosm).</note> of the <term>macrocosm</term>.

As soon as man appeared, *everything was complete* . . . for everything is comprised in man. *He unites in himself all forms.*‡

The mystery of the *earthly* man follows the mystery of the *Heavenly Man.*§

The human form—so called because it is the vehicle (under whatever shape) of the *Divine Man*—is, as the author of "Esoteric Studies" so intuitively remarked, the *new type* at the beginning of every Round.

Just as man never can be, so he never has been, manifested in a shape belonging to the animal kingdom <note>original: "in esse"; meaning: "in being" or "in essence".</note>, meaning he never formed part of that kingdom. Derived only from the most finished class of the animal kingdom, a new human form must always have been the new type of the cycle. The human shape in one ring [?], as I imagine, becomes "cast-off clothes" in the next; it is then adopted by the highest order in the servant-kingdom below.||

If this idea is what we understand it to mean—for the "rings" spoken of are somewhat confusing—then it is the correct Esoteric Teaching.

### Mazdean Symbolism

The Egyptian ram-headed God <note>original: "Egyptian ram-headed God," likely referring to Khnum, who was believed to fashion human bodies from clay on a potter’s wheel.</note> makes man out of clay on a potter’s wheel; similarly, in the book of *Genesis*, the **Elohim** <note>A Hebrew word for "gods" or "divine beings" used in the creation story.</note> fashion him out of the same material.

Furthermore, when the “Maker of the material world,” Ahura Mazda <note>The supreme creator deity in Zoroastrianism.</note>, is asked what gives light “to the **Vara** <note>An enclosure or "ark" built by the hero Yima to protect the seeds of life from a devastating winter.</note> which Yima made,” he answers that:

<margin>* *Vendidad*, verse 40 (131).</margin>

> There are uncreated lights and created lights. There [in Airyana Vaêjô <note>The legendary homeland of the ancient Iranians, often associated with a northern or polar location.</note>, where the Vara is built], the stars, the moon, and the sun are only seen to rise and set once a year, and a year seems only as a day [and night].*

This is a clear reference to the “Land of the Gods,” or the (current) Polar Regions. Moreover, another hint is contained in this verse—a distinct allusion to the “uncreated lights” which enlighten man from within, his spiritual “principles.” Otherwise, no sense or reason could be found in Ahura Mazda’s answer, which is immediately followed by these words:

<margin>† See also *Bundahishn*, chapter 15.</margin>

> *Every fortieth year, two are born to every couple [hermaphrodite], a male and a female.†*

The latter is a distinct echo of the *Secret Doctrine*, specifically a **Stanza** <note>One of the verses from the "Book of Dzyan" upon which this book is a commentary.</note> which says:

> *At the expiration of every forty [annual] Suns, at the end of every fortieth Day, the double one becomes four; male and female in one, in the first and second and the third. . . .*

This is clear, since every “Sun” meant a whole year; a year was composed of only one “Day” then, just as in the Arctic Circle today it consists of six months of light. According to the ancient teaching, the axis of the Earth gradually changes its inclination to the **ecliptic** <note>The apparent path of the Sun across the sky; the tilt of Earth's axis relative to this path determines the seasons.</note>. At the period referred to, this inclination was such that a polar Day lasted during the entire period of the Earth’s revolution around the Sun. During this time, a very short twilight occurred, after which the polar land returned to its position directly under the solar rays. This may contradict Astronomy as it is currently taught and understood; but who can say that changes in the Earth's motion, which do not happen now, did not occur millions of years ago?

Returning once more to the statement that the **Vara** represented the Man of the **Fourth Round** <note>The current major cycle of evolutionary development on Earth.</note>, as much as it represented the Earth of those days, the Moon, and even Noah’s Ark (if one chooses to see it that way)—this is again shown in the dialogue between Ahura Mazda and Zarathushtra <note>The prophet also known as Zoroaster.</note>. ## "THREE-EYED" MORTALS.

The earliest mankind was a race of giants. Certain excavations in America, within mounds and caves, have already yielded isolated cases of groups of skeletons between nine and twelve feet high.* These belong to tribes of the early Fifth Race <note>In the author's system, the "Fifth Race" refers to modern humanity, which followed the "Fourth Race" or Atlanteans.</note>, who have now degenerated to an average size of between five and six feet. But we can easily believe that the Titans and Cyclopes of old really belonged to the Fourth (Atlantean) Race, and that all the subsequent legends and allegories found in the Hindu *Puranas* <note>Ancient Hindu texts containing mythology and history</note> and the Greek poems of Hesiod and Homer were based on the hazy reminiscences of real Titans—men of a tremendous, superhuman physical power. This power enabled them to defend themselves and hold at bay the gigantic monsters of the Mesozoic and early Cenozoic eras—actual Cyclopes, or "three-eyed" mortals.

It has been often remarked by observant writers that the "origin of nearly every popular myth and legend could be traced invariably to a fact in Nature."

In these fantastic creations of an exuberant subjectivity <note>original: subjectivism; the tendency to view reality through internal mental states</note>, there is always an element of the objective and real. The imagination of the masses, disorderly and ill-regulated as it may be, could never have conceived and fabricated out of nothing <note>original: ex nihilo</note> so many monstrous figures and such a wealth of extraordinary tales, had it not had a central nucleus of floating memories. These obscure and vague reminiscences unite the broken links of the chain of time to form the mysterious, dream-like foundation of our collective consciousness.†

Evidence for the Cyclopes—a race of Giants—will be pointed out in forthcoming sections through the "Cyclopean" ruins <note>Ancient structures made of massive, irregular stones without mortar, traditionally attributed to the Cyclopes</note>, which are still called by that name today. Science also provides an indication that the early Fourth Race may have been three-eyed. This occurred during its evolution and before the final adjustment of the human organism, which became perfect and symmetrical only in the Fifth Race. This does not necessarily mean they had a third eye in the middle of the brow like the legendary Cyclops.

# THE SEAT OF THE SOUL.

Each side is formed by a lateral thickening of the medullary wall <note>the layer of nervous tissue in the developing brain</note>, while the space between, descending toward the base, forms the cavity of the <term>third ventricle</term> <note>a fluid-filled space in the center of the brain</note> with its extension in the <term>infundibulum</term> <note>the "funnel" connecting the brain to the pituitary gland</note>. The grey <term>commissure</term> <note>a band of nerve fibers connecting the two sides of the brain</note> afterward stretches across the ventricular cavity. . . . The back part of the roof is developed by a unique process (to be mentioned later) into the **pineal gland**, which remains united on each side by its stalks <note>original: "pedicles"</note> to the **thalamus**, and behind these, a transverse band is formed as the **posterior commissure**.

The <term>lamina terminalis</term> <note>also called the lamina cinerea; the thin front wall of the third ventricle</note> continues to close the third ventricle in front. Below it, the **optic commissure** <note>where the optic nerves cross</note> forms the floor of the ventricle, and further back, the <term>infundibulum</term> descends to be united in the <term>sella turcica</term> <note>Latin: "Turkish saddle"; a saddle-shaped depression in the skull bone</note> with the tissue adjoining the posterior lobe of the **pituitary body**.

The two <term>optic thalami</term> <note>the part of the brain that processes sensory information</note>, formed from the back and outer part of the front brain-sac <note>original: "anterior vesicle"</note>, consist at first of a single hollow sac of nervous matter. The cavity of this sac communicates on each side in front with the developing cerebral hemispheres, and behind with the middle brain-sac (the <term>corpora quadrigemina</term> <note>Latin: "quadruplet bodies"; parts of the midbrain involved in vision and hearing</note>). Soon, however, due to increased growth taking place in their interior—at the back, bottom, and sides—the thalami become solid. At the same time, a cleft or fissure appears between them above and penetrates down to the internal cavity, which remains open at the back part opposite the entrance of the <term>Sylvian aqueduct</term> <note>a canal connecting the ventricles of the brain</note>. This cleft or fissure is the *third ventricle*. Behind it, the two thalami remain united by the *posterior commissure* (which can be seen around the end of the third month of development) and also by the *peduncles of the pineal gland* <note>the stalks connecting the gland to the rest of the brain</note>. . .

At an early period, the **optic tracts** <note>the paths of the optic nerves</note> may be recognized as hollow extensions from the outer part of the wall of the thalami while they are still sac-like. By the fourth month, these tracts are distinctly formed. They are subsequently extended backward into connection with the <term>corpora quadrigemina</term>.

The formation of the pineal gland and pituitary body presents some of the most interesting phenomena connected with the development of the <term>thalamencephalon</term> <note>the "inter-brain" or diencephalon</note>.*

The above information is especially interesting when it is remembered that, were it not for the development of the back part of the cerebral hemispheres, the **Pineal Gland** would be perfectly visible upon removing the parietal bones <note>the bones forming the roof and sides of the skull</note>. It is also very interesting to note the obvious connection that can be traced between the originally hollow **Optic Tract** and the **Eyes** in the front, and the **Pineal Gland** and its stalks in the back, and between all of these and the **Optic Thalami**. Consequently, the recent discoveries regarding the "third eye" of the *Hatteria Punctata* <note>original: Latin name for the Tuatara, a New Zealand lizard with a well-developed parietal eye</note> have a very important bearing on the history of the development of the human senses and on the Esoteric <note>original: "Occult"</note> assertions in this text.

It is well known that **Descartes** saw in the Pineal Gland the *Seat of the Soul*, though this is now regarded as a fiction by those who have ceased to believe in the existence of an immortal principle in man.

Nemesis, as the daughter of <term>Dike</term> <note>Greek: "Justice"</note>, is the fair Goddess who saves her anger only for those who are driven mad by pride, selfishness <note>original: "egoïsm"</note>, and impiety. (See Mesomedes, *Hymn to Nemesis* <note>original: "Mesomed., Hymn. Nemes."</note>, verse 2, from Brunck, *Analecta* <note>original: "Analecta"; a collection of literary fragments or selections</note> II. page 292; quoted in *Mythology of Ancient Greece* <note>original: "Mythologie de la Grèce Antique"</note>, page 304.) In short, while Nemesis is a mythological, outer <note>original: "exoteric"</note> Goddess or *Power* given human form in various ways, Karma is a highly philosophical truth. It is a most divine and noble expression of humanity's original intuition regarding the Deity. It is a doctrine that explains the origin of Evil and elevates our ideas of what divine, unchangeable Justice ought to be, instead of insulting the unknown and unknowable Deity by making it the unpredictable, cruel tyrant that we call "Providence."

# THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

...for Karma is one with the Unknowable (of which it is an aspect) through its effects in the world of physical phenomena.

Closely—or rather, inseparably—connected with Karma is the Law of Rebirth, the reincarnation of the same spiritual Individuality through a long, nearly endless series of Personalities. These personalities are like the various characters played by the same actor. The actor identifies with each role, and the audience identifies him with it as well, for the duration of a few hours. The *inner* or real Man, who performs these characters, knows the entire time that he is Hamlet only for the brief space of a few acts. However, on the level <note>original: "plane"</note> of human illusion, these acts represent Hamlet's entire life. He also knows that the night before he was King Lear—who was himself a transformation of the Othello he played on a previous night. Even though the external, visible character is supposed to be unaware of this fact—and in real life, that ignorance is unfortunately all too real—the *permanent* Individuality is fully aware of it. It is because the "spiritual Eye" has wasted away <note>original: "atrophy"</note> within the physical body that this knowledge is unable to reach the consciousness of the temporary <note>original: "false"</note> Personality.

We are told that the men of the <term>Third Root-Race</term> <note>In the author's system, these are the "Lemurians," a prehistoric stage of humanity</note> possessed a physical Third Eye until nearly the middle of the third sub-race of the <term>Fourth Root-Race</term> <note>The "Atlanteans"</note>. At that point, as the human body became more solid and refined, the eye disappeared from the external anatomy of man. Psychically and spiritually, however, the mental and visual perception of this eye lasted until nearly the end of the Fourth Race. Its functions eventually died out entirely due to the focus on physical matter and the corrupted state of mankind. This happened before the majority of the <term>Atlantean Continent</term> was submerged. Now, we may return to the subject of the Great Floods <note>original: "Deluges"</note> and their many "Noahs."

The student must keep in mind that there were many floods like the one mentioned in the Book of Genesis. There were three even more significant ones, which will be described in the section of Part III regarding prehistoric "Submerged Continents." To avoid mistaken guesses, however, we must address certain claims: first, that the Esoteric Doctrine has much in common with the legends in the <term>Hindu Scriptures</term>; second, that the timeline <note>original: "chronology"</note> of those scriptures is almost identical to the Doctrine's own—only explained more clearly; and finally, the belief that <term>Vaivasvata Manu</term>—a generic title!—was the Noah of the <term>Aryans</term> and the original model for the biblical patriarch. All...

# THE SEVEN AND FOURTEEN MANUS.

this—as it also pertains to the beliefs of the Occultists—requires a new explanation at this point.

### THE PRIMEVAL MANUS OF HUMANITY.

Those who are aware that the "Great Flood," which was connected with the sinking of an entire continent (except for a few islands), could not have happened as far back as 18,000,000 years ago, and that <term>Vaivasvata Manu</term> <note>In Hindu tradition, the seventh Manu and the protagonist of the flood story</note> is the Indian Noah connected with the *Matsya* <note>original: "Matsya," meaning Fish</note>, or the Fish Incarnation <note>original: "Avatâra"</note> of Vishnu, may feel confused by the apparent contradiction between these facts and the timeline previously given. However, there is no real contradiction. The reader is encouraged to look at *The Theosophist* from July 1883; by studying the article there titled "The Septenary Principle in Esotericism," the entire issue can be explained. I believe it is in the explanation given there that the Occultists differ from the <term>Brahmans</term> <note>The priestly caste of India and guardians of traditional Vedic knowledge</note>.

For the benefit of those who may not have that issue of *The Theosophist* available, a passage or two may be quoted from it now:

> Who was Manu, the son of Svayambhuva? The *Secret Doctrine* tells us that *this Manu was not a single man, but the representation of the first human races, which evolved with the help of the Dhyan Chohans (Celestial Beings), at the beginning of the First Round.* But we are told in his *Laws* (i. 80) that there are fourteen Manus for every <term>Kalpa</term> <note>A vast period of time, often called a "Day of Brahma"</note>, or "interval from creation to creation"—which should be understood as the interval from one minor <term>Pralaya</term> <note>A period of dissolution or cosmic rest</note> to another—and that "in the present divine age, there have been seven Manus so far." Those who know that there are seven Rounds, of which we have passed three and are now in the Fourth, and who are taught that there are seven...

***

* <term>Pralaya</term>—a word already explained—is not a term that applies *only* to every "Night of Brahma," or the dissolution of the world that follows every <term>Manvantara</term> <note>A period of 71 Mahayugas, or roughly 306.7 million years</note> (which equals 71 <term>Mahayugas</term> <note>Great Ages</note>). It also applies to each "Obscuration" <note>A period when a planet or system goes into dormancy</note> and even to every cataclysm that ends each <term>Root-Race</term> by fire or water in turn. *Pralaya* is a general term like the word "Manu"—the generic name for the *Shishtas* <note>The "remnants" or seeds of life that survive a cosmic destruction to start the next cycle</note>, who are called "Kings" in the *Puranas* <note>Ancient Hindu texts containing mythology and history</note>. They are said to be preserved "with the seed of all things, in an ark, from the waters of that flood [or the fires of a general volcanic eruption, the beginning of which we already see for our <term>Fifth Race</term> in the terrible earthquakes and eruptions of these recent years, and especially in the present year (1888)], which, in the season of a Pralaya, overspreads the world [the Earth]." (*Vishnu Purana*, Wilson’s Translation, I. 81.) Time is simply a form of Vishnu—truly, as Parashara says in the *Vishnu Purana*. In the Hindu <term>Yugas</term> <note>Eras or ages</note> and *Kalpas*, we see a regular descending series of 4, 3, and 2, followed by zeros and multiplied as necessary for Esoteric purposes. This was not done for "sectarian decorations," as Wilson and other Western scholars of the East <note>original: "Orientalists"</note> thought. A *Kalpa* may be an Age, a "Day of Brahma," or a "sidereal Kalpa" relating to astronomy and the Earth. These calculations are found in all the *Puranas*, though some differ—for example, the "Year of the Seven Rishis" is 3,030 mortal years, and the "Year of Dhruva" is 9,090 in the *Linga Purana*. These are again Esoteric and *do* represent actual (and secret) chronology. As stated in the *Brahma Vaivarta*: "Chronologers calculate a Kalpa by the life of Brahma. *Minor Kalpas*, such as Samvarta and the rest, are numerous." "Minor Kalpas" here refers to every period of destruction. This was well understood by Wilson himself, who explained them as "those in which the Samvarta wind or other destructive agents operate." (*Ibid.*, p. 54.)

# THE SECRET DOCTRINE

There are seven Dawns and seven Twilights, making fourteen <term>Manvantaras</term> <note>Vast periods of activity or cycles of time</note> in total. At the beginning and end of every Round, as well as on and between the planets [Globes], there is an "awakening to *illusive life*" and an "awakening to *real life*." Furthermore, there are <term>Root-Manus</term> and what we must awkwardly translate as <term>Seed-Manus</term>—the *seeds for the human races of the upcoming Round* (also called the <term>Shishtas</term>, the "surviving fittest"; a mystery revealed only to those who have passed the third degree of <term>Initiation</term>).

Those who have learned all this will be better prepared to understand the following: We are told in the Hindu Sacred Scriptures that "The first Manu produced *six other Manus* [seven primary Manus in all], and these in turn each produced seven other Manus" (<note>original: *Bhrigu, i. 61-63*</note>). In Occult treatises, the production of these latter Manus is recorded as 7×7. Thus, it becomes clear that Manu—the last one and the Progenitor of our Fourth-Round Humanity—must be the *seventh*, since we are currently in our Fourth Round, and there is a Root-Manu at Globe A and a Seed-Manu at Globe G.

Just as each planetary Round begins with the appearance of a Root-Manu (a <term>Dhyan Chohan</term> <note>A high-ranking spiritual being or celestial guide</note>) and ends with a Seed-Manu, a Root-Manu and a Seed-Manu also appear at the beginning and end of the human period on any specific planet [Globe]. From this statement, it is easy to see that a Manvantaric period (*Manu-antara*) means exactly what the term implies: the time between the appearance of two Manus or Dhyan Chohans. Therefore, a **Minor Manvantara** is the duration of the *seven Root-Races* on any specific planet [Globe], and a **Major Manvantara** is the period of one human Round along the Planetary Chain. 

Furthermore, since it is said that each of the seven Manus creates 7×7 Manus, and there are 49 Root-Races on the seven planets [Globes] during each Round, then every Root-Race has its own Manu. The current seventh Manu is called "Vaivasvata." In public religious texts, he represents the same figure as the Babylonian Xisuthrus and the Jewish Noah.

***

A thousand such groups equal one 'Day of Brahma,' and fourteen *Manus reign during that period*" (<note>original: *Op. cit., ibid., p. 49*, referring to the previously cited *Vishnu Purana*</note>). If we took this literally, there would be only one Manu for every 4,320,000,000 years. Where were the other Manus mentioned, unless the allegory refers to what the Esoteric Doctrine teaches: that the 14 Manus are each multiplied by 49?

# THE “BLINDS” OF EXOTERICISM
<note>In esoteric studies, a "blind" is a statement that is literally true but designed to mislead the uninitiated or hide a deeper meaning.</note>

In the Esoteric books, we are told that **Manu Vaivasvata**—the progenitor of our **Fifth Race** <note>The current stage of human evolution in this system</note> who saved it from the flood that nearly wiped out the Fourth (or **Atlantean**) Race—is not actually the seventh Manu mentioned in the standard list of "Root" or "Primitive" Manus. Instead, he is one of the 49 Manus who originated from this primary Root-Manu.

For a clearer understanding, the names of the 14 Manus are provided here in their specific order, showing how they relate to each **Round** <note>A "Round" is one full cycle of the life-force passing through the seven "Globes" or states of existence of the Earth chain</note>:

| Cycle | Type of Manu | Location | Name |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1st Round** | 1st (Root) Manu | Planet A | **Svâyambhuva** |
| | 1st (Seed) Manu | Planet G | **Svârochi**, or **Svârochisha** |
| **2nd Round** | 2nd (Root) Manu | Planet A | **Auttami** |
| | 2nd (Seed) Manu | Planet G | **Tâmasa** |
| **3rd Round** | 3rd (Root) Manu | Planet A | **Raivata** |
| | 3rd (Seed) Manu | Planet G | **Châkshusha** |
| **4th Round** | 4th (Root) Manu | Planet A | **Vaivasvata** (Our Progenitor) |
| | 4th (Seed) Manu | Planet G | **Sâvarna** |
| **5th Round** | 5th (Root) Manu | Planet A | **Daksha-sâvarna** |
| | 5th (Seed) Manu | Planet G | **Brahma-sâvarna** |
| **6th Round** | 6th (Root) Manu | Planet A | **Dharma-sâvarna** |
| | 6th (Seed) Manu | Planet G | **Rudra-sâvarna** |
| **7th Round** | 7th (Root) Manu | Planet A | **Rauchya** |
| | 7th (Seed) Manu | Planet G | **Bhautya** |

Thus, although **Vaivasvata** is seventh in the standard religious lists, he is actually the primary Root-Manu of our **Fourth Human Wave**. (The reader must always remember that "Manu" is not a single man, but a term for **collective humanity**). Our specific Vaivasvata was one of the seven "Minor Manus" who preside over the seven **Root-Races** of our planet [Globe]. Each of these Manus witnesses one of the periodic, recurring cataclysms (by fire or water) that end the cycle of every Root-Race.

It is this Vaivasvata—the Hindu ideal embodiment of the survivor, known by names like **Xisuthrus**, **Deucalion**, and **Noah**—who is the allegorical "Man" who rescued our Race. This happened when nearly the entire population of one hemisphere perished by water, while the other hemisphere was waking up from its temporary period of "obscuration" or dormancy.*

Therefore, there is no real contradiction in saying that the **Vaivasvata Manvantara** <note>original: *Manu-antara*, literally "between two Manus"</note> began over 18,000,000 years ago, when physical—or truly human—Man first appeared in this Fourth Round on Earth.

***

* The words "Creation" and "Dissolution" do not accurately translate the true meaning of either **Manvantara** <note>A period of activity</note> or **Pralaya** <note>A period of rest or dissolution</note>. The *Vishnu Purana* lists several types: "The dissolution of all things is of four kinds," the sage **Parashara** is recorded as saying:
1. **Naimittika** (Occasional or Contingent): This occurs when **Brahma** slumbers. During his "Night," at the end of his "Day," the Universe merges back together. This is called Brahma's contingent re-absorption because Brahma is the Universe itself.
2. **Prakritika** (Elemental or Natural): This occurs when the Universe returns to its original nature in a partial and physical way.
3. **Atyantika** (Absolute or Final): This is the identification of the individual soul with the bodiless Supreme Spirit—the **Mahatmic** state <note>A state of great spiritual liberation</note>, whether temporary or lasting until the next **Maha Kalpa** <note>A "Great Age" or full cycle of the universe</note>. This also refers to the "Absolute Obscuration" of an entire planetary chain.
4. **Nitya** (Perpetual or Daily): This refers to the constant dissolution of the universe, including the death of an individual man. **Nitya** is the extinction of life, like the "extinguishing of a lamp," and also occurs during sleep at night. 

Just as **Nitya Sarga** is "constant or perpetual creation," **Nitya Pralaya** is the "constant or perpetual destruction of all that is born." "The creation that follows a minor dissolution is called ephemeral creation" (<note>original: *Vishnu Purana, Wilson’s Translation, i. 113, 114*</note>). This subject is so complex that we must repeat these explanations often.

### THE FOUR EARLIER RACES.

...of Humanity. This is even more likely... if... smaller disasters occurred, such as local floods, earthquakes, the falling of volcanic ash... the spread of sandy deserts, or the destruction of life by deadly plagues, foul air, or the release of sulfurous fumes.†

### THE ESOTERIC MEANING OF "FISH."

A massive fish and the Seven Rishis <note>original: "Rishis" — enlightened sages or seers in Hindu tradition</note> "with him." This allegory is very clear.

In the symbolism of every nation, the "Deluge" stands for chaotic, unsettled Matter—Chaos itself—and "Water" represents the Feminine Principle, the "Great Deep." As the Greek Lexicon by Parkhurst explains:

> *Archê* <note>original: ’Αρχὴ — Greek for "beginning" or "origin"</note> corresponds to the Hebrew *rasit* <note>original: "beginning" or "wisdom"</note>, or Wisdom... and [at the same time] to the symbol of the female generative power, the *arg* or *arca* <note>original: "ark" or "chest"</note>, in which the germ of nature [and of mankind] floats or broods on the great abyss of the waters during the interval that occurs after every mundane [or racial] cycle.

<margin>* St. Augustine says of Jesus: "He is a **fish** that lives in the midst of waters." Early Christians called themselves "Little Fishes"—*Pisciculi* <note>original Latin: "little fishes"</note>—in their sacred Mysteries. "So many fishes bred in the water, and saved by one great fish," says Tertullian of the Christians, Christ, and the Church.</margin>
*Archê* (’Αρχὴ) or "Ark" is also the mystic name of the Divine Spirit of Life which broods over Chaos. Now, **Vishnu** is the Divine Spirit, both as an abstract principle and as the Preserver and Generator, or Giver of Life. He is the third person of the **Trimûrti**—which is composed of Brahmâ the Creator, Shiva the Destroyer, and Vishnu the Preserver. In the allegory, Vishnu is shown in the form of a **Fish**, guiding the Ark of Vaivasvata Manu across the waters of the Flood. 

There is no need to speak at great length about the esoteric meaning of the word **Fish** (as authors like Payne Knight, Inman, Gerald Massey, and others have done). Its theological meaning is phallic <note>related to physical generation</note>, but its metaphysical meaning is divine. Jesus was called the "Fish," as were Vishnu and Bacchus. The letters **IHS** <note>original: ΙΗΣ</note>—the "Saviour" of Mankind—are actually the monogram of the god Bacchus, who was also called **ICHTHYS** <note>original: ΙΧΘΥΣ — Greek for "Fish"</note>.* Furthermore, the Seven Rishis in the Ark symbolized the seven "principles" <note>the layers of human consciousness and constitution</note>, which became complete in man only after he had separated and become a fully **human** being, thus ceasing to be a purely divine creature.

<margin>† *Esoteric Buddhism*, p. 55.</margin>

The history of the **Third Race**, or **Lemuria**, is provided, as is that of **Atlantis**, but the others are only mentioned briefly. Lemuria is said to have perished about 700,000 years before the start of what is now called the Tertiary Age (the *Eocene*).† During this Deluge—which was an actual geological flood this time—Vaivasvata Manu is also shown saving mankind allegorically. In reality, he saved a portion of it—the Fourth Race—just as he saved the Fifth Race during the destruction of the last...

The sinking of the great continent of Atlantis is the most interesting event. This is the catastrophe <note>original: "Cataclysm"</note> described in ancient records like the *Book of Enoch*, which says, "the ends of the Earth came loose." This event is the basis for the legends and symbolic stories of Vaivasvata <note>The Hindu figure equivalent to Noah</note>, Xisuthrus <note>The hero of the Babylonian flood myth</note>, Noah, Deucalion <note>The son of Prometheus in Greek mythology who survived the flood</note>, and all the rest of them <note>original Italian: "tutti quanti"</note> who represent the "Chosen Few" who were saved. Tradition often ignores the distinction between astronomical <note>original: "sidereal"</note> events and geological ones, calling both of them "Deluges" without distinction. However, there is a major difference. The catastrophe that destroyed the massive continent (of which Australia is the largest remaining piece) was caused by a series of underground tremors and the fracturing of the ocean floor. The event that destroyed its successor—the Fourth Continent—was caused by repeated shifts in the Earth's axis <note>original: "axial rotation"</note>. This process began during the early Tertiary period <note>A geological era beginning about 66 million years ago; Blavatsky argues it was the era of the Fourth Root-Race</note>. Over long ages, it gradually washed away the last traces of Atlantis, perhaps leaving only Sri Lanka <note>original: "Ceylon"</note> and a small part of modern Africa. It altered the entire surface of the globe. No record of its thriving continents, islands, civilizations, or sciences remains in historical chronicles, except within the Sacred Records of the East.

Because of this, modern science denies that Atlantis ever existed. It even denies that the Earth's axis has ever shifted violently, attributing climate changes to other causes. However, this is still a debated topic. While Dr. Croll <note>James Croll (1821–1890), a scientist who theorized that changes in the Earth's orbit caused the Ice Ages</note> insists that these changes are caused by nutation <note>A small, irregular "nodding" motion in the Earth's axis</note> and the precession of the equinoxes <note>The slow change in the orientation of Earth's rotational axis over a cycle of about 26,000 years</note>, other scientists like Sir Henry James and Sir John Lubbock <note>See *The Athenæum*, August 25, 1860</note> feel more inclined to believe they are caused by a shift in the axis of rotation itself. Most astronomers disagree with this. Yet, we must ask: what have scientists *not* denied or condemned in the past, only to accept it later once the theory became an undeniable fact?

# PRESENTMENTS OF TRUTHS.

Under the guidance of their *divine* rulers, they built large cities, cultivated arts and sciences, and mastered astronomy, architecture, and mathematics to perfection. The primeval civilization of the Lemurians did not, as one might think, immediately follow their physical transformation. Between their final physiological evolution and the construction of their first city, many hundreds of thousands of years had passed. Nevertheless, we find the Lemurians in their sixth sub-race building their first rock cities out of stone and lava.\* One of these great cities of primitive construction was built entirely of lava, about thirty miles west of where Easter Island now stretches its narrow strip of barren ground; it was totally destroyed by a series of volcanic eruptions. The oldest remains of "Cyclopean" <note>A style of ancient masonry using massive, irregular stone blocks without mortar</note> buildings were all the handiwork of the last sub-races of the Lemurians. An Occultist, therefore, shows no surprise on learning that the stone relics which were found on the small piece of land called Easter Island by Captain Cook, are:

->Very much like the walls of the Temple of Pachacamac or the Ruins of Tiahuanaco in Peru,†<-

and also that they are built in the *Cyclopean* style. The first large cities, however, were built in that region of the continent which is now known as the island of Madagascar. There were civilized people and savages in those days, just as there are now. Evolution achieved its work of perfection on the former, and Karma—its work of destruction—on the latter. The Australians and those like them are the descendants of those savages.

These groups, instead of giving life to the Spark projected into them by the "Flames" <note>The "Flames" are high-ranking celestial beings or creative fire-spirits in Theosophical cosmology</note>, extinguished it through long generations of primitive, animalistic behavior.\* In contrast, the Aryan nations could trace their descent through the Atlanteans from the more spiritual races of the Lemurians, in whom the "Sons of Wisdom" had personally incarnated.†

It was with the arrival of the divine Dynasties that the first civilizations began. While in some regions of the Earth, a portion of mankind preferred leading a nomadic and simple patriarchal life—and in others, savage man was barely learning to build a fire and protect himself against the elements—his brothers, more favored than he by their Karma <note>The law of cause and effect governing one's destiny</note> and helped by the divine intelligence that dwelled within them, built cities and cultivated arts and sciences. Civilization has always developed the physical and the intellectual at the cost of the psychic and spiritual. The command over and the guidance of one's own psychic nature—which foolish men now associate with the "supernatural"—were innate and present from birth in early humanity; they came to man as naturally as walking and thinking.

### THE HINDU SYMBOLIZATION

It is nothing of the kind. Because Orientalists <note>Western scholars who study Eastern cultures and languages</note> know nothing of the Secret Teaching, they persist in taking everything *literally*, and then conclude the texts are flawed.

### THE ATLANTIC OCEAN-FLOW

This was the state of the majority of humanity in that region during the era of the Third Race <note>The Third Root-Race, or Lemurians, in Theosophical chronology</note>, when the gigantic continent of Lemuria began separating into smaller continents. According to the explanations in the *Commentary* <note>Referring to the "Book of Dzyan" commentaries</note>, this is due to a decrease in the speed of the Earth's rotation:

> *When the Wheel [the Earth] runs at the usual rate, its extremities [the poles] agree with its middle Circle [the equator]. When it runs slower and tilts in every direction, there is a great disturbance on the face of the Earth. The waters flow toward the two ends, and new lands arise in the middle Belt [equatorial lands], while those at the ends are subject to Pralayas <term>Periods of dissolution or destruction</term> by submersion.*

And again:

> *Thus the Wheel [the Earth] is subject to, and regulated by, the Spirit of the Moon, regarding the breath of its waters [tides]. Toward the close of the age [Kalpa <term>A vast period of time in Hindu cosmology</term>] of a great [Root-] Race, the Regents of the Moon [the Fathers, or Pitris <term>Spiritual ancestors or progenitors of humanity</term>] begin drawing harder, and thus flatten the Wheel about its Belt. When this happens, the Earth goes down in some places and swells in others; as the swelling moves toward the extremities [poles], new lands will arise and old ones will be sucked in.*

We only have to read astronomical and geological works to see the meaning of the above very clearly. Scientists—*modern specialists*—have confirmed the influence of the tides on the geological distribution of land and water on the planet. They have noted the shifting of the oceans along with the corresponding sinking and rising of continents and new lands. Science knows, or thinks it knows, that this occurs periodically.* Professor Todd believes he can trace these series of oscillations back to the periods of the Earth's first formation of a crust.† Therefore, it seems easy for Science to verify the esoteric statement. We propose to treat this at greater length in the Addenda.

Regarding stones, we may gather every available piece of evidence to show that: (a) if there had been no giants to move such colossal rocks, there could never have been a <term>Stonehenge</term> (the famous prehistoric monument in England), a <term>Carnac</term> (the massive stone alignments in Brittany, France), or other such <term>Cyclopean</term> <note>original: "Cyclopean" — refers to ancient masonry built with massive, irregular stones without mortar, once believed to be the work of the mythical giants called Cyclopes.</note> structures; and (b) if there were no such thing as Magic, there could never have been so many witnesses to "oracular" and "speaking" stones.

# LIVING, SPEAKING, AND MOVING STONES.

...even as mortals as we are? It is not our intention to list all the various traditions associated with "rocking stones." However, it is worth reminding the English reader of Giraldus Cambrensis <note>Gerald of Wales (c. 1146–1223), a chronicler and cleric</note>, who describes such a stone on the Isle of Anglesey <note>original: Isle of Mona</note>. This stone reportedly returned to its original spot despite every effort to move it elsewhere. During the conquest of Ireland by King Henry II, a man named Hugh d'Avranches, Earl of Chester <note>original: Count Hugo Cestrensis</note>, wanted to test the truth of this story. He tied the Anglesey stone to a much larger one and had them both thrown into the sea. The next morning, the stone was found back in its usual place. 

The learned William of Salisbury <note>referring to William Salesbury (c. 1520–1584), a Welsh scholar and translator</note> confirmed this by reporting that he saw it embedded in a church wall in 1554. This brings to mind the account by Pliny the Elder regarding the stone left by the Argonauts at Cyzicus <note>original: Cyzicum</note>. The people of that city placed it in the town hall <note>original: Prytaneum</note>, "from which it *ran away several times, so they were forced to weigh it down with lead.*" <note>original: *Natural History*, Book 36, p. 592</note>. Here we see massive stones described throughout antiquity as "living, moving, speaking, and walking on their own." It seems they were even capable of making people flee; they were called *routers*, from the word "rout" or "to put to flight." The author Des Mousseaux shows that these were all prophetic stones, sometimes called "mad stones." <note>original: *Dieu et les Dieux* (God and the Gods), p. 567.</note>

Modern science acknowledges the existence of rocking stones. But why did they rock? It is clear that this movement was one more method used for divination <term>the practice of seeking knowledge of the future or the unknown by supernatural means</term>. For this very reason, they were called the "stones of truth." <note>original: De Mirville, in the work cited, p. 291.</note>

They are generally arranged in vertical lines with many variations in size and pattern. 

Anyone who carefully examines the drawings of such marks in the *Archaeological Notes on Ancient Sculpturing on Rocks in Kumaon, India, etc.*, will find a very primitive style of record-keeping. The largest of them are clearly the relics of the Atlanteans; the smaller ones, such as Brimham Rocks with revolving stones on their summit, are copies of the more ancient *lithoi* <term>sacred stones</term>. Had the Bishops of the Middle Ages not destroyed all the maps and plans of the *Dracontia* they could lay their hands on, Science would know more of these structures.‡ As it is, we know that they were used universally during long prehistoric ages, and all for the same purposes of prophecy and magic. Édouard Biot, a member of the Institute of France, published an article in the *Antiquities of France* showing that the *Chatampéramba* (the "Field of Death," or ancient burial ground in Malabar, India) is identical in its layout to the old tombs at Carnac in Brittany; that is to say, they both feature "a prominent mound and a central tomb." Bones are found in the tombs, and the scholar Mr. Halliwell tells us that some of these are enormous; the natives call the tombs the "dwellings of the *Rakshasas*" <term>demonic giants in Hindu mythology</term>. Several stone circles—"considered the work of the *Panch Pandava* <term>the five Pandu brothers, heroes of the Indian epic Mahabharata</term>, as all such monuments are in India, where they are found in great numbers"—when opened by the direction of Rajah Vasariddi, "were found to contain *human bones of a very large size*."§

But if the monstrous *Iguanodon* of the Wealden <note>A geological formation in England where large dinosaur fossils were first discovered</note> may have been the ancestor of the tiny Iguana of today, why could the giant man of the *Secret Doctrine* not have become the modern man—the link between Animal and Angel? Occult Sciences may be less "scientific" than today's Exact Sciences, but they are nonetheless more logical and consistent in their teachings. Physical forces and the natural attractions of atoms may be sufficient factors to transform a plant into an animal; but it requires more than the mere interaction between certain material clusters and their environment to bring a *fully conscious man* to life—even if he were indeed nothing more than a branch between two "poor cousins" of the primate order <term>original: quadrumanous; four-handed</term>. Suppose an Occultist were to claim that the first grand organ of a cathedral had come into being as follows: first, there was a progressive and gradual development in space of an organizable material, which resulted in the production of a state of matter named *organic protein*; then, under the influence of external forces, these states were thrown into a phase of unstable equilibrium, and they slowly and majestically evolved into new combinations of carved and polished wood, of brass pins and staples, of leather and ivory, wind-pipes and bellows. Then, after having adapted all its parts into one harmonious and symmetrical machine, the organ suddenly pealed forth Mozart’s “Requiem”; this was followed by a Sonata of Beethoven, and so on, to infinity <note>original: ad infinitum</note>, its keys playing on their own and the wind blowing into the pipes by its own inherent force and whim. Whatever may have been the real inner thought of Mr. Herbert Spencer <note>A prominent 19th-century English philosopher who applied evolutionary theory to philosophy and psychology.</note> when writing on the subject of the gradual transformation of species, his words apply to our doctrine:

> Interpreted in terms of evolution, every kind of being is conceived as a product of modifications wrought by imperceptible gradations on a *pre-existing kind of being*.*

Then why, in this case, should not historical man be the product of a modification of a pre-existent and prehistoric kind of man—even if we suppose, for the sake of argument, that there is *nothing* within him that lasts longer than, or lives independently of, his physical structure? ### SERPENTS AND DRAGONS UNDER DIFFERENT SYMBOLISMS.

The name of the Dragon in Chaldea <note>An ancient region in Mesopotamia, often associated with early astrology and magic</note> was not written phonetically, but was represented by two monograms <note>symbols or ideograms</note> meaning *probably*, according to Orientalist scholars, the "scaly one." "This description," George Smith <note>A pioneering English Assyriologist (1840–1876) who discovered the "Chaldean Account of Genesis"</note> very pertinently remarks, "of course might apply either to a fabulous dragon, a serpent, or a fish." To this we may add that, in one aspect, it applies to *Makara* <note>original: Makara; the Sanskrit name for the tenth Zodiacal sign, Capricorn</note>, the tenth Zodiacal Sign. This is a Sanskrit term for a nondescript amphibious animal, generally called a "Crocodile," but it really signifies something else entirely. This, then, is a virtual admission that the Assyriologists <note>scholars who study ancient Mesopotamia</note>, at all events, know nothing certain as to the true status of the Dragon in ancient Chaldea. It was from Chaldea that the Hebrews *obtained their symbolism*, only to be afterwards robbed of it by the Christians, who turned the "scaly one" into a living entity and a malevolent power.

# WHO WERE ENOCH AND THE OTHERS?

The Aletae <note>original: "Aletæ", ancient Phoenician deities</note> are identified with the Kabiri <note>mysterious deities worshipped in the ancient world, often associated with creation and protection</note>. We have shown that the Kabiri are the same as the Manus, the Rishis, and our Dhyan Chohans <note>divine beings or "Lords of Meditation"</note> who incarnated into the chosen individuals of the Third and Fourth Root Races. Thus, while in the study of the gods <note>original: "Theogony"</note> the Kabiri-Titans were seen as seven Great Gods, in a cosmic and astronomical sense, the Titans were called Atlantes. This is perhaps because, as the scholar Faber suggests, they were connected with *at-al-as* (the "divine sun") and with *tit* (the "deluge"). 

If true, however, this is only the public <note>original: "exoteric"</note> version. In the hidden <note>original: "esoteric"</note> sense, the meaning of their symbols depends on the title used. The seven mysterious, awe-inspiring Great Gods—the Dioscuri,* the deities surrounded by the darkness of hidden Nature—become the *Idaei Dactyli*, or the "Fingers of Ida," associated with the master healers <note>original: "Adept-healers"</note> who worked with metals. Sanchuniathon <note>a Phoenician author</note> translates the word *Aletae* as "fire worshippers," while Faber believes it comes from *al-orit*, or the "God of fire."

Mystically, as the Lares, they were the Regents <note>spiritual governors</note> of these planets—our protectors and rulers.

<header>THE SECRET DOCTRINE.</header>

The word *Kabirim* <note>original Hebrew/Semitic term meaning "Great Ones"</note> contains the idea of "the powerful, the mighty, and the great," corresponding to the Greek *megaloi* and *dynatoi* <note>original Greek: μεγάλοι, δυνατοί; meaning "great ones" and "powerful ones"</note>, though these are later titles. These Gods were universally worshipped, and their origin is lost in the night of time. Yet whether they were honored in Phrygia, Phoenicia, the Troad, Thrace, Egypt, Lemnos, or Sicily, their cult was always connected with Fire. Their temples were always built in the most volcanic locations, and in public <note>original: "exoteric"</note> worship, they belonged to the Underworld <note>original: "Chthonian"</note> Divinities. Because of this, Christianity has turned them into *Infernal* <note>hellish or demonic</note> Gods.

They are truly "the great, beneficent, and powerful Gods," as Cassius Hemina <note>original: "Hermione", likely referring to the Roman historian Cassius Hemina</note> calls them.\* At Thebes, Core <note>another name for Persephone</note> and Demeter—who were considered among the Kabiri—had a sanctuary,† and at Memphis, the Kabiri had a temple so sacred that none, except for the priests, were permitted to enter its holy precincts.‡ But we must not, at the same time, lose sight of the fact that the title of Kabiri was a general <note>original: "generic"</note> name. These Kabiri—the mighty Gods as well as mortals—were of both sexes, and were also terrestrial, celestial, and cosmic. While in their later role as rulers of sidereal <note>star-based</note> and terrestrial powers, they symbolized geological phenomena (as they are now regarded), they were also, in the beginning of time, the Rulers of Mankind. When they incarnated as Kings of the "Divine Dynasties," they gave the first impulse to civilization. They directed the human mind—with which they had endowed men—toward the invention and perfection of all the arts and sciences. Thus, the Kabiri are said to have appeared as the benefactors of men, and as such, they lived for ages in the memory of nations. To these Kabiri, or Titans, is ascribed the invention of letters (the *Devanagari* <note>the script used for Sanskrit</note>, or the alphabet and language of the Gods), of laws and legislation, of architecture, as well as the various modes of so-called magic, and the medical use of plants. Hermes, Orpheus, Cadmus, Asclepius—all those Demigods and Heroes to whom the revelation of sciences to men is ascribed—are general names. Writers like Bryant, Faber, Bishop Cumberland, and so many other Christian authors—who were too zealous for their own version of the truth—would force future generations to see in these figures only Pagan copies of one single prototype named Noah.

It is the Kabiri who are credited with having revealed the great blessing of agriculture by *producing* corn or wheat. What Isis and Osiris—the once living "Kabiri"—did in Egypt, Ceres is said to have done in Sicily; they all belong to one class.

### HERMES IN ASTRONOMY AND ELSEWHERE.

It is said that this prince [Isis-Osiris] built cities in Egypt and controlled the flooding of the Nile. He is credited with inventing agriculture, the cultivation of the vine, music, astronomy, and geometry.

When Abul Feda, in his *Pre-Islamic History*<note>original: "Historia Anteislamitica"</note>, says that the "<term>Sabæan</term><note>The Sabæans were an ancient people of South Arabia often associated with star worship and early astronomical science.</note> language" was established by Seth and Edris (Enoch)—he means Astronomy. In the *Melelwa Nahil*<note>A medieval Arabic manuscript</note>, Hermes is called the disciple of Agathodæmon <note>In Greek and Egyptian mythology, the "Good Spirit" or a protective deity</note>. And in another account, Agathodæmon is mentioned as a "King of Egypt." The writer Celepas Geraldinus gives us some intriguing traditions about Henoch (Enoch), who is called the "Divine Giant." In his book, *The Various Names of the Nile*, the historian Ahmed Ben Yusouf Eltiphas describes a belief among the Semitic Arabs that Seth—who later became the Egyptian Typhon or Set—had been one of the Seven Angels, or Patriarchs, in the Bible. According to this tradition, he became a mortal and the son of Adam, after which he passed the gift of prophecy and astronomical science to Jared, who then passed it to his son Henoch. But Henoch (Idris), "the author of thirty books," was "Sabæan by origin"—meaning he belonged to the *Saba*, or "a Host" <note>Referring to the "host of heaven," or the stars</note>:

> Having established the rites and ceremonies of primitive worship, he went to the East, where he constructed one hundred and forty cities (of which Edessa was the least important), then returned to Egypt where he became its King.

Thus, he is identified with Hermes. However, there were said to be five different versions of Hermes—or rather one being who appeared, just as some <term>Manus</term> and <term>Rishis</term><note>In Hindu tradition, these are progenitor-beings and inspired sages who appear at the start of various cycles of time.</note> did, in several different identities. In the *Burham i Kati*, he is mentioned as Hormig, a name for the Planet Mercury or <term>Budha</term><note>The Hindu name for the planet Mercury, not to be confused with Gautama Buddha.</note>; both Hermes and Thoth were associated with Wednesday. The Hermes of Oriental tradition was worshipped by the people of Pheneos <note>original: "Phineatæ"</note> and is said to have fled to Egypt after the death of Argus, where he civilized the land under the name of Thoth. But regardless of which identity he takes, he is always credited with bringing all the sciences from potential to practical application—that is, with being the first to teach Magic to Egypt and Greece. This occurred before the era of *Magna Græcia* <note>original: "Magna Græcia"; the Greek-speaking coastal areas of Southern Italy</note>, during a time when the Greeks were not yet even known as Hellenes.

THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

The entire series of classical authors supports him. Diodorus, Eratosthenes, Plato, Manetho, and others repeat the same story and never vary in the order they provide.

As Creuzer shows:

> It is, indeed, from the spheres of the stars where the gods of light dwell that wisdom descends to the lower spheres. . . . In the system of the ancient priests [Hierophants <note>High-ranking priests who interpreted sacred mysteries</note> and Adepts], all things without exception—Gods, Genii, Souls [Manes <note>The spirits of ancestors or deceased experts</note>], and the whole world—are developed together in space and time. The pyramid may be considered the symbol of this magnificent hierarchy of spirits.*

It is modern historians—chiefly French Academicians like Renan—who have made more effort to suppress the truth by ignoring the ancient annals of "Divine Kings" than is strictly honest. But Ernest Renan could never have been more unwilling than Eratosthenes (260 B.C.) to accept such an unpalatable fact; yet Eratosthenes found himself obliged to recognize its truth. For this, the great Astronomer is treated with much contempt by his colleagues 2,000 years later. In their view, Manetho becomes "a superstitious priest born and bred in the atmosphere of other lying priests of Heliopolis." As the scholar of the supernatural <note>original: "Demonologist"</note> De Mirville justly remarks:

> *All those historians and priests, who are so truthful when repeating stories of human kings and men, suddenly become extremely suspicious the moment they go back to the era of their gods.*

However, there is the <term>synchronistic table</term> <note>A chart showing events occurring at the same time across different regions</note> of Abydos. Thanks to the genius of Champollion <note>The scholar who first deciphered Egyptian hieroglyphs</note>, this table has now proven the honesty of the Egyptian priests (especially Manetho) and of Ptolemy in the Turin Papyrus, which is the most remarkable record of all. In the words of the Egyptologist De Rougé:

> *Champollion, struck with amazement, found that he had before his own eyes the remains of a list of Dynasties reaching back to the furthest mythical times, or the* Reigns of the Gods and Heroes. . . . *At the very beginning of this curious papyrus, we are forced to conclude that, even as far back as the period of Ramses, these mythical and heroic traditions were exactly as Manetho had passed them down to us. We see appearing in them, as Kings of Egypt, the Gods Seb, Osiris, Set, Horus, Thoth-Hermes, and the Goddess Ma, with a vast period of centuries assigned to the reign of each.†*

These synchronistic tables had never been traced back further than Manetho—not to mention the fact that they were distorted by Eusebius <note>A 4th-century Christian historian often accused of altering chronologies to fit biblical timelines</note> for dishonest purposes. Now, although it is said that Africa appeared as a continent before Europe, it nevertheless emerged later than <term>Lemuria</term> <note>A hypothetical "lost continent" in the Indian or Pacific Ocean, popularized in 19th-century science and occultism</note> and even the earliest <term>Atlantis</term>. The entire region of what is now Egypt and its deserts was once upon a time covered by the sea. This was made known, firstly, by Herodotus, Strabo, Pliny, and others, and secondly, through the findings of Geology. Abyssinia <note>Historical name for the region of Ethiopia</note> was once an island, and the Nile Delta was the first country occupied by the pioneer emigrants who came with their Gods from the northeast.

When did this happen? History is silent on the subject. Fortunately, we have the <term>Dendera Zodiac</term> <note>A famous ancient Egyptian celestial map found on the ceiling of a temple dedicated to Hathor</note>—the planisphere on the ceiling of one of the oldest Egyptian temples—to record the fact. This Zodiac, with its mysterious three "Virgos" placed between Leo and Libra, has found its <term>Oedipus</term> <note>A person who solves a difficult riddle, referencing the Greek hero</note> to understand the secret of its signs. It justifies the truthfulness of those priests who told Herodotus that their Initiates taught: (a) that the poles of the Earth and the <term>Ecliptic</term> <note>The apparent path of the Sun; the text suggests the Earth's tilt was once different</note> had formerly coincided, and (b) that even since their first zodiacal records were commenced, the Poles have been within the plane of the Ecliptic three times.

<term>Bailly</term> <note>Jean-Sylvain Bailly (1736–1793), a prominent French astronomer and historian of science</note> could not find words enough to express his surprise at the similarity of all such traditions regarding the "Divine Races," and he exclaims:

It was during that period that those benefactors of humanity descended to Earth and taught men to calculate the course of the sun and moon by the twelve signs of the Zodiac.†*

Nearly five hundred years before the present era, the priests of Egypt showed Herodotus the statues of their human Kings and Pontiffs—the <term>Piromis</term> <note>According to Herodotus, a term meaning "noble and good," used to describe these high officials</note>—the Arch-prophets or <term>Maha Chohans</term> <note>A Theosophical term for great spiritual masters or heads of a hierarchy</note> of the temples, who were *born one from the other* without the intervention of woman, and who had reigned before Menes, their first *human* King. # WHAT ARE "SPIRITS"?

Without such a psychological link, and the feeling of its presence, no science can ever progress, and the realm of knowledge must be limited only to the analysis of physical matter.

Occultists believe in "spirits" because they *feel*—and some even see—themselves surrounded by them on every side.* Materialists do not. They live on this Earth just as certain creatures in the world of insects and even fish live surrounded by countless thousands <note>original: "myriads"</note> of their own kind without seeing or even sensing them.†

Plato is the first wise man <note>original: "sage"</note> among classical writers who speaks at length about the "Divine Dynasties." He locates them on a vast continent which he calls Atlantis. Neither Bailly <note>Jean Sylvain Bailly (1736–1793), a French astronomer who theorized about the origins of civilization and Atlantis.</note> was the first, nor the last, to believe this. He had been preceded and anticipated in this theory by Father Kircher, the learned Jesuit, who in his *Oedipus Aegyptiacus* <note>Egyptian Oedipus (1652), a massive scholarly work on Egyptology and comparative religion.</note>, writes:

> I confess, for a long time I had regarded all this [the Dynasties and Atlantis] as pure nonsense <note>original Latin: *meras nugas*</note> until the day when, being better instructed in Oriental languages, I judged that all those legends must be, after all, only the development of a great truth.‡

As De Rougemont shows, Theopompus, in his work *Meropis*, described the priests of Phrygia and Asia Minor speaking exactly as the priests of Saïs <note>An ancient Egyptian city in the Nile Delta.</note> did when they revealed the history and fate of Atlantis to Solon <note>A famous Athenian statesman and poet (c. 638–558 BCE).</note>. According to Theopompus, it was a unique continent of an indefinite size, containing two countries inhabited by two races—a fighting one...

Although seen by millions of various other fish and creatures surrounding it, the *Amphioxus* species—having neither a brain nor any of the senses possessed by other classes—does not see them. ->**PLATO'S IDEA OF EVIL.**<-

If one listens to traditions, they place the reign of heroes and divine beings <note>original: "Demi-gods"</note> before the reign of kings; and even earlier still, they place the marvelous reign of the Gods and all the myths of the Golden Age. . . . One feels surprised that annals so interesting should have been rejected by almost all our historians. And yet the ideas presented by them were once universally admitted and revered by all nations; not a few revere them still, making them the basis of their daily life. Such considerations seem to make a less hurried judgment necessary. . . . The ancients—from whom we have these traditions, which *we no longer accept because we no longer understand them*—must have had motives for believing in them. They were closer to those first ages, a proximity that the distance separating us from them denies to us. . . . Plato, in the fourth book of his *Laws*, says that long before the construction of the first cities, Saturn had established on earth a certain form of government under which man was very happy. Now, as he is referring to the Golden Age, or to 그 reign of the Gods so celebrated in ancient myths, . . . let us see what ideas he had of that happy age, and what occasion he had to introduce this *fable* into a treatise on politics.

According to Plato, in order to obtain clear and precise ideas on royalty, its origin and power, one has to turn back to the first principles of history and tradition. Great changes, he says, have occurred in days of old, in *heaven and on earth*, and the present state of things is one of the results [Karma] <note>The law of cause and effect, or the cosmic debt inherited from past actions.</note>. Our traditions tell us of many marvels, of changes that have taken place in the course of the sun, of Saturn's reign, and of a thousand other matters that remain scattered in human memory; but one never hears anything of the evil which *has produced* these revolutions, nor of the evil which directly *followed* them. Yet . . . that Evil is the primary principle one has to talk about to be able to treat the subjects of royalty and the origin of power.*

Plato seems to see that Evil in the sameness or "consubstantiality" <note>Sharing the same substance or nature.</note> of the natures of the rulers and the ruled. He says that long before man built his cities, in the Golden Age, there was nothing but happiness on Earth, for there were no needs. Why? Because Saturn, knowing that man could not rule man without injustice immediately filling the universe through his whims and vanity, would not allow any mortal to obtain power over his fellow creatures. To prevent this, the God used the same means we ourselves use with regard to our flocks. We do not place a bullock or a ram over our bullocks and rams, but give them a leader, a shepherd—that is, a being of a species quite different from their own and of a superior nature. This is just what Saturn did. He loved mankind and placed no mortal king or prince to rule over it, but—"Spirits and Genii (<term>daimones</term> <note>original Greek: δαιμονες; here meaning divine guiding spirits rather than modern "demons."</note>) of a divine nature more excellent than that of man."

It was God (the Logos <note>The "Word" or the divine Reason acting as the creative principle of the universe.</note>, the Synthesis of the Heavenly Host), who thus presiding over these Genii became the first Shepherd and Leader of men.†
