# THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

When the world was no longer governed by these divine beings and the Gods withdrew, ferocious wild animals began to prey on humanity. Left to their own resources and hard work, inventors then appeared among them one after another and discovered fire, wheat, and wine; out of public gratitude, these inventors were then treated as gods.*

And mankind was right to do so, as creating fire through friction was the first mystery of nature—the first and most important property of matter that was revealed to human beings.

As the ancient Commentaries say:

> *Fruits and grain, which were unknown to Earth until that day, were brought by the "Lords of Wisdom" for the benefit of those they ruled from other Spheres <note>original: "Lokas"</note>.*

Now:

The earliest inventions of mankind are the most wonderful that our race has ever made. . . . The first use of fire and the discovery of the methods by which it can be started; the domestication of animals; and, above all, the processes by which the various cereals were first developed out of wild grasses—these are all discoveries with which no subsequent inventions can compare in terms of ingenuity and importance. They are all unknown to history—all lost in the light of a glowing dawn.†

This will be doubted and denied in our proud generation. But if it is claimed that there are no grains or fruits unknown to the earth, then we may remind the reader *that wheat has never been found in a wild state; it is not a natural product of the earth's own evolution*. All other cereals have been traced to their original forms in various species of wild grasses, but wheat has so far defied the efforts of botanists to trace it to its origin. Let us also keep in mind how sacred this grain was to the Egyptian priests; wheat was even placed with their mummies and has been found thousands of years later in their coffins. Remember how the servants of Horus <note>The Egyptian sky god, son of Osiris and Isis.</note> gather the wheat in the Field of Aanroo <note>A region of the Egyptian afterlife, also known as the Field of Reeds.</note>—wheat that grows *seven cubits <term>Cubit: an ancient unit of measurement based on the length of the forearm, roughly 18–20 inches.</term> high*.‡

# WHEAT BROUGHT DOWN BY THE GODS.

The Egyptian goddess Isis says:

> I am the Queen of these regions; I was the first to reveal to mortals the mysteries of wheat and corn. . . . I am she who rises in the constellation of the Dog. . . . Rejoice, O Egypt! You who were my nurse. <note>original: "wert my nurse." Source: I. xiv. Egyptologists have incorrectly tried to identify the god Osiris with the historical king Menes. The scholar Bunsen dates Menes to 5,867 B.C., a date often challenged by Christian chronologists. Sirius was called the Dog Star. It was the star associated with Mercury or Budha, who was known as the great Teacher of Humanity.

The Chinese *Y-King* <note>original: "I Ching" or "Book of Changes"</note> attributes the discovery of agriculture to "the instruction given to men by heavenly spirits <note>original: "celestial genii"</note>."

Woe, woe to the men who know nothing, observe nothing, and refuse to see. They are all blind <note>In the original text, the author uses the terms "corked up" or "screwed up."</note> because they remain ignorant of how full the world is of various and invisible creatures that crowd even into the most sacred places. <note>original: *Zohar*, part i, col. 177; De Mirville, ibid., p. 88.</note>

The "Sons of God" have existed and *do* exist. From the Hindu *Brahmaputras* and *Manasaputras* <term>Mind-born Sons of Brahma</term> down to the *Bne Aleim* <note>original: Hebrew "Bnei Ha-Elohim," or "Sons of God"</note> of the Jewish *Bible*, the faith of centuries and universal tradition force reason to yield to such evidence. What is the value of so-called "independent criticism" or "internal evidence"—usually based on the personal biases of the critics—in the face of universal testimony that has never varied throughout historical cycles? For instance, read the sixth chapter of *Genesis* esoterically. It repeats the statements of the Secret Doctrine, though it slightly changes the form and draws a different conclusion that even conflicts with the *Zohar*.

> There were giants in the earth in those days; *and also after that*, when the sons of God [*Bne Aleim*] came in unto the daughters of men, and they bore children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown [or giants]. <note>original: *Genesis*, vi. 4.</note>

What does this sentence, "and also after that," signify? It means there were Giants on the Earth *before*—meaning before the Sinless Sons of the Third Race <note>A reference to an earlier stage of human evolution in theosophical chronology</note>—*and also after that*, when other Sons of God, lower in nature, began sexual relationships on Earth. This is similar to the story of Daksha <note>A creator figure in Hindu mythology</note> in Hindu tradition, who acted when he saw that his "Mind-born Sons" would not populate the Earth. Furthermore, there is a long break in the biblical chapter between verses 4 and 5. Surely, the decline of humanity was not caused by the "mighty men . . . men of renown," among whom Nimrod is placed.

->### THE MYSTERY OF AZAZEL.<-

But Azazel, whom Church doctrine persists in associating with Satan, is nothing of the kind. Azazel is a mystery, as explained elsewhere, and it is described this way by Maimonides <note>Moses Maimonides (1138–1204) was a preeminent Jewish philosopher and scholar; this reference is to his work "The Guide for the Perplexed."</note>:

> There is an impenetrable mystery in the narrative concerning Azazel.*

And so there is, as Lanci—a librarian at the Vatican whom we have quoted before, and someone who ought to know—says:

> This divine and venerable name <note>original Italian: *nome divino e venerabile*</note> has become, through the pens of biblical scholars, a devil, a wilderness, a mountain, and a he-goat.†

Therefore, it seems foolish to derive the name, as Spencer <note>John Spencer (1630–1693) was an English theologian who wrote extensively on Hebrew ritual.</note> does, from *Azal* ("separated") and *El* ("God"), implying "one separated from God"—the Devil. In the *Zohar* <term>The foundational work of Jewish Kabbalah</term>, Azazel is considered a "sacrificial victim" rather than the "formal adversary of Jehovah," as Spencer would argue.‡

The amount of malicious imagination and fiction bestowed on this "Host" by various fanatical writers is quite extraordinary. Azazel and his "Host" are simply the Hebrew "Prometheus" <note>In Greek mythology, Prometheus was a Titan who stole fire from the gods to give to humanity, bringing them civilization but suffering eternal punishment for it.</note>, and they ought to be viewed from the same perspective. The *Zohar* shows the *Ischins* <note>original: "Ischins," likely referring to the Ishim, a rank of angels often associated with the souls of righteous men or lower spiritual messengers</note> chained to the mountain in the desert. This is allegorical and simply refers to these "Spirits" being chained to the Earth during the Cycle of Incarnation. 

Azazel, or Azazyel, is one of the chiefs of the "transgressing" Angels in the *Book of Enoch*. These angels, descending upon Ardis (the top of Mount Hermon), bound themselves by swearing loyalty to each other. It is said that Azazyel taught men to make swords, knives, and shields; to fabricate mirrors; and to make *one see what is behind him*—that is, "magic mirrors." Amazarak taught all the sorcerers and those who divide roots; Amers taught the solution of Magic; Barkayal taught Astrology; Akibeel taught the meaning of portents and signs; Tamiel taught Astronomy; and Asaradel taught the motion of the Moon.§ 

"These seven were the first instructors of the fourth man" (meaning, the Fourth Race). But why should allegory always be understood as meaning only what its literal sense expresses?

It is the symbolic representation of the great struggle between Divine Wisdom (*Nous* <note>Greek: "Mind" or "Intellect"</note>) and its Earthly Reflection (*Psuche* <note>Greek: "Soul" or "Breath of Life"</note>), or between Spirit and Soul, in Heaven and on Earth. In Heaven—because the Divine Monad <term>The fundamental, indivisible spiritual spark of an individual</term> had voluntarily exiled itself from there to descend, for the purpose of incarnating, to a lower plane and thus transform the "animal of clay" into an immortal God. For, as Éliphas Lévi <note>Alphonse Louis Constant (1810–1875), a famous French occultist and author.</note> tells us:

# DRUNKEN INDRA

Read the account of Indra (Vayu) in the *Rig Veda*, the pre-eminent <note>original: "par excellence"</note> occult volume of Aryanism, and then compare it with the account in the *Puranas*—the public version and the intentionally distorted account of the true Wisdom Religion. In the *Rig Veda*, Indra is the highest and greatest of the Gods, and his drinking of Soma <term>A ritual drink in ancient India associated with spiritual ecstasy and immortality.</term> is symbolic of his highly spiritual nature. In the *Puranas*, Indra becomes a degenerate and a regular drunkard on the Soma juice in the ordinary worldly way. He is the conqueror of all the "enemies of the Gods"—the Daityas, Nagas (Serpents), Asuras <note>Classes of supernatural beings often depicted as "demons" in later mythology, but originally representing different spiritual forces.</note>, all the Serpent-gods, and of Vritra, the Cosmic Serpent. Indra is the St. Michael of the Hindu Pantheon—the chief of the militant heavenly army. Turning to the Bible, we find Satan, one of the "Sons of God,"* becoming in public interpretation the Devil and the Dragon in its hellish, evil sense. But in the *Kabbalah*†, Samael, who is Satan, is shown to be identical with St. Michael, the Slayer of the Dragon. How can this be, when it is said that *Tselem* (the Image) reflects both Michael and Samael, *who are one*? It is taught that both proceed from *Ruach* (Spirit), *Neshamah* (Soul), and *Nephesh* (Life). In the *Chaldean Book of Numbers*, Samael is the hidden (occult) Wisdom, and Michael is the higher earthly Wisdom; both emerge from the same source but branch off after they leave the World Soul. On Earth, this soul is *Mahat* (intellectual understanding) or *Manas* (the seat of the intellect). They diverge because one (Michael) *is influenced* by *Neshamah* (the Soul), while the other (Samael) remains *uninfluenced*. This principle was distorted by the narrow-minded spirit of the Church. Loathing any independent spirit that was not controlled by external forms or dogma, the Church immediately turned Samael-Satan—the wisest and most spiritual of all spirits—into the Adversary of its human-like God and physical man: the Devil!

Seth, the supposed ancestor of Israel, is merely a Jewish adaptation <note>original: "travesty"</note> of Hermes, the God of Wisdom, also known as Thoth, Tat, Seth, Set, and Satan. He is also Typhon, identical to Apophis, the Dragon killed by Horus; for Typhon was also called Set. He is simply the *dark side* of Osiris, his brother, just as the spirit of darkness <note>original: "Angra Mainyu"</note> is the black shadow of the spirit of light <note>original: "Ahura Mazda"</note>. On a worldly level, all these allegories were connected with the trials of achieving spiritual mastery <note>original: "Adeptship"</note> and initiation. Astronomically, they referred to solar and lunar eclipses. The mythical explanations for these are found to this day in India and Sri Lanka <note>original: "Ceylon"</note>, where anyone can study the allegorical stories and traditions that have remained unchanged for many thousands of years.

In mythology, Râhu is a giant <note>original: "Daitya"</note>—a demi-god whose lower body ended in a dragon’s or serpent’s tail. During the Churning of the Ocean, when the Gods produced the Nectar of Immortality <note>original: "Amrita"</note>, he stole some of it and became immortal by drinking it. The Sun and Moon, who had caught him in his theft, reported him to Vishnu. Vishnu then placed him in the starry heavens; the upper part of his body represents the Dragon’s head and the lower part, Ketu, represents the Dragon’s tail. These two points are the ascending and descending nodes <term>The two points where the moon's orbit crosses the sun's path.</term>. Since then, Râhu takes his revenge on the Sun and Moon by occasionally swallowing them. However, this fable has another hidden meaning, for Râhu, the Dragon’s head, played a prominent role in the Mysteries of the Sun’s (the "Sun-Cutter's" <note>original: "Vikartana’s"</note>) Initiation, when the Candidate and the Dragon engaged in a final battle.

The caves of the sages <note>original: "Rishis"</note>—the homes of Teiresias and the Greek seers—were modeled after those of the serpent-beings <note>original: "Nâgas"</note>, the Hindu King-Snakes who lived in rocky underground cavities. From Shesha, the thousand-headed serpent upon which Vishnu rests, to Python, the dragon-serpent oracle, all these symbols point to the secret meaning of the myth. In India, we find this fact mentioned in the earliest ancient chronicles <note>original: "Purânas"</note>. The children of Surasâ are the mighty "Dragons." ->MERODACH-MICHAEL.<-

If anyone who truly understood the spirit of Homer’s allegories ever had a real understanding of the *esoteric* <term>esoteric: intended for or likely to be understood by only a small number of people with specialized knowledge</term> meaning of the *Iliad* and *Odyssey*, he would have understood St. John’s *Revelation*, and even the *Pentateuch* <note>original: "Pentateuch" refers to the first five books of the Bible: Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, and Deuteronomy</note>, better than he currently does. (3) A repetition of this ancient tradition is found in chapter 12 of St. John’s *Revelation*. It comes from Babylonian legends, without the smallest doubt, though the Babylonian story, in its turn, originated in the allegories of the Aryans. The fragment read by the late George Smith is sufficient to reveal the source of this chapter of the Apocalypse. Here it is as given by the eminent Assyriologist:

> Our . . . fragment refers to the creation of mankind, called Adam, as [the man] in the Bible; he is made perfect, . . . but afterwards he joins with the dragon of the deep, the animal of Tiamat, the spirit of chaos, and offends against his god, who *curses him*, and calls down on his head all the evils and troubles of humanity.*

This is followed by a war between the dragon and the powers of evil, or chaos, on one side and the gods on the other.

The gods have weapons forged for them,† and Merodach [the Archangel Michael in *Revelation*] undertakes to lead the heavenly host against the dragon. The war, which is described with spirit, ends of course in the triumph of the principles of good.‡

This War of the Gods with the Powers of the Deep also refers, in its final and earthly application, to the struggle between the Aryan Adepts of the emerging Fifth Race and the Sorcerers of Atlantis—the "Demons of the Deep," the islanders surrounded with water who disappeared in the Deluge.

### THE SUN-GODS, CREATIVE POWERS.

Anubis is also represented as slaying a Dragon that has the head and tail of a serpent.†

Cosmologically, then, all the Dragons and Serpents conquered by their "Slayers" are, in their origin, the turbulent and confused principles in Chaos. They are brought to order by the Sun-gods or *Creative Powers*. In the *Book of the Dead*, those principles are called the "Sons of Rebellion."‡

The fact is, even as a common snake <note>original: "ophidian"</note>, it has always been a dual symbol, and as a dragon, it has never been anything other than a symbol of the Manifested Deity in its great Wisdom. Those who have faith in the Occult Teachings believe that in the days of old there were indeed such creatures as flying dragons—a kind of Pterodactyl—and that it is those gigantic winged lizards that served as the models for the "Seraph" of Moses and his great Brazen Serpent.* The Jews previously worshipped that same idol themselves, but after the religious reforms brought about by King Hezekiah, they reversed their position. ### WHO FIRST CREATED WOMAN.

The verb *shatana* <note>original: "shatana," a Hebrew root meaning "to be adverse" or "to persecute"</note> belongs by right to the first and cruelest "Adversary" of all the other Gods—Jehovah. It does not belong to the Serpent, which spoke only words of sympathy and wisdom, and is at the worst—even in church dogma—only the "Adversary" of *men*. This dogma, based as it is on the third chapter of *Genesis*, is as illogical and unjust as it is contradictory. 

After all, who was the first to *create* that original and ever-since universal tempter of man—the woman? It was certainly not the Serpent, but the "Lord God" himself. # THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

The king, also called Gian-ben-Gian (or Wisdom, son of Wisdom), was the monarch of the <term>Peris</term> <note>benevolent supernatural beings in Persian mythology, similar to spirits or fairies</note>.\* He possessed a shield as famous as that of Achilles; however, instead of serving against a human enemy in war, it served as a protection against black magic—the sorcery of the <term>Devs</term> <note>evil spirits or demons in Persian lore</note>. Gian-ben-Gian had reigned for 2,000 years when <term>Iblis</term> <note>the primary devil or Satan in Islamic and Persian tradition</note> was permitted by God to defeat the Peris and scatter them to the other end of the world. Even the magic shield—which was produced according to the principles of Astrology to destroy charms, enchantments, and bad spells—could not prevail against Iblis, who was an agent of Fate, or <term>Karma</term>. They count ten kings in their last capital called Khanoom, and identify the tenth, Kaimurath, as identical to the Hebrew Adam. These kings correspond to the ten generations of kings before the Flood as recorded by <term>Berosus</term> <note>a Babylonian historian and priest from the 3rd century BCE</note>.

Distorted as these legends are now found to be, one can hardly fail to identify them with the Chaldæan, Egyptian, Greek, and even Hebrew traditions. For the Jewish myth, though disdaining in its exclusiveness to speak of "Pre-Adamite" nations (people existing before Adam), nevertheless allows these to be clearly inferred by sending out Cain—one of the only two *living men on earth* at the time—into the land of Nod, where he gets married and builds a city.‡

Now, if we compare the 9,000 years mentioned by the Persian tales with the 9,000 years which Plato declared had passed since the submersion of the last part of Atlantis, a very strange fact is made apparent. <term>Bailly</term> <note>Jean-Sylvain Bailly (1736–1793), a French astronomer and historian of ancient science</note> remarked on this, but distorted it through his own interpretation. The Secret Doctrine may restore these figures to their true meaning. We read in the *Critias*:

> First of all, one must remember that 9,000 years have elapsed since the *war of the nations* which lived above and outside the Pillars of Hercules <note>the Strait of Gibraltar</note>, and those which peopled the lands on this side.

In the *Timæus*, Plato says the same. The Secret Doctrine declares that most of the later islander Atlanteans perished in the interval between 850,000 and 700,000 years ago, and that the <term>Âryans</term> <note>in this context, the "Fifth Root Race" of humanity in Theosophical evolution</note> were 200,000 years old when the first great "Island," or Continent, was—

### ESOTERIC CHRONOLOGY

If the 9,000 years mentioned by the Persian tales refers to the time since the continent was submerged, there seems hardly any reconciliation possible between the figures. But there is, in truth, a way to reconcile them. Plato, being an <term>Initiate</term> <note>a person who has been admitted into secret religious or philosophical knowledge</note>, had to use the veiled language of the Sanctuary. The <term>Magi</term> <note>priests or wise men</note> of Chaldea and Persia, through whose public revelations the Persian legends were preserved and passed to posterity, had to do the same.

Thus, we find the Hebrews calling a week “seven days,” and speaking of a “week of years” when each of its days actually represents 360 solar years, making the whole “week” 2,520 years in total. They had a Sabbatical week, a Sabbatical year, and so on; their Sabbath lasted either 24 hours or 24,000 years in the secret calculations of their <term>Sods</term> <note>from the Hebrew word 'sod', meaning a secret assembly or hidden council</note>. In modern times, we call an age a “century.” In Plato’s day, the initiated writers at any rate meant 100,000 years when they said a “millennium,” rather than 1,000. Meanwhile, the Hindus—more independent than any others—have never concealed their chronology. 

Thus, for 9,000 years, the Initiates will read 900,000 years. During this span of time—that is, from the first appearance of the <term>Aryan Race</term> <note>in Theosophical teaching, this refers to the 'Fifth Root Race' of humanity</note>, when the <term>Pliocene</term> <note>a geological epoch from about 5.3 to 2.5 million years ago</note> portions of the once-great Atlantis began gradually sinking\* and other continents began to appear on the surface, down to the final disappearance of Plato’s small island of Atlantis—the Aryan races had never ceased to fight with the descendants of the first giant races. This war lasted until nearly the close of the age which preceded the <term>Kali Yuga</term> <note>in Hindu philosophy, the current 'Age of Darkness' or 'Iron Age'</note> and was the <term>Mahabharata</term>, or Great War, so famous in Indian history. 

Such blending of events and epochs, and the reduction of hundreds of thousands of years into just thousands, does not interfere with the number of years that have elapsed since the destruction of the last portion of Atlantis, according to the statement made by the Egyptian priests to <term>Solon</term> <note>a famous Greek statesman who visited Egypt around 600 BCE</note>. The 9,000 years mentioned there were the correct figures. That specific event had never been kept a secret; it had only faded from the memory of the Greeks. The Egyptians had their records complete because of their isolation. Being surrounded by sea and desert, they had been left undisturbed by other nations until about a few millennia before our era.

History catches a glimpse of Egypt and its great Mysteries for the first time through <term>Herodotus</term> <note>a Greek historian known as the 'Father of History'</note>, if we do not take into account the Bible and its strange chronology.† And Herodotus himself confesses how little he *could* tell when, speaking of a mysterious tomb of an Initiate at Sais, in the sacred precinct of <term>Minerva</term> <note>the Roman name for the goddess Athena, often identified with the Egyptian goddess Neith</note>, he says:

# THE ARCTIC CONTINENT.

“...girdle that surrounds the world.” A journey of seven months’ duration will bring anyone who possesses "Solomon's Ring" <note>original: "Soliman’s Ring"; a legendary signet ring said to give the wearer power over spirits and animals</note> to that “Fountain,” provided they keep traveling straight North, as the bird flies. # THE UNREACHABLE LAND.

*Mother Earth labored <note>original: "travailed"</note> under the waves, and a new land was joined to the first one, which our wise men call the "head-covering" [the polar cap]. She labored even harder for the Third Race, and her waist and navel appeared above the water. This was the "belt," the sacred Himalayas <note>original: "Himavat"</note>, which stretches around the world. Toward the setting sun, she broke apart from her neck† downward [to the South-West] into many lands and islands, but the Eternal Land [the polar cap] did not break apart. Dry lands covered the face of the silent waters on all four sides of the world. All of these eventually perished. Then the home of the wicked [Atlantis] appeared. The Eternal Land was now hidden, for the waters became solid [frozen] under the breath of her nostrils and the evil winds from the Dragon’s mouth, and so on.*

This shows that Northern Asia is as old as the Second Race. One may even say that Asia is as old as humanity itself, since its "Root-Continent," so to speak, existed from the very beginning of human life. The part of the world now known as Asia was only separated from it in a later age and divided by glacial waters.

If the teaching is understood correctly, the first continent to exist covered the whole North Pole like a single unbroken crust. It remains there to this day, beyond that inland sea which appeared like an unreachable mirage to the few Arctic travelers who saw it.

During the era of the Second Race, more land emerged from under the waters as an extension from the "head" to the "neck." This began in both hemispheres, along the line above the northernmost part of Spitsbergen.‡

# THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

On Mercator’s Projection <note>A standard map projection that represents the Earth as a flat rectangle, often used for navigation</note>, on our side of the world, this land may have included the regions now occupied by Baffin’s Bay and the neighboring islands and capes on the American side. *There*, it hardly reached as far south as the 70th degree of latitude; *here*, it formed the horseshoe-shaped continent described in the Commentary. Of its two ends, one included Greenland with an extension that crossed the 50th degree to the Southwest, and the other included Kamchatka. These two ends were united by what is now the northern fringe of the coasts of Eastern and Western Siberia. Eventually, this land broke apart <note>original: "asunder"</note> and disappeared. In the early part of the Third Race, Lemuria was formed. When it was destroyed in its turn, Atlantis appeared.

### WESTERN SPECULATIONS, BASED ON THE GREEK AND PURANIC TRADITIONS.

Thus, it is natural to find that, based even on the meager data available to secular historians, Olaus Rudbeck—a Swedish scientist about two centuries ago—tried to prove that Sweden was the Atlantis mentioned by Plato. He even believed he had found the location and measurements of the capital of "Atlantis" in the layout of ancient Uppsala, just as the Greek sage described it. As the astronomer Bailly proved, Rudbeck was mistaken. However, Bailly was also mistaken, and even more so; Sweden and Norway had actually been part of ancient Lemuria and also of Atlantis on the European side, just as Eastern and Western Siberia and Kamchatka had belonged to it on the Asiatic side. The only question is: when did this occur? We can only find the approximate answer by studying the Puranas <note>ancient Hindu texts containing mythology and history</note>, provided we are willing to consider the Secret Teachings.

Seventy-five years have already passed since Francis Wilford brought forward his imaginative theories claiming that the British islands were the "White Island," the *Atala* of the *Puranas*. This was absolute nonsense, as *Atala* is one of the seven *Dvipas* <note>islands or continents</note> belonging to the lower *Lokas* <note>worlds or planes</note>, specifically one of the seven regions of *Patala* <note>the netherworld or the antipodes</note>. Moreover, as Wilford* himself shows, the *Puranas* place it "on the seventh zone or seventh climate"—or rather, on the seventh measure of heat—which locates it between 24° and 28° North latitude. It is, therefore, to be sought...

---

He also places it in the Euxine <note>the Black Sea</note> or *Ikshu* (Black) Sea, and later seems to connect it with Africa and the Atlas Mountains.

But another proof can be brought forward regarding the great antiquity of these Hindu Aryans who described the last surviving island of Atlantis—or rather, that remnant of the eastern portion of that continent which perished shortly after the rising of the two Americas\* (the two regions <note>original: Varshas</note> of Pushkara). Now, if we consider this statement from its astronomical aspect—since Krishna is the Sun (Vishnu) in human form, a solar god, and is said to have killed the White Devil <note>original: Div-sefid</note>—this "White Devil" may be a personification of the ancient inhabitants at the foot of the Atlas Mountains, or perhaps he represents the vertical beams of the Sun. Again, these inhabitants, the Atlanteans <note>original: Atlantides</note>, are accused by the historian Diodorus of daily cursing the Sun and constantly fighting against its influence. The previous teachings of the Secret Doctrine, supported by universal traditions, should now have demonstrated that the *Brahmanas* <note>ancient Indian commentaries on the Vedas</note> and *Puranas* <note>ancient Hindu texts containing myths and history</note>, the *Vendidad* <note>a collection of texts in the Zoroastrian Avesta</note> and other Mazdean scriptures, and even the Egyptian, Greek, Roman, and finally the Jewish sacred records, all share the same origin. Due to space constraints in these volumes, we cannot enter into further or more specific details regarding the four Races that preceded our own. It has been shown, through the evidence of the entire ancient literary world and the intuitive speculations of several modern philosophers and scientists, that the principles of our Esoteric Doctrine are, in almost every case, supported by both logical inference and direct proof. In the Addenda <note>supplementary material at the end of a book</note> that close this volume, Science will often find itself unable to provide an answer. It is hoped that these additions will finally address every skeptical remark regarding the sacred numbers in nature and our calculations in general.

Meanwhile, one task remains incomplete: addressing that most harmful of all theological dogmas—the “Curse” under which mankind is claimed to have suffered ever since the supposed disobedience of Adam and Eve in the Garden of Eden.

The creative powers in man were the gift of Divine Wisdom, not the result of sin. This is clearly illustrated in the paradoxical behavior of Jehovah, who first curses Adam and Eve (representing Humanity) for their supposed crime, and then blesses his “chosen people” by saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the earth.”*

> . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
> It must be one of your [<term>Io</term>'s] own descendants (791)

This "Son" will deliver <term>Prometheus</term> (who represents suffering **Humanity**) from his own fatal gift. His name is "**He who has to come**."

Based on the authority of these few lines—which, like any other allegorical sentence, may be twisted into almost any meaning—and on the words pronounced by <term>Prometheus</term> to <term>Io</term> (the daughter of <term>Inachus</term> who was persecuted by <term>Zeus</term>), an entire prophecy has been constructed by some <term>Catholic writers</term>. The crucified <term>Titan</term> says:

> And, a sign beyond belief, the speaking oaks
> By which you were clearly hailed, in no riddling phrase,
> As the *illustrious spouse of <term>Zeus</term>*
> . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . (853).
> . . . . . . . . . . . . stroking you
> With the touch alone of a hand that brings no fear;
> Then you shall bear dark *<term>Epaphos</term>*, whose name
> Records his sacred birth . . . . . . . (870).

# CHRIST CONNECTED WITH EPAPHOS.

Several fanatics—including Des Mousseaux and De Mirville <note>Gougenot des Mousseaux (1805–1876) and Jules-Eudes de Mirville (1802–1873) were French writers who argued that occult phenomena were the work of demons</note>, among others—interpreted this as a clear prophecy. We are told that Io "is the mother of God," and "dark Epaphos" is Christ. However, Christ has not dethroned his Father, except in a metaphorical sense (if one considers Jehovah to be that Father); nor has the Christian Savior hurled *his* Father down into Hades <note>the Greek underworld or realm of the dead</note>. Prometheus says (in verse 930) that Zeus will yet be humbled:

> . . . . . such a marriage he prepares
> Which from his throne of power to nothingness
> Shall hurl him down; so shall be all fulfilled
> His father Cronus’ <note>original: "Kronos"</note> curse . . . .
> . . . . . . . . Then let him sit
> Confiding in his lofty thunder-peals,
> And wielding with both hands the fiery bolt;
> For *these shall not avail, but fall he shall*,
> *A fall disgraceful, not to be endured* . . . . (980).

"Dark Epaphos" was the Dionysus-Sabasius, the son of Zeus and Demeter <note>the Greek goddess of the harvest and agriculture</note> in the Sabasian Mysteries <note>secret religious rites dedicated to the god Sabazios, often identified with Dionysus</note>. During these mysteries, the "Father of the Gods," assuming the shape of a *Serpent*, fathered Dionysus (or the Solar Bacchus) upon Demeter. Io is the Moon, and at the same time the Eve of a *new race*, as is Demeter in this instance. The Promethean myth is indeed a prophecy; but it does not relate to any of the cyclic Saviors who have appeared periodically in various countries and among various nations during their transitional stages of evolution. Instead, it points to the last of the mysteries of cyclic transformations. In the series of these cycles, mankind—having passed from the <term>ethereal</term> <note>spiritual or non-physical</note> to the solid physical state, and from spiritual to physiological <term>procreation</term> <note>the biological act of producing offspring</note>—is now being carried forward on the opposite arc of the cycle. It moves toward that second phase of its original state, when *woman knew no man*, and human offspring were *created, not begotten*.

That state will return to humanity and to the world at large when the world finally discovers and truly appreciates the truths that underlie this vast problem of sex. It will be like "the light that never shone on sea or land" <note>original: "the light that never was, on sea or land," from William Wordsworth's poem *Elegiac Stanzas*</note>, and it must come to men through the Theosophical Society. That light will lead onward and upward to true spiritual intuition. Then, as expressed once in a letter to a Theosophist:

> *The world will have a race of Buddhas and Christs, for the world will have discovered that individuals have it in their own power to procreate Buddha-like children—or Demons. . . . When that knowledge comes, all dogmatic religions, and with them the Demons, will die out.*

<margin>* The author and translator of *Prometheus Bound* complains that in this tracing of Io’s wanderings, "no consistency with our own known geography is attainable" (p. 379). There may be a good reason for this. First of all, it represents the journey and wandering from place to place of the **Race** from which the "tenth," or <term>Kalki Avatâra</term> <note>original: "Kalki Avatâra"; the final messenger or incarnation of Vishnu expected at the end of the current age</note> is to emerge. This is what the text calls the "kingly race born in *Argos*" (v. 888). However, "Argos" here does not refer to the city of Argos in Greece. It comes from *arg* or *arka*—the female generative power symbolized by the Moon—the boat-shaped <term>Argha</term> <note>original: "Argha"; a sacrificial vessel or cup used in ancient mysteries</note> of the Mysteries, meaning the Queen of Heaven. <term>Eustathius</term> <note>a 12th-century Byzantine scholar and archbishop</note> shows that in the dialect of the Argives, "Io" signified the Moon; meanwhile, Esotericism explains it as the divine Androgyne <note>a being combining both male and female characteristics</note>, or the mystic number Ten (10). In Hebrew, 10 is the perfect number, or "Jehovah." <term>Arghya</term> in Sanskrit is the ritual cup, the boat-shaped vessel in which flowers and fruit are offered to the deities. <term>Arghyanâth</term> is a title of the <term>Mahâ Chohan</term> <note>a high spiritual leader or "Great Lord" in esoteric tradition</note>, meaning the "Lord of Ritual Offerings." Additionally, <term>Arghyavarsha</term>, the "Land of Ritual Offerings," is the mystery name of that region extending from Mount <term>Kailâsa</term> nearly to the <term>Shamo Desert</term>—the area from which the <term>Kalki Avatâra</term> is expected to come. The <term>Airyâna-Varsedya</term> (likely <term>Airyâna Vaëjô</term> <note>the ancient homeland of the Aryans in Zoroastrian tradition</note>) is identical to it. It is currently said to have been situated between the Sea of Aral, Baltistan, and Little Tibet; but in ancient times, its area was much larger, as it was the birthplace of *physical* humanity, of which Io is the mother and symbol.</margin>

If we reflect upon the sequential development of the allegory and the character of the heroes, the mystery may be solved. <term>Cronus</term> <note>original: "Kronos"</note> is, of course, "Time" in its cyclical course. He swallows his children—including the *personal* gods of external religious dogmas. Instead of <term>Zeus</term>, he has swallowed a stone idol; however, this symbol has grown and developed in human imagination as mankind has cycled downward toward only physical and intellectual—not spiritual—perfection. 

When humanity is as far advanced in its spiritual evolution, <term>Cronus</term> will no longer be deceived. Instead of the stone image, he will have swallowed the human-like fiction itself. This is because the Serpent of Wisdom—represented in the <term>Sabasian Mysteries</term> by the personified <term>Logos</term> <note>original: "Logos"; the Divine Word or Reason</note>, the unity of spiritual and physical powers—will have fathered a descendant in Time (<term>Cronus</term>). This descendant is <term>Dionysus-Bacchus</term>, or the "dark <term>Epaphos</term>," the "mighty one," representing the Race that will overthrow him. 

Where will he be born? <term>Prometheus</term> traces his origin and birthplace in his prophecy to <term>Io</term>. <term>Io</term> is the Moon-goddess of generation—for she is <term>Isis</term> and she is <term>Eve</term>, the Great Mother. He traces the path of these racial wanderings as plainly as words can express. She must leave Europe and go to the continent of Asia, reaching the highest mountains of the <term>Caucasus</term> (v. 737). The Titan tells her:

->When you have crossed the flood, the boundary between<br>Two continents, facing the burning East . . . . (810)—<-

He explains that she must travel Eastward, after passing the "Cimmerian Bosphorus" <note>original: "Kimmerian Bosphorus"; the modern Strait of Kerch</note>, and cross what is evidently the <term>Volga</term> and the area of modern <term>Astrakhân</term> on the <term>Caspian Sea</term>. After this, she will encounter "fierce northern blasts" and cross over to the land of the "Arimaspian host" (located east of the <term>Scythia</term> described by <term>Herodotus</term>) to—

->Pluto’s gold-abounding flood. . . . . (825).<-

# THE MISTAKE OF ARRIAN EXPLAINED.

Professor Newman correctly guesses that this referred to the Ural Mountains, as the <term>Arimaspi</term> <note>original: "Arimaspi"; a legendary tribe of one-eyed people in northern Scythia mentioned by Herodotus</note> of Herodotus were the "recognized inhabitants of this gold-producing region."

And here, between verses 825 and 835, we find a puzzle for all European interpreters. The Titan <note>Prometheus</note> says:

> Do not approach these [the Arimaspi and the <term>Grypes</term> <note>Griffins</note>]; next you shall reach
> A far border land, where a dark-skinned race dwells
> Near the fountains of the Sun, where the Ethiopian river begins;
> Follow its banks until you reach
> The mighty rapids, where from the Bybline heights
> The Nile sends forth its pure, sacred waters.

There, Io was destined to found a colony for herself and her sons. Now we must see how this passage is interpreted. Io is told that she must travel eastward until she reaches the Ethiops River, which she is to follow until it flows into the Nile—this is what causes the confusion. As the author of the translation of *Prometheus Bound* informs us:

> This condition was fulfilled by the river Indus. <term>Arrian</term> <note>a Greek historian and philosopher of the 2nd century AD</note> (in Book 6, Chapter 1) mentions that Alexander the Great, when preparing to sail down the Indus—having seen crocodiles in the river Indus and in no other river except the Nile—believed he had discovered the sources of the Nile. It was as though the Nile rose from some place in India, flowed through much desert land, and thereby lost its name "Indus"... then flowed through inhabited land, being called "Nile" by the Ethiopians of those parts and later by the Egyptians. Virgil, in the fourth book of the *Georgics* <note>a poem on agriculture</note>, repeats this outdated error. <note>original: "Op. cit., p. 385, note."; refers to the previously cited work by the translator of *Prometheus Bound*</note>

Both Alexander and Virgil may have been quite mistaken in their geographical notions; however, the prophecy of Prometheus has not made the slightest error—at least not in its <term>Esoteric</term> <note>hidden or inner spiritual</note> meaning. When a certain Race is symbolized, and events belonging to its history are described as an allegory, one should not expect topographical accuracy in the journey mapped out for that personification. 

Yet, as it happens, the "Ethiops river" is certainly the Indus, and it is also the <term>Nîl or Nîlâ</term> <note>Sanskrit for "blue"</note>. It is the river born on the heavenly Mount Kailâsa, the Mansion of the Gods, 22,000 feet above sea level. It was called the Ethiops river by the Greeks long before the days of Alexander because its banks, from Attock down to Sind, were inhabited by tribes generally referred to as the "Eastern Ethiopians." India and Egypt were two related nations, and the Eastern Ethiopians—those mighty builders—came from India, as I hope I have sufficiently proved in *Isis Unveiled*. <note>Volume 1, pages 569, 570.</note>

# THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

Then why could not Alexander the Great, and even the learned Roman poet Virgil, have used the word Nile or *Neilos* when speaking of the Indus River, since it is one of its names? To this day the Indus is called, in the regions around Kalabagh <note>a town in the Punjab province of modern-day Pakistan</note>, *Nîl* ("blue") and *Nîlâ* ("the blue river"). The water there is of such a dark blue color that this name was given to it from time immemorial; a small town on its banks is called by the same name and still exists today. Evidently Arrian, who wrote much later than the days of Alexander and who was ignorant of the old name of the Indus, has unconsciously slandered the Greek conqueror. Nor are our modern historians much wiser in their judgments, for they often make the most sweeping declarations based on mere appearances, just as much as their ancient colleagues ever did in the past, when no encyclopedias were yet available to them.

The race of Io, the "cow-horned maid," is then simply the first pioneer race of the Ethiopians brought by her from the Indus to the Nile. This river received its name in memory of the mother river of the colonists from India.* Therefore Prometheus says to Io† that the sacred *Neilos*—the God, not the river—shall guide her "to the land, *three-cornered*," namely, to the Delta, where her sons are destined to found "that far-off colony" (verses 833 and following).

It is there that a new race (the Egyptians) will begin, and a "female race" (verse 873) which, "fifth in descent" from dark Epaphos <note>the son of Io and Zeus, born in Egypt</note>—

->Fifty in number shall return to Argos.<-

->**Then one of the fifty virgins will fail through love and shall—**<-

->. . . give birth to a kingly race in Argos.<-
->. . . . . . . . .<-
->But from this seed shall dauntless heroes spring,<-
->Famous for the bow, who shall free me from these ills.<-

***

* Alexander, who was better acquainted with Attock <note>a city on the Indus River</note> than with the rest of India—for he never entered India proper—could not have failed to hear the Indus, near its very sources, called *Nîl* and *Nîlâ*. The mistake—if it is indeed a mistake—is thus easily explained.

† That Io is identical, allegorically, with Isis and the Moon is shown by her being "cow-horned." The allegory undeniably reached Greece from India, where *Vâch*—the "melodious Cow" of the *Rig Veda*, "from whom mankind was produced" (*Bhâgavata Purâna*)—is shown in the *Aitareya Brâhmana* as being pursued by her father Brahmâ. Moved by an illicit passion, he changed her into a deer. Hence Io, refusing to yield to Jupiter’s <note>Zeus's</note> passion, becomes "horned." In every country, the cow was the symbol of the passive generative power of nature—Isis, Vâch, Venus (the mother of the prolific God of Love, Cupid). But, at the same time, it symbolized the *Logos* <note>original: "Logos"; the Divine Word or Reason</note>, whose symbol with the Egyptians and the Indians became the Bull, as evidenced by the Apis bull in Egypt and the Hindu bulls in the most ancient temples. In Esoteric Philosophy, the Cow is the symbol of Creative Nature, and the Bull (her calf) is the Spirit which gives her life, or the "Holy Spirit," as Dr. Kenealy <note>Edward Kenealy, an Irish barrister and writer on religion</note> shows. This is the origin of the symbol of the horns. These were also sacred to the Jews, who placed horns of Shittim wood <note>acacia wood</note> on the altar; by grabbing these horns, a criminal could ensure his safety.

### WAS AESCHYLUS INITIATED?

The Titan <note>Prometheus</note> does not reveal when these heroes shall arise; for as he remarks:

->To explain this fully would require a lengthy speech.<-

But "Argos" is *Arghyavarsha*, the "Land of Libations" of the ancient Hierophants <note>term: Hierophants; high priests or initiators into sacred mysteries</note>. This is the land from which the Deliverer of Humanity will appear—a name that, ages later, became that of its neighbor, India, the *Aryavarta* of old.

That this subject was part of the Sabasian Mysteries <note>ancient religious rituals associated with the god Sabazios, often linked to Dionysus or Zeus</note> is confirmed by several ancient writers, including Cicero\* and Clement of Alexandria.† The latter writers are the only ones who identify the true reason why Aeschylus was charged with sacrilege by the Athenians and condemned to be stoned to death. They state that Aeschylus, being himself uninitiated, had profaned the Mysteries by exposing them on a public stage in his Trilogies.‡ However, he would have faced the same condemnation even if he had been initiated. This must have been the case; otherwise, like Socrates, he must have had a *Daimon* <note>original: "Daimon"; a guiding spirit or inner divine voice</note> to reveal the secret and sacred allegorical drama of initiation to him. In any event, it was not the "father of Greek tragedy" who invented the prophecy of Prometheus. He merely repeated in dramatic form what was revealed by the priests during the *Mysteria* <note>original: "Mysteria"; secret rites or mysteries</note> of the Sabasia.§ This was one of the oldest sacred festivals, and its origin remains unknown to history even today. Mythologists connect it to Mithras, the Sun—who is called Sabasius on some ancient monuments—as well as to Jupiter and Bacchus. However, it was never truly the property of the Greeks, but dates back to time immemorial.

The translator of the drama wonders how Aeschylus could be guilty of such a:

> Discrepancy between the character of Zeus as portrayed in the *Prometheus Bound* and that depicted in his remaining dramas.‖

This is precisely because Aeschylus, like Shakespeare, was and will always remain the intellectual "Sphinx" of the ages. There was a vast abyss between Zeus as the Abstract Deity of Greek thought and the Olympic Zeus. In the Mysteries, the latter represented no higher a principle than—

<margin>‡ Herodotus and Pausanias supposed that the cause of the condemnation was that Aeschylus, adopting the Egyptian version of the origin of the gods <note>original: *Theogony*</note>, made Diana <note>Artemis</note> the daughter of Ceres <note>Demeter</note> rather than Latona <note>Leto</note>. # THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

...principle <note>The text begins mid-word; likely "principle" following from the previous page.</note> than the lower aspect of human physical intelligence—*Manas* <note>term: Manas; the mind or intellect</note> wedded to *Kâma* <note>term: Kâma; desire, emotion, or passion</note>. In contrast, Prometheus—representing the divine aspect of the mind merging into and aspiring toward *Buddhi* <note>term: Buddhi; the higher spiritual soul or faculty of intuition</note>—was the divine Soul. Whenever Zeus is shown yielding to his lower passions, he represents the Human Soul and nothing more—the *jealous* God, revengeful and cruel in its egotism or "I-am-ness." 

Because of this, Zeus is represented as a Serpent—the intellectual tempter of man. Nevertheless, through the course of cyclic evolution, he begets the "Man-Saviour," the Solar Bacchus or Dionysus, who is *more than a man*.

Dionysus is one with Osiris, with Krishna, and with Buddha, the heavenly Wise One. He is also one with the coming tenth *Avatâra* <note>term: Avatâra; a divine incarnation or "descent" of a deity to Earth</note>, the glorified spiritual *Christos* <note>term: Christos; the anointed one or the spiritual self</note>, who will deliver the suffering *Chrestos* <note>term: Chrestos; the "good" but suffering aspect of humanity, or an initiate undergoing trials</note>—meaning mankind, or Prometheus, while on trial. Brahmanical and Buddhist legends, echoed by Zoroastrian and occasionally Christian teachings, say this will happen at the end of the *Kali Yuga* <note>term: Kali Yuga; the "age of darkness" or the final of four cycles in Hindu cosmology</note>. 

It is only after the appearance of the *Kalki Avatâra* <note>the final incarnation of Vishnu</note> or *Sosiosh* <note>the Zoroastrian savior</note> that man will be born from woman without sin. At that point, the gods of human imagination—Brahmâ (the Hindu deity), Ahura Mazda or Ormazd (the Zoroastrian deity), Zeus (the Greco-Olympian "Don Juan"), Jehovah (the jealous, regretful, and cruel tribal God of the Israelites), and all their like in the universal collection of gods—will vanish into thin air. 

Along with these will vanish their "shadows," the *dark aspects* of all these deities who are always represented as "twin brothers" or creatures in public legends. In Esoteric <note>term: Esoteric; intended for or understood by only a small group with specialized knowledge</note> Philosophy, these are merely the deities' own *reflections* on Earth. The figures of Ahriman, Typhon, Samael, and Satan must all be dethroned on 그 day when every dark and evil passion is finally subdued.

There is one Eternal Law in Nature that always seeks to balance opposites and produce final harmony. Because this Law of spiritual development eventually overtakes physical and purely intellectual growth, mankind will be freed from its false gods and will find itself, at last, self-redeemed.

In its final revelation, the ancient myth of Prometheus—whose early models and opposites are found in every ancient *Theogony* <note>term: Theogony; a genealogy or account of the origin of the gods</note>—stands at the very origin of physical evil in each of them, because it stands at the threshold of human physical life. Cronus represents "Time," whose first law is that the order of successive and harmonious phases in the process of evolution must be strictly maintained—under the severe penalty of abnormal growth and all its resulting consequences. It was not part of the plan for natural development...

### THE GIFT OF PROMETHEUS.

It is remarkable that man—higher animal though he may be—should become at once, intellectually, spiritually, and psychologically, the demi-god he is on Earth, while his physical frame remains weaker, more helpless, and shorter-lived than that of almost any large mammal. The contrast is too grotesque and violent; the "tabernacle" <note>Here, the author uses "tabernacle" to refer to the human body as a dwelling place for the soul.</note> is much too unworthy of the God dwelling within it. 

The gift of Prometheus thus became a curse—though it was *foreknown and foreseen* by the "Host" <note>term: Host; a collective group of celestial or spiritual beings who guide evolution</note> personified in that character, as his name itself indicates.* It is within this fact that both the sin and the redemption of humanity exist at the same time. For the Host that incarnated into a portion of humanity—though led to do so by Karma or Nemesis <note>term: Nemesis; the personification of divine retribution or the law of balance</note>—preferred free will over passive slavery. They chose intellectual, self-conscious pain and even torture "while myriad time shall flow," rather than an empty, mindless, instinctual bliss. 

Knowing that such an incarnation was premature and not part of Nature's original plan, the Heavenly Host, "Prometheus," still sacrificed itself to benefit at least one portion of mankind.† But while saving humanity from mental darkness, they also inflicted the tortures of self-conscious responsibility—the inevitable result of free will—along with every other ill that mortal man and flesh are heir to. Prometheus accepted this torture for himself, as the Host became henceforward blended with the physical bodies prepared for them, which were still unfinished at that stage of development.

Because spiritual evolution was unable to keep pace with physical evolution once its original unity was broken by this mixture, the gift became the primary cause, if not the sole origin, of Evil.‡ This is a highly philosophical...

# THE OLDEST RECORDS ABOUT ATLANTIS.

Perhaps it is this "voice of the soul" that speaks to those who value tradition more than written history, telling them that the account below is entirely true and refers to prehistoric facts.

This is what is written in one passage:

Based on beforehand reasoning <note>original: *a priori*</note>, a century or two generally passes before a truth begins to dawn on human consciousness as a possible fact, except in cases where the thing claimed is physically discovered. The truths of today are the falsehoods and errors of yesterday, and the other way around <note>original: *vice versâ*</note>. It is only in the twentieth century that portions, if not the whole, of the present work will be proven right.

<header>THE COMING NEW RACE.</header>

With records and traditions from its Sanctuaries that remain unbroken for more than just a few centuries, the Ancient Science <note>original: Old Science; refers to the esoteric or hidden wisdom the author promotes.</note> brushes away that web of theories—spun in the darkness covering a period of barely a few millennia—which Europeans call their "history." This Ancient Science says to us: "Listen, now, to my version of the memoirs of Humanity."

The Human Races are born from one another; they grow, develop, become old, and die. Their sub-races and nations follow the same rule. If your all-denying Modern Science and so-called Philosophy do not contest that the human family is composed of a variety of well-defined types and races, it is only because the fact is undeniable. No one would say that there is no external difference between an Englishman, an African, and a Japanese or Chinese person. 

On the other hand, most Naturalists <note>Scientists who study the natural world, particularly biology and anthropology.</note> formally deny that *mixed* human races—that is <note>original: i.e.</note>, the seeds for entirely new races—are still being formed in our day. This latter point, however, is maintained on good grounds by De Quatrefages <note>Jean Louis Armand de Quatrefages de Bréau (1810–1892), a prominent French biologist and anthropologist.</note> and some others.

Nevertheless, our general proposition will not be accepted. Critics will say that whatever forms man has passed through in the long prehistoric past, there are no more changes for him in the future, except for certain variations like those we see at present. Therefore, they would argue that our Sixth and Seventh Root-Races <term>Root-Races: In the author's system, these are the seven primary stages of human evolution on Earth, each lasting millions of years.</term> are mere fictions.

To this, we answer again: "How do you know?" Your experience is limited to a few thousand years—to less than a day in the total age of Humanity—and to the present types found on the current continents and islands of our Fifth Race <term>Fifth Race: Also called the "Aryan" race in this text, it refers to the current stage of dominant human civilization.</term>. How can you tell what will or will not be? Meanwhile, such is the prophecy of the Secret Books <note>The ancient, hidden texts (such as the Stanzas of Dzyan) that form the basis of the author's teachings.</note> and their very clear statements.

This shows the enormous overlapping of one Race over the Race that succeeds it. In this process, the elder race loses its specific characteristics and assumes the new features of the younger Race. This is proven in all formations of mixed human races. 

Now, Occult Philosophy <term>Occult Philosophy: A system of knowledge concerning the hidden spiritual laws of nature and the inner development of humanity.</term> teaches that even now, under our very eyes, the new Race and sub-races are preparing to be formed. It is in America that this transformation will take place, and it has already silently commenced.

# THE FUTURE MANKIND.

Humanity is still changing in stature, general physique, and mentality, just as the Fourth Race <note>The Atlanteans</note> overlapped our Aryan Race, and the Third <note>The Lemurians</note> overlapped the Atlanteans.

When this will happen, as just stated, is not for the writer to know. However, since Nature no more proceeds by sudden jumps and starts than a child suddenly changes into a mature man, the final cataclysm will be preceded by many smaller submersions and destructions, caused by both ocean waves and volcanic fires. 

The exultant pulse will beat high in the heart of the race now living in the American zone. But there will be no more "Americans" when the Sixth Race commences; in fact, there will be no more Europeans. By then, they will have become a *new Race* and many *new nations*. Yet the Fifth Race will not die out immediately; it will survive for a while, overlapping the new Race for many hundreds of thousands of years to come. As we have just said, it will be transformed alongside its *successor*, though more slowly—still becoming entirely altered in mentality, general physique, and stature. 

Mankind will not grow into giant bodies again, as was the case with the Lemurians and the Atlanteans. The evolution of the Fourth Race led them down to the very bottom of materiality in their physical development. In contrast, the present Race is on its ascending arc. ## SECTION I.

### ESOTERIC TENETS CONFIRMED IN EVERY SCRIPTURE.

---

Given how strange these teachings are, and how many of these doctrines seem absurd from a modern scientific perspective, some necessary additional explanations must be made. The theories found in the Stanzas of Volume II are even harder to grasp than those in Volume I, which focused on the origin of the universe <note>original: "Cosmogony"</note>. Therefore, we will question Theology here in Part II, just as we will question Science in Part III. Since our doctrines differ so greatly from the current ideas of both Materialism <note>the belief that only physical matter exists</note> and Theology, Occultists <note>students of hidden or secret knowledge</note> must always be ready to defend against attacks from either or both sides.

Readers should be constantly reminded that, as shown by the many quotations from various ancient scriptures, these teachings are as old as the world itself. This work is simply an attempt to translate the ancient accounts of creation <note>original: "archaic Genesis"</note> and history—as taught in certain Asian centers of hidden <note>original: "Esoteric"</note> learning—into modern language and terminology familiar to the educated student. These ideas should be accepted or rejected based on their own merits, whether in whole or in part, but only after they have been carefully compared with traditional religious dogmas and modern scientific theories and speculations.

Neither the uninitiated scholar nor the philosopher is capable of fully comprehending the spirit of ancient <note>original: "Archaic"</note> philosophy. Nor can either be expected to do so until the real meaning of the beginning and the end <note>original: "Alpha and the Omega"; Greek phrase denoting totality</note> of Eastern hidden teachings <note>original: "Esotericism"</note>—the terms *Sat* and *Asat*, used so freely in the *Rig Veda* and elsewhere—is thoroughly understood. Without this key to Indo-European <note>original: "Âryan"</note> wisdom, the account of the universe's origin <note>original: "Cosmogony"</note> provided by the enlightened sages <note>original: "Rishis"</note> and the Buddhist saints <note>original: "Arhats"</note> is in danger of remaining a "dead letter" <note>meaningless or purely literal</note> to the average scholar of Eastern studies <note>original: "Orientalist"</note>.

*Asat* is not merely the opposite of *Sat*, nor is it "that which does not yet exist." For *Sat* is in itself neither "the existent" nor "being." *Sat* is the unchangeable, ever-present, eternal Root from which and through which everything proceeds. But it is far more than the potential force in a seed that drives the process of development—what we now call evolution. It is that which is "ever-becoming," even though it never manifests itself to the senses. *Sat* is born from *Asat*, and *Asat* is produced by *Sat*—this is truly perpetual motion in a circle. Yet, it is a circle that can be "squared" <note>a mathematical metaphor for solving a seemingly impossible spiritual puzzle</note> only at the highest level of spiritual enlightenment <note>original: "Supreme Initiation"</note>, at the threshold of final liberation <note>original: "Parinirvâna"</note>.

The scholar Auguste Barth once shared a reflection on the *Rig Veda* that was intended as a harsh criticism—an unusual and therefore supposedly original view of this ancient volume. However, in his criticism, this scholar revealed a truth without being aware of its full importance. He begins by saying that "neither in the language nor in the thought of the *Rig Veda*" has he "been able to discover that quality of *primitive natural simplicity* which so many are eager to see in it." Barth was likely thinking of Max Müller when he wrote this. The famous Oxford professor has consistently described the hymns of the *Rig Veda* as the simple, pure expression of the religious feelings of an innocent, pastoral people. Müller believes that "in the Vedic hymns, the ideas and myths appear in their simplest and freshest form." Barth, however, holds a different opinion.

The opinions of Sanskrit scholars regarding the importance and internal value of the *Rig Veda* are so divided and personal that their views become entirely biased regardless of which side they take. For example, Professor Max Müller declares that:

> Nowhere is the wide distance that separates the ancient poems of India from the oldest literature of Greece more clearly felt than when we compare the developing myths of the *Veda* with the fully developed and decaying myths upon which the poetry of *Homer* is founded. The *Veda* is the real account of the origin of the gods <note>original: "Theogony"</note> of the Indo-European <note>original: "Aryan"</note> races, while that of *Hesiod* is a distorted parody <note>original: "caricature"</note> of the original image.

->### THE VEDAS WRITTEN BY INITIATES.<-

This is a sweeping assertion, and perhaps rather unjust in its general application. But why not try to explain it? Scholars of Eastern studies <note>original: "Orientalists"</note> cannot do so because they reject the timeline of the Secret Doctrine. They can hardly admit the fact that tens of thousands of years passed between the writing of the *Rig Veda* hymns and Hesiod's *Theogony* <note>original: "Theogony"; a Greek poem describing the origins and genealogies of the gods</note>. 

Because of this, they fail to see that the Greek myths are no longer the primitive symbolic language of the Initiates—those disciples of the God-Hierophants <note>original: "Hierophants"; high priests or revealers of sacred mysteries</note> and the divine "Sacrificers" of ancient times. Distorted by the distance of time and weighed down by the excessive growth of worldly <note>original: "profane"</note> human imagination, these myths now appear like the shimmering, distorted images of stars reflected in moving waves. But if Hesiod’s *Cosmogony* <note>original: "Cosmogony"; a theory or account of the origin of the universe</note> and *Theogony* are viewed as caricatures of the original images, how much more so are the myths in the Hebrew *Genesis*? This is especially true for those who see them as no more a divine revelation or the "word of God" than Mr. Gladstone <note>William Gladstone (1809–1898), a British Prime Minister and lay theologian who wrote on the intersection of Homeric myth and the Bible</note> considers Hesiod's *Theogony* to be.

As Auguste Barth says:

> The poetry it [the *Rig Veda*] contains seems to me, on the contrary, to be of a uniquely refined and carefully crafted character. It is full of hints and hidden meanings, claiming a sense of mysticism and spiritual insight. Its style reminds one more of the language used by small groups of initiates than the poetic language of a large community.*

We will not stop to ask the critic how he could know anything about the language used by "initiates," or whether he belongs to such a group himself; for, if he did, he would hardly have used such language. However, the quote above shows the remarkable disagreement between scholars even regarding the external character of the *Rig Veda*. What, then, can any modern Sanskrit scholar know about its internal or hidden <note>original: "esoteric"</note> meaning, beyond Barth’s correct conclusion that *this Scripture was compiled by Initiates*?

The whole of the present work is an effort to prove this truth. The ancient Adepts solved the great problems of science, regardless of how unwilling modern Materialism <note>a philosophy that holds that matter is the only reality</note> may be to admit it. The mysteries of Life and Death *were* fully understood by the great master-minds of antiquity. If they kept them secret and silent, it is because these problems were part of the Sacred Mysteries, which must have remained incomprehensible to the vast majority of people then, just as they do now. If such teachings are still regarded as delusions <note>original: "chimeras"</note> by our opponents in philosophy, it may be a consolation to—

It would benefit Theosophists to learn, through solid evidence, that the theories of modern psychologists—whether they are serious idealists like Mr. Herbert Spencer or daydreaming <note>original: "wool-gathering"</note> "pseudo-idealists"—are far more unrealistic <note>original: "chimerical"</note>. Indeed, rather than resting on the solid foundation of facts in nature, these theories are merely the unhealthy delusions <note>original: "will-o'-the-wisps"</note> of a materialistic imagination, produced by the brains that conceived them—and nothing more. While they deny, we affirm; and our claim is supported by almost all the Sages of antiquity. Having good reasons to believe in occultism and a multitude of invisible powers <note>original: "Potencies"</note>, we say, "I am certain, I know what I have believed" <note>original: "Certus sum, scio quod credidi"</note>; to which our critics reply, "Let the Jew Apella believe it" <note>original: "Credat Judæus Apella"; a Latin phrase from the poet Horace used to express skeptical disbelief, similar to "tell it to someone else."</note>. Neither side is convinced by the other, nor does this outcome affect even our little planet. And yet it moves! <note>original: "E pur se muove!"; a phrase famously attributed to Galileo Galilei after he was forced to recant his view that the Earth moves around the Sun.</note>

Nor is there any need to try to convert others <note>original: "proselytizing"</note>. As the wise Cicero remarked:

> Time destroys the theories <note>original: "speculations"</note> of man, but it confirms the judgment of nature.

Let us wait for our time. Meanwhile, it is not in human nature to silently watch the destruction of one's gods, whether they are true or false. And since theology and materialism have joined forces to destroy the old gods of antiquity and seek to distort every ancient philosophical concept, it is only fair that lovers of the Ancient Wisdom <note>original: "Old Wisdom"</note> should defend their position. They can do this by proving that the entire arsenal of these two opponents is, at best, made of new weapons forged from very old materials.

# SECTION II.

## ADAM-ADAMI.

---

Names such as Adam-Adami, used by Dr. Chwolsohn in his work *Nabathean Agriculture* and dismissed by the scholar Ernest Renan, may mean little to those who are uninitiated <note>original: "profane"</note> in secret knowledge. However, for a student of the occult, the fact that this term is found in a work as incredibly ancient as the one mentioned above proves a great deal. It proves, for instance, that Adami was a symbol with many layers of meaning. It originated with the Aryan people, as the root word shows, and was later adopted from them by the Semitic and Turanian peoples—just as many other concepts were.

Adam-Adami is a general, compound name as old as language itself. The *Secret Doctrine* teaches that *Adi* was the name the Aryans gave to the first race of humans capable of speech in this current evolutionary cycle <note>original: "Round"; in Theosophical teaching, a "Round" is a major cycle of planetary and human development</note>. This is the source of the terms *Adonim* and *Adonai* (the ancient plural form of the word *Adon*), which the Jews used to refer to their God Jehovah and his Angels. These beings were simply the first spiritual and non-physical <note>original: "ethereal"</note> sons of the Earth. Similarly, the god Adonis—in his many different forms—represented the "First Lord." Adam is the same as the Sanskrit *Adi-Nath* <note>original: "Âdi-Nâth"</note>, which also means "First Lord," just like *Ad-Ishvara* <note>original: "Âd-Îshvara"</note> or any term where *Ad* (meaning "the First") is used as a prefix to a description or a title.

The reason for these similarities is that such truths were a common human inheritance. This was a revelation received by the very *first* humanity, before the time described in the Bible as the period of "one lip" <note>original: "one *lip* and word"; a reference to Genesis 11:1, meaning a time when all people spoke a single language</note>. This knowledge was later expanded through human intuition and eventually hidden from those who might disrespect <note>original: "profanation"</note> it, using a carefully designed system of symbols. The author of the *Kabbalah* <note>original: "Qabbalah"</note>, based on the philosophical writings of Solomon ibn Gabirol <note>original: "Ibn Gebirol"</note>, shows that the Israelites used *Adonai* (Lord) instead of *Eh-yeh* ("I am") <note>original: "Eh'yeh"</note> and *YHVH* <note>The "Tetragrammaton," the four-letter sacred name of God in Hebrew</note>. He adds that, while *Adonai* is translated as "Lord" in the Bible:

The lowest title, referring to the Deity as expressed in Nature—the more general term *Elohim*—is translated as "God."*

->THE SECRET DOCTRINE.<-

A curious work was translated around 1860 by the Orientalist Daniel Chwolsohn and presented to an always-skeptical and dismissive Europe under the innocent title of *Nabathean Agriculture*. In the opinion of the translator, that ancient volume is a complete initiation into the mysteries of the nations that lived before Adam <note>original: "Pre-Adamite nations"</note>, based on the authority of *undeniably authentic documents*. It is an invaluable collection—a complete summary of the doctrines, arts, and sciences of not only the Chaldeans but also the Assyrians and Canaanites of prehistoric ages.* These Nabatheans—as some critics thought—were simply the Sabeans <note>original: "Sabæans"</note>, or Chaldean star-worshippers. The work is a re-translation from Arabic, into which language it was first translated from the original Chaldean.

Masoudi, the Arabian historian, speaks of these Nabatheans and explains their origin in this way:

> After the Deluge [?] the nations established themselves in various countries. Among these were the Nabatheans, who founded the city of Babylon. They were those descendants of Ham who settled in the same province under the leadership of Nimrod, the son of Cush, who was the son of Ham and great-grandson of Noah. This took place at the time when Nimrod received the governorship of Babylonia as the delegate of Dzahhak, who was named Biourasp.†

The translator, Chwolsohn, finds that the assertions of this historian are in perfect accord with those of Moses in *Genesis*; however, more irreverent critics might suggest that for this very reason their truth should be suspected. It is useless, though, to argue this point, as it has no value in the current discussion. We can leave the weather-beaten, long-buried problem—and the difficulty of explaining, on any logical ground, the extraordinary origin of millions of people of various races and many civilized nations and tribes from only *three couples* (Noah's sons and their wives) in just 346 years‡ after the Deluge—to the <term>Karma</term> <note>the spiritual principle of cause and effect</note> of the author of *Genesis*, whether he is called Moses or Ezra. What is truly interesting in this work, however, are its contents and the doctrines expressed in it. If read *esoterically* <note>meaning: with an understanding of hidden or inner spiritual meanings</note>, almost all of them are identical to the Secret Teachings.

The scholar Quatremère suggested that this book might have been simply a copy made under Nebuchadnezzar II from some <term>Hamitic</term> <note>relating to the descendants of Ham, a branch of ancient peoples in biblical tradition</note> treatise that was "infinitely more ancient." Meanwhile, the author maintains, based on *internal and external evidence*, that its Chaldean original was written down from the oral discourses and teachings of a wealthy Babylonian landowner named Qû-tâmy, who—

### NABATHEAN AGRICULTURE

The author had used even more ancient materials for those lectures. Chwolsohn places the first Arabic translation as far back as the 13th century B.C. <note>Before the Common Era</note>. On the first page of this "revelation," the author—or his scribe <note>original: "amanuensis"</note>, Qû-tâmy—declares that "the doctrines proposed within were *originally told by Saturn . . . to the Moon, who communicated them to her idol,* and the idol revealed them to her devotee, the writer—the Adept Scribe of that work—Qû-tâmy."

The details given by the God for the benefit and instruction of mortals show periods of incalculable length and a series of countless kingdoms and dynasties that preceded the appearance of Adami (the "red-earth") <note>The Hebrew name "Adam" is derived from a word meaning "red" or "earth"</note> on Earth. As might have been expected, these vast periods of time enraged those who defend a literal, word-for-word interpretation of Biblical chronology. Frédéric de Rougemont was the first to organize a call to arms <note>original: "levée-in-arms"</note> against the translator. He reproached Chwolsohn for *sacrificing Moses in favor of anonymous authors.* De Rougemont argued that the historian Berosus—however great his *chronological errors*—was at least in perfect agreement with the prophet Moses regarding the first men, since Berosus speaks of Alorus-Adam, Xisuthrus-Noah, and Belus-Nimrod, etc. Therefore, he adds, the work must be a fraudulent text <note>original: "apocryphon"</note> to be categorized with its contemporaries—the *Fourth Book of Esdras*, the *Book of Enoch*, the *Sibylline Oracles*, and the *Book of Hermes*—all of which date no further back than two or three centuries B.C.

The scholar Heinrich Ewald criticized Chwolsohn even more harshly, and finally, Ernest Renan—who asks in the *Germanic Review* <note>original: "Revue Germanique"</note> why this *Nabathean Agriculture* should not be considered the fraudulent work of some Jew from the third or fourth century of our era. Renan, the imaginative author of the *Life of Jesus* <note>original: "Vie de Jésus"</note>, argues that it can hardly be otherwise, since in this large-format book <note>original: "in-folio"</note> on astrology and sorcery:

> We recognize in the characters introduced by Qû-tâmy all the patriarchs of the Biblical legends, such as Adam-Adami, Anouka-Noah, and his Ibrahim-Abraham, etc.

But this is not a valid reason for dismissal, since Adam and the others are generic names <note>In esoteric studies, these names often represent classes of humanity or evolutionary stages rather than single individuals</note>. Meanwhile, it is humbly suggested that, all things considered, such a text—even if it were from the third century A.D. instead of the 13th century B.C.—is old enough to be considered a genuine historical document, satisfying the demands of the most exacting archaeologist and critic. For even if we admit, for the sake of argument, that this literary relic was compiled by "some Jew of the third century of our era"—what does that matter? Leaving the credibility of its doctrines aside for a moment, why should—
