# THE SOUL AND HEART OF THE GREAT MOTHER

...activity. Consequently, while the <term>Astral Light</term> <note>In Theosophy, the Astral Light is a subtle essence that surrounds the Earth, acting as a medium for both divine light and human thoughts and actions.</note> is the Universal Cause in its unmanifested unity and infinity, it appears to mankind simply as the effects of the causes produced by people in their sinful lives. It is not its bright inhabitants—whether they are called Spirits of Light or Darkness—that produce Good or Evil; rather, it is humanity itself that determines the unavoidable action and reaction within this Great Magic Agent. 

It is mankind that has become the "Serpent of Genesis." Thus, human beings cause the daily and hourly Fall and Sin of the "Celestial Virgin"—who thereby becomes the Mother of Gods and Devils at the same time. For she is the ever-loving, benevolent Deity to all those who stir her *Soul* and *Heart*, rather than attracting her shadowy, manifested essence. This essence was called by the occultist Éliphas Lévi the "fatal light" which kills and destroys. 

Individual human beings can overpower and master its effects, but only through the holiness of their lives and by producing good causes. Humanity has power only over the manifested *lower* principles—the shadow of the Unknown and Unknowable Deity in Space. However, in antiquity and in reality, Lucifer (or *Luciferus*) is the name of the Angelic Entity presiding over the Light of Truth just as he presides over the light of day. In the great <term>Valentinian</term> <note>A school of Gnosticism founded by Valentinus in the 2nd century AD.</note> Gospel known as the *Pistis Sophia*, it is taught that of the three Powers emanating from the Holy Names of the three Triple Powers (<term>Triple Powers</term> <note>original Greek: Τριδυνάμεις</note>), the power of Sophia resides in the planet Venus or Lucifer. Among these <term>Gnostics</term>—who were the most cultured of all such groups—Sophia was considered the Holy Spirit.

Thus, to the uninitiated <note>original: "profane"</note>, the Astral Light may appear to be both God and the Devil at once. As the saying goes, "The Devil is God inverted" <note>original Latin: *Demon est Deus inversus*</note>. This means that through every point of Infinite Space, the magnetic and electrical currents of animate Nature throb—the life-giving and death-giving waves—for death on earth becomes life on another plane. 

Lucifer is both divine and terrestrial Light, the "Holy Spirit" and "Satan" at one and the same time. Visible Space is truly filled with the invisible, differentiated Breath of the divine. The Astral Light—the manifested effects of these two forces which are actually one—is guided and attracted by our own actions. It is the *Karma* of Humanity, acting as both a personal and impersonal entity. It is personal because "Lucifer" is the mystic name given by the philosopher St. Martin <note>Louis-Claude de Saint-Martin (1743–1803), a French philosopher known as "le Philosophe Inconnu."</note> to the Host of Divine Creators, Guides, and Rulers of this planet. It is impersonal as the Cause and Effect of Universal Life and Death.

The "Fall of Man" was the result of human knowledge, for his "eyes were opened." Indeed, he was taught Wisdom and Hidden Knowledge by the "Fallen Angel," for from that day onward, the latter had become his...

It is the **Sûtrâtmâ**, the luminous thread of immortal, *impersonal* <term>Monadship</term> <note>The state of being a 'Monad,' the eternal, spiritual part of a person that reincarnates.</note>, on which our earthly "lives" or temporary personalities are strung like so many beads—according to the beautiful expression of the <term>Vedântic Philosophy</term> <note>One of the major schools of Hindu philosophy, focusing on the relationship between the individual soul and the ultimate reality.</note>.

And now it stands proven that Satan, or the Red Fiery Dragon, the "Lord of <term>Phosphoros</term>" <note>original: Phôsphoros; Greek for 'light-bringer.'</note>—the mention of "brimstone" was a later theological "improvement"—and **Lucifer**, or the "Light-Bearer," is within us. "The first *man* Adam was made only a *living soul* (<term>Nephesh</term> <note>Hebrew for 'soul' or 'breath of life,' often used in the Bible to refer to physical or animal life.</note>), the last Adam was made a *life-giving spirit*"\*—says Paul, his words referring to the construction or creation of man. Without this *life-giving spirit*, or *human mind and soul*, there would be no difference between man and beast; as there is none, in fact, between animals regarding their actions. The tiger and the donkey, the hawk and the dove, are each as pure and as innocent as the other because they are *irresponsible*. Each follows its instinct: the tiger and the hawk kill with the same unconcern as the donkey eats a thistle or the dove pecks at a grain of corn. 

If the "Fall" had the significance given to it by standard Theology—if that Fall occurred as a result of an act never intended by Nature, a *sin*—what about the animals? If we are told that they procreate their species as a consequence of that same "original sin" for which God cursed the Earth—and therefore everything living on it—we must ask another question. We are told by Theology, as well as by Science, that animals were on Earth far earlier than man. But it is now sufficiently proven that all the so-called <note>original: soi-disant</note> evil spirits who are credited with making war on the Gods are identical personalities. Moreover, all ancient religions taught this same tenet, except for the final conclusion, which differs from the Christian view. The seven primeval Gods all had a dual nature: one essential, the other accidental. In their essential state, they were the Builders or Fashioners, the Preservers, and the Rulers of this World. In their accidental state, they clothed themselves in visible physical bodies <note>original: corporeality</note> and descended to the Earth. There, they reigned as Kings and Instructors of the lower hosts, who had taken on flesh <note>original: incarnated</note> once more as human beings.

Thus, Esoteric Philosophy shows that man is truly the manifested deity in both its aspects—good and evil. However, Theology cannot admit this philosophical truth. Because it teaches the dogma of the Fallen Angels in its literal sense <note>original: dead-letter meaning</note> and has made Satan the cornerstone and pillar of the doctrine of redemption, to do so would be suicidal for the church. # THE SEVENTH MYSTERY OF CREATION.

In the *Zend Avesta* <note>the primary sacred texts of Zoroastrianism</note>, Angra Mainyu (also known as Ahriman), surrounding himself with Fire (the "Flames" mentioned in the Stanzas), seeks to conquer the Heavens.* At this, Ahura Mazda <note>the supreme creator god in Zoroastrianism</note> descends from the *solid* Heaven where he lives to help the *revolving* Heavens. These revolving Heavens represent the manifested worlds that exist in time and space, including the cycles of incarnation <note>the process of a soul taking on a physical body</note>. Ahura Mazda and the Amshaspands <note>the "Holy Immortals" or divine emanations</note>, the "seven bright Sravah," accompanied by their stars, fight Ahriman, and the defeated Devas <note>celestial beings; in Zoroastrianism, these became viewed as demons</note> fall to the Earth along with him.† In the *Vendîdâd* <note>a section of the Zend Avesta focused on purification</note>, the Daêvas are called "evil-doers" and are shown rushing away "into the depths of the... world of hell," which actually refers to Matter.‡ This is an allegory showing that the Devas were *compelled to incarnate* once they separated themselves from their Parent Essence—in other words, after the original Unity became multiple through the process of differentiation and manifestation.

Typhon (the Egyptian Python), the Titans, and the Suras and Asuras <note>opposing groups of deities in Hindu mythology</note> all belong to this same legend of Spirits who inhabit the Earth. They are not "demons" commissioned to create and organize this visible universe. Instead, they are the Fashioners or "Architects" of the Worlds and the progenitors <note>ancestors or biological creators</note> of humanity. They are the "Fallen Angels" in a metaphorical sense—the "true mirrors" of the "Eternal Wisdom."

What is the complete truth and the hidden <note>original: Esoteric</note> meaning behind this universal myth? The full essence of this truth *cannot be communicated by word of mouth*. No pen can describe it—not even that of the Recording Angel—unless a person finds the answer in the sanctuary of their own heart, in the innermost depths of their divine intuition. It is the great *Seventh Mystery of Creation*, the first and the last; and those who read St. John’s *Book of Revelation* <note>original: Apocalypse</note> may find its shadow lurking under the *seventh seal*. It can only be represented in its outward, physical form, like the eternal riddle of the Sphinx. If the Sphinx threw herself into the sea and perished, it was not because Oedipus *had solved* the secret of the ages, but because he had dishonored that great truth forever by making the spiritual and subjective seem merely human <note>original: anthropomorphizing</note>. Therefore, we can only explain this from philosophical and intellectual perspectives, using three "keys." The last four keys of the seven—those that throw wide open the gates to the Mysteries of Nature—are in the hands of the highest Initiates <note>advanced spiritual masters</note> and cannot be revealed to the general public; at least, not in this century.

->THE SECRET DOCTRINE.<-

The literal interpretation of scripture is the same everywhere. The dualism found in the Mazdean <note>Zoroastrian</note> religion was born from a superficial interpretation. The holy Airyaman—the "bestower of prosperity"* who is invoked in the prayer called *Airyama-ishyô*—is actually the divine aspect of Ahriman, "the deadly one, the *Daêva* <note>originally "shining one," but in Zoroastrianism it refers to a demon</note> of the *Daêvas*."† Conversely, Angra Mainyu <note>the "destructive spirit"</note> is merely the dark, material aspect of Airyaman. The prayer "Keep us from our hater, O Mazda and Ârmaita Spenta,"‡ has the same meaning as "Lead us not into temptation." Both are addressed by a person to the terrible spirit of duality within their own self. For Ahura Mazda represents the spiritual, divine, and purified aspect of humanity, while Ârmaita Spenta—the Spirit of the Earth or materiality—is in one sense the same as Ahriman or Angra Mainyu.

The entire body of Magian or Mazdean literature—or what remains of it—is magical and occult. Therefore, it is allegorical and symbolic, including its "mystery of the law."§ Today, the Mobed <note>Zoroastrian priest</note> and the Parsi <note>follower of Zoroastrianism in India</note> keep their eyes on the *Baresma* <note>a bundle of twigs or rods used in ritual</note> during the sacrifice. This "divine twig" from the tree of Ormazd has been transformed into a bunch of metal rods. They wonder why neither the *Amesha Spentas* <note>the "Holy Immortals" or divine emanations</note>, nor the "high and beautiful golden *Haômas* <note>sacred ritual plants or the deity associated with them</note>," nor even their *Vohu-Manô* (good thoughts) or their *Râta* (sacrificial offerings) seem to help them much. Let them instead meditate on the "Tree of Wisdom," and through study, absorb its fruits one by one. The path to the Tree of Eternal Life—the white *Haôma* or the *Gaokerena* <note>the "White Haoma" tree that grows in the middle of the sea and provides immortality</note>—stretches from one end of the Earth to the other. *Haôma* exists in Heaven just as it does on Earth. But to become its priest and a "healer" once more, a person must first heal themselves; this must be accomplished before they can hope to heal others.

This proves once again that if we want to treat so-called "myths" with even a small degree of justice, we must examine them closely from all perspectives. ### HIS ORIGIN IN ANCIENT INDIA.

In our modern day, there is not the slightest doubt in the minds of the best European experts in symbolism that the name Prometheus possessed the greatest and most mysterious significance in antiquity. While providing the history of Deucalion—whom the Boeotians <note>an ancient Greek tribal group</note> regarded as the ancestor of the human races and who was the son of Prometheus, according to the significant legend—the author of the *Mythology of Ancient Greece* <note>original: *Mythologie de la Grèce Antique*</note> remarks:

> Thus, Prometheus is something more than the original model <note>original: "archetype"</note> of humanity; he is its creator <note>original: "generator"</note>. In the same way that we saw Hephaestus molding the first woman (Pandora) and endowing her with life, so Prometheus kneads the moist clay, fashions the body of the first man from it, and endows him with the soul-spark.* After the flood of Deucalion, they said that Zeus had commanded Prometheus and Athena to call forth a new race of men from the mud <note>original: "mire"</note> left by the waters of the deluge,† and in the time of Pausanias <note>a 2nd-century Greek traveler and geographer</note>, the slime which the hero had used for this purpose was still shown in Phocis.‡ On several ancient <note>original: "archaic"</note> monuments, we still see Prometheus modeling a human body, either alone or with Athena’s help.§

The same author reminds us of another equally mysterious figure <note>original: "personage"</note>, though one less generally known than Prometheus, whose legend offers remarkable similarities <note>original: "analogies"</note> to that of the Titan. The name of this second ancestor and creator is Phoroneus, the hero of an ancient poem called *The Phoroneids* <note>original: *Phoroneidæ*</note>, which is unfortunately no longer surviving <note>original: "extant"</note>. His legend was centered in Argolis, where a perpetual flame was preserved on his altar as a reminder that he was the bringer of fire to earth.‖ A benefactor of men like Prometheus, he had made them participants...

...terrestrial fire and its discovery. It is no longer attributed to the strike of lightning setting dry fuel ablaze and revealing its priceless benefits to Paleolithic humans—but to something more mysterious this time, though still just as earthly!

A divine bird, nesting in the branches [of the celestial Ash-tree], stole that bough [or the fruit] and carried it down to the Earth in its beak. Now the Greek word Phoroneus <note>original: Φορωνευς</note> is the exact equivalent of the Sanskrit word *bhuranyu*, meaning "the rapid," which is an epithet for Agni <note>the Hindu god of fire</note> considered as the carrier of the divine spark. Phoroneus, the son of Melia (or of the celestial ash), thus corresponds to a concept that is probably far more ancient than the one that transformed the *pramantha* <note>original: "pramantha," a fire-drilling tool used by the ancient Hindus</note> [of the ancient Aryan Hindus] into the Greek Prometheus. Phoroneus is the [personified] bird that brings heavenly lightning to the Earth. Traditions regarding the birth of the Bronze Age race, and those that identify Phoroneus as the father of the Argolians <note>the inhabitants of Argos, Greece</note>, prove to us that this lightning, as in the legends of Hephaestus or Prometheus, was considered the origin of the human race.*

This still provides us with nothing more than the external meaning of the symbols and the allegory. It is now believed that the mystery of the name "Prometheus" has been solved. However, modern mythologists and Orientalists <note>scholars of Eastern languages and cultures</note> no longer see in it what their predecessors saw based on the authority of classical antiquity. Instead, they find in it something much more suited to the spirit of the current age: a phallic <note>sexual</note> element. 

But the name Phoroneus, as well as the name Prometheus, carries not just one, or even two, but a series of hidden <term>esoteric</term> meanings. Both relate to the seven Celestial Fires; to Agni Abhimanin, his three sons, and their forty-five sons, together constituting the Forty-nine Fires. Do all these numbers relate only to the physical nature of fire and the flame of sexual passion? Did the Hindu Aryan mind never rise above such purely sensual concepts—that mind which is described by Professor Max Müller as the most spiritual and mystically inclined on the whole globe? The sheer number of those fires alone should have provided a hint <note>original: "inkling"</note> of the truth.

We are told that in this age of rational thought, we are no longer permitted to explain the name "Prometheus" as the ancient Greeks did. The latter, it seems:

> Based their view on the apparent analogy between the name Prometheus <note>original: προμηθεύς</note> and the verb *to perceive beforehand* <note>original: προμανθάνειν</note>. They saw him as the archetype of the "foreseeing" man, to whom—for the sake of symmetry—a brother was added: Epimetheus, or "he who takes counsel *after* the event" <note>hindsight</note>.†

But now, modern Orientalists have decided otherwise. They believe they know the real meaning of the two names better than the people who invented them.

### THE POETRY OF MODERN ORIENTALISTS

The legend is based upon an event of universal importance. It was built to commemorate a great event which must have strongly impressed itself upon the imagination of the first witnesses, and its remembrance has never since faded from popular memory.

<margin>Same source <note>original: "Ibid."</note>, page 257.</margin>

What was this? Putting aside every poetical fiction and all those dreams of the Golden Age, let us imagine—as modern scholars argue—the first miserable state of humanity in all its harsh realism. A striking picture of this state was traced for us by Lucretius, following Aeschylus <note>Aeschylus (c. 525–456 BCE) was a Greek tragedian; Lucretius (c. 99–55 BCE) was a Roman poet and philosopher who described the primitive state of man in "De rerum natura."</note>, and the exact truth of it is now confirmed by science. Then we may better understand that a new life really began for man on that day when he saw the first spark produced by the friction of two pieces of wood or from the veins of a flint. How could men help but feel gratitude toward that mysterious and marvelous being which they were henceforth enabled to create at their will, and which was no sooner born than it grew and expanded, developing with singular power?

Was this terrestrial flame not similar in nature to the light and heat sent to them from above, or the fire that frightened them in the thunderbolt? Was it not derived from the same source? And if its origin was in heaven, must it not have been brought down to earth one day? If so, who was the powerful and beneficent being—God or man—who had conquered it? These are the questions that the curiosity of the Aryans <note>referring here to the Indo-European ancestors in the context of 19th-century linguistics and myth-study</note> offered in the early days of their existence, and which found their answer in the myth of Prometheus.

<margin>Same source <note>original: "Ibid."</note>, page 258.</margin>

The Philosophy of Occult Science finds two weak points in the above reflections and proceeds to point them out. The miserable state of Humanity described by Aeschylus and Lucretius was no more wretched then, in the early days of the Aryans, than it is now. That "state" was limited to the savage tribes; and the savages existing now are not a bit more happy or unhappy than their forefathers were a million years ago.

It is an accepted fact in science that "rough implements, exactly resembling those in use among existing savages," are found in river-gravels and caves, geologically implying "an enormous antiquity." So great is that resemblance that, as the author of *The Modern Zoroastrian* tells us:

> If the collection in the Colonial Exhibition of stone tools <term>original: "celts"</term> and arrowheads used by the Bushmen of South Africa were placed side by side with a collection from the British Museum of similar objects from Kent’s Cavern or the Caves of Dordogne, no one but an expert could distinguish between them.

<margin>Work cited <note>original: "Op. cit."</note>, page 145.</margin>

-># THE SECRET DOCTRINE.<-

If there are Bushmen <note>A term used in the 19th century to refer to the Khoisan people of Southern Africa.</note> existing today, in our era of advanced civilization, who are no more intellectually advanced than the race of men who inhabited Devonshire and Southern France during the Paleolithic age <note>The Old Stone Age, characterized by the use of chipped stone tools.</note>, why could the latter not have lived at the same time as other races who were as highly civilized for their day as we are for ours? That the total sum of knowledge in humanity increases daily, "but that intellectual capacity does not increase with it," is shown when the intellect—if not the physical data—of thinkers like Euclid, Pythagoras, Panini, Kapila, Plato, and Socrates is compared with that of Newton, Kant, and modern scientists like Huxley and Haeckel.

<margin>Transactions of the Royal Society, London, 1868.</margin>
On comparing the results obtained by the craniologist <term>craniologist: a scientist who studies the shape and size of human skulls to determine characteristics like intelligence or race.</term> Dr. J. Barnard Davis regarding the internal capacity of the skull—taking its volume as the standard test for judging intellectual capacity—Dr. Pfaff finds that this capacity among the French (who are certainly in the highest rank of humanity) is 88.4 cubic inches. This is "perceptibly smaller than that of Polynesians in general, which, even among many Papuans and Alfuras <note>original: "Alfuras"—an archaic term for various indigenous peoples of the Maluku Islands and surrounding areas</note> of the lowest grade, amounts to 89 and 89.7 cubic inches." This shows that it is the *quality* and not the *quantity* of the brain that determines intellectual capacity. Since the average skull index has now been recognized as "one of the most characteristic marks of difference between various races," the following comparison is suggestive:

> The breadth index among Scandinavians is 75; among the English, it is 76; among Holsteiners <note>People from the Holstein region of northern Germany.</note>, 77; in Breisgau <note>original: "Bresgau"—a region in southwestern Germany.</note>, 80; the skull of the poet Schiller shows a breadth index as high as 82 . . . and the Madurese <note>People from the island of Madura, Indonesia.</note> also measure 82!

Finally, the same comparison between the oldest known skulls and modern European ones brings to light the startling fact that:

> *Most of these ancient skulls, belonging to the Stone Age, are above rather than below the average volume of the brain of people living today.*

Calculating the measurements for height, breadth, and length in inches from the average measurements of several skulls, the following totals are obtained:

1. Ancient Northern skulls of the Stone Age: 18.877 inches
2. Average of 48 skulls of the same period from England: 18.858 inches
3. Average of 7 skulls of the same period from Wales: 18.649 inches
4. Average of 36 skulls of the Stone Age from France: 18.220 inches

The average of modern Europeans living today is 18.579 inches; that of the Hottentots <note>An archaic and now offensive term for the Khoekhoe people of Southern Africa.</note> is 17.795 inches!

# THE BOON GIVEN BY PROMETHEUS.

These figures show plainly that:

The size of the brain of the oldest populations known to us is not such as to place them on a lower level than that of the inhabitants living on the Earth today.*

Besides this, they show the "missing link" <note>A hypothetical extinct creature halfway between humans and their primate ancestors.</note> vanishing into thin air. Of these matters, however, we will say more later: we must return to our direct subject.

As the *Prometheus Bound* <note>original: "Prometheus Vinctus"</note> by Aeschylus tells us, the race which Jupiter so ardently desired "to extinguish, and plant a new one in its place" (verse 241), suffered *mental*, not physical misery. The first gift Prometheus gave to mortals, as he tells the Chorus, was to prevent them "from *foreseeing death*" (verse 256); he "saved the mortal race from sinking blasted down to the gloom of Hades" <note>In Greek mythology, the underworld or the god ruling it.</note> (verse 244); and only after that did he give them fire (verse 260). At any rate, this shows plainly the dual character of the Promethean myth, even if Orientalists <note>Scholars who study the languages and cultures of Asia.</note> will not accept the existence of the *seven keys* taught in Occultism. This relates to the first opening of man's spiritual perceptions, not to his first seeing or "discovering" fire. For fire was never discovered; it has existed on Earth since its beginning. It existed in the seismic activity of the early ages, as volcanic eruptions were as frequent and constant in those periods as fog is in England now. And if we are told that men appeared so late on Earth that all but a few volcanoes were already extinct, and that geological disturbances had made room for a more settled state of things, we answer: Let a new race of men—whether evolved from Angel or Gorilla—appear now on any uninhabited spot of the Globe (with the exception perhaps of the Sahara), and it is a thousand to one that it would not be a year or two old before "discovering fire" through lightning setting the grass or something else in flames. This assumption, that primitive man lived for ages on Earth before he was made acquainted with fire, is one of the most painfully illogical of all. But old Aeschylus was an Initiate <term>Initiate: someone who has been admitted into the secret knowledge or "mysteries" of a spiritual or occult tradition.</term>, and knew well what he was revealing.†

No Occultist acquainted with symbology and the fact that Wisdom came to us from the East will for a moment deny that the myth of Prometheus reached Europe from Aryavarta <note>original: "Âryâvarta"—the ancient Sanskrit name for Northern India, meaning "the land of the Aryans."</note>. Nor is he likely to deny that in one sense Prometheus represents "fire by friction." Therefore, he admires the sagacity of M. F. Baudry, who shows in *The Myths of Fire and the Celestial Beverage* <note>original: "Les Mythes du Feu et du Breuvage Céleste"</note>‡ one of the aspects of—

## THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

Prometheus and his origin from India. He shows the reader the supposed primitive process to obtain fire, still in use today in India to light the sacrificial flame. This is what he says:

> This process, just as it is minutely described in the Vedic Sutras <note>Ancient Indian manuals of religious law and ritual.</note>, consists in rapidly turning a stick in a socket made in the center of a piece of wood. The friction develops intense heat and ends by setting on fire the particles of wood in contact. The motion of the stick is not a continuous rotation, but a series of motions in opposite directions, by means of a cord fixed to the stick in its middle; the operator holds one of the ends in each hand and pulls them alternately. . . . The full process is designated in Sanskrit by the verb *manthâmi, mathnâni*, which means "to rub, agitate, shake and obtain by rubbing," and is especially applied to rotatory friction, as is proved by its derivative *mandala*, which signifies a circle. . . . The pieces of wood serving for the production of fire have each their name in Sanskrit. The stick which turns is called *pramantha*; the disk which receives it is called *arani* and *aranî*: "the two aranis" designating the whole set <note>original: "ensemble"</note> of the instrument.*

It remains to be seen what the Brahmins <note>The priestly class of Hindu society.</note> will say to this. But even supposing that Prometheus, in one of the aspects of his myth, was conceived as the producer of fire by means of the *Pramantha*, or as an animate and divine *Pramantha*, would this imply that the symbolism had no other than the phallic meaning attributed to it by modern scholars of symbols? Decharme, at any rate, seems to have a correct glimmering of the truth; for he unconsciously corroborates all that the Occult Sciences teach with regard to the *Mânasa Devas* <note>In Theosophy, divine beings who endowed humanity with mind and self-consciousness.</note>, who have endowed man with the consciousness of his immortal soul—that consciousness which hinders man "from foreseeing death," and makes him *know* he is immortal.† "How did Prometheus come into possession of the [divine] spark?" he asks.

# GREEK IDEAS MISUNDERSTOOD.

The Greeks believed that he was of the *Divine Race*, "the son of the Titan Iapetos <note>original Greek: "Ἰαπετιονίδης" (Iapetionidēs)</note>";* the Hindus believed that he was a *Deva* <note>A celestial being or deity in Hindu mythology.</note>.

But celestial fire belonged in the beginning to the gods alone; it was a treasure they reserved for themselves, over which they watched jealously. . . . "The wise son of Iapetos," says Hesiod, "deceived Jupiter by stealing the tireless fire with its brilliant glow and hiding it in the hollow stem of a giant fennel plant <note>original: "narthex"</note>."† . . . Thus, the gift Prometheus gave to men was a conquest won from heaven. Now, according to Greek ideas (which are identical to those of the Occultists in this regard), this possession stolen from Jupiter—this human trespassing onto the property of the gods—had to be followed by an expiation <note>A way of making amends or suffering punishment for a wrongdoing.</note>. . . . Furthermore, Prometheus belongs to that race of Titans who had rebelled‡ against the gods, and whom the master of Olympus had hurled down into Tartarus <note>The deepest abyss of the underworld, used as a dungeon of torment.</note>. Like them, he is seen as a spirit <note>original: "genius"</note> of evil, doomed to cruel suffering.§

What is most revolting in the explanations that follow is the one-sided view taken of this, the grandest of all myths. Even the most intuitive among modern writers cannot, or will not, think beyond the level of the Earth and physical phenomena. It is not denied that the moral idea in the myth, as presented in the *Theogony* of Hesiod, plays a certain part in the primitive Greek conception. The Titan is more than just a thief of celestial fire. He is the representative of humanity—active, hardworking, and intelligent, but at the same time ambitious, aiming to equal divine powers. Therefore, it is humanity that is punished in the person of Prometheus, but this is only the case with the Greeks. To them, Prometheus is not a criminal, except in the eyes of the Gods. In his relationship with the Earth, he is, on the contrary, a God himself—a friend of humanity <note>original Greek: "φιλάνθρωπος" (philanthrōpos)</note>—whom he has raised to civilization and initiated into the knowledge of all the arts. This is a concept that found its most poetic expression in the works of Aeschylus. 

But with all other nations, what is Prometheus? Is he the Fallen Angel, Satan, as the Church would have it? Not at all. *He is simply the image of the harmful and dreaded effects of lightning.* He is the "evil fire" <note>original French: "mal feu"</note>|| and the symbol of the divine reproductive male organ.

Put simply, the myth we are trying to explain is then merely a [cosmic] spirit <note>original: "genius"</note> of fire.¶

It is the former idea (the phallic or sexual) which was *preeminently* Aryan, if we believe Adalbert Kuhn\* and F. Baudry. For they argue:

> Because the fire used by man is the result of the action of the *pramantha* <term>the upper wooden spindle of a fire-drill</term> in the *arani* <term>the lower wooden block of a fire-drill</term>, the Aryans must have ascribed the same origin to celestial fire. They must have† imagined that a god armed with the *pramantha*—or a divine *pramantha* itself—caused violent friction in the heart of the clouds, which gave birth to lightning and thunderbolts.‡

This idea is supported by the fact that, according to Plutarch’s testimony,§ the Stoics thought that thunder was the result of the struggle of storm-clouds, and lightning a conflagration due to friction; while Aristotle saw in the thunderbolt only the action of clouds which clashed with each other. What was this theory, if not the scientific translation of the production of fire by friction? . . . Everything leads us to think that, from the highest antiquity, and before the dispersion of the Aryans, it was believed that the *pramantha* lighted the fire in the storm-cloud as well as in the fire-drills || <note>original: "aranis"</note>.

Thus, suppositions and idle hypotheses are made to stand for discovered truths. Defenders of the literal meaning of the Bible could not help the writers of missionary tracts more effectively than do materialistic symbologists, who take for granted that the ancient Aryans based their religious conceptions on no higher thought than the physiological.

But it is not so, and the very spirit of Vedic Philosophy is against such an interpretation. For if, as Decharme himself confesses:

This means nothing worse than an abstract idea expressed in the tongue of mortals. # SECTION VII.
## ENOÏCHION-ENOCH.

---

The history of the evolution of the "Satanic Myth" would not be complete if we omitted to notice the character of the mysterious and cosmopolitan Enoch—variously called Enos, Hanoch, and finally *Enoïchion* <note>Greek variant of Enoch, often associated with the "Inner Eye" or the "Seer"</note> by the Greeks. It is from his book that the first notions of the Fallen Angels were taken by the early Christian writers.

The *Book of Enoch* is declared "apocryphal." But what is an *apocryphon*? The very etymology of the term shows that it is simply a secret book—that is, one that belonged to the catalogue of temple libraries under the guardianship of the <term>Hierophants</term> <note>high priests who interpreted sacred mysteries</note> and initiated priests, and was never meant for the <term>profane</term> <note>the uninitiated general public</note>. *Apocryphon* comes from the verb *crypto* <note>original: κρύπτω</note>, meaning “to hide.” For ages the *Enoïchion* (the Book of the Seer) was preserved in the “city of letters” and secret works—the ancient Kirjath-sepher, later known as Debir.

<margin>See *Joshua*, xv. 15.</margin>

Some of the writers interested in the subject—especially the Masons—have tried to identify Enoch with Thoth of Memphis, the Greek Hermes, and even with the Roman Mercury. As individuals, all of these are distinct from one another. However, "professionally"—if one may use this word, though its meaning is now so limited—each and every one of them belongs to the same category of sacred writers, initiators, and recorders of occult and ancient wisdom. 

Those who in the *Quran* are generically termed the *Edris* <note>original: *Surât* xix</note>, or the “Learned” and Initiated, bore the name of “Thoth” in Egypt. Thoth was the inventor of arts, sciences, writing, music, and astronomy. Among the Jews, Edris became “Enoch,” who, according to the scholar Bar-Hebræus, “was the first inventor of writing,” books, arts, and sciences, and the first who reduced the movements of the planets to a system. # WHAT ENOCH IS, ESOTERICALLY.

"Seer," "Adept in the Secret Wisdom," and similar titles are used without specifically defining the character of the person holding them. Josephus, speaking of Elijah and Enoch, <note>original: *Antiquities*, ix. 2; Josephus, *Antiquities of the Jews*, Book 9, Chapter 2.</note> remarks that:

> It is written in the sacred books that they [Elijah and Enoch] disappeared, but in such a way that no one knew that they had died.

This simply means that *they had died to their individual personalities*, just as Yogis <term>Yogis: practitioners of deep meditation and spiritual disciplines</term> do in India to this day, or even as some Christian monks do—dying "to the world." They disappear from the sight of men and die on the earthly plane, even to themselves. This is a seemingly figurative way of speaking, yet it is *literally true* in a spiritual sense.

"Enoch <note>original: Hanokh</note> transmitted the science of astronomical calculation and the computing of the seasons to Noah," says the Midrash *Pirkah*; <note>original: *Cap. viii*; Chapter 8.</note> Rabbi Eliezar refers to Enoch using the same descriptions that others apply to Hermes Trismegistus <term>Hermes Trismegistus: a legendary Hellenistic figure representing a combination of the Greek god Hermes and the Egyptian god Thoth, credited with ancient secret wisdom</term>, for the two are identical in their esoteric <term>esoteric: intended for or likely to be understood by only a small number of people with specialized knowledge</term> meaning. In this case, "Enoch" and his "Wisdom" belong to the cycle of the Fourth Atlantean Race, <note>The *Zohar* (a fundamental work of Jewish mysticism) says, "Enoch had a book which was one with the *Book of the Generations of Adam*; this is the Mystery of Wisdom."</note> and Noah belongs to that of the Fifth Race. <note>Noah is the heir to the Wisdom of Enoch; in other words, the Fifth Race is the heir to the Fourth Race.</note> In this context, both represent the "Root-Races"—the present human race and the one that preceded it.

In another sense, Enoch disappeared: "he walked with God, and he was not, for God took him." This allegory refers to the disappearance of sacred and secret knowledge from the general population; for "God" (or *Java Aleim*—the high Hierophants <term>Hierophant: a high priest or interpreter of sacred mysteries</term>, the heads of the colleges of initiated priests <note>See *Isis Unveiled*, volume 1, pages 575 and following.</note>) took him. In other words, the "Enochs" or the *Enoïchions* (the Seers and their knowledge and wisdom) became strictly confined to the secret colleges of the Prophets among the Jews and to the temples among the non-Jews.

Interpreted using only the symbolic key, Enoch is the archetype of the dual nature of man—both spiritual and physical. Consequently, he occupies the center of the "Astronomical Cross," as described by the occultist Éliphas Lévi from a secret work. This cross is a six-pointed star, the "Adonai." In the top angle of the upper triangle is the Eagle; in the bottom-left angle stands the Lion; in the right stands the Bull; while between the Bull and the Lion—above them and below the Eagle—is the face of Enoch, or Man. <note>See the illustration in *Isis Unveiled*, volume 2, page 452.</note> These figures on the upper triangle represent the four human races, omitting the first race, which were the *Chhâyâs* or "Shadows," and the "Son..."

of Man,” Enos or Enoch, is at the center, where he stands between the Fourth and the Fifth Races, for he represents the Secret Wisdom of both. These are the four Animals of Ezekiel and of the *Book of Revelation* <note>The "four animals" are the Tetramorph—the Lion, the Ox, the Man, and the Eagle—often used in mystical symbolism to represent different aspects of creation or stages of human development.</note>. This Double Triangle which, in *Isis Unveiled*, is positioned opposite the Hindu Ardhanârî <term>Ardhanârî: a composite androgynous form of the Hindu deities Shiva and Parvati, representing the union of masculine and feminine energies</term>, is by far the best representation. For in the latter, only the three (for us) historical Races are symbolized: the Third, the Androgynous, by Ardha-nârî; the Fourth, symbolized by the strong, powerful Lion; and the Fifth, the Aryan, by that which is its most sacred symbol to this day, the Bull (and the Cow).

A man of great learning, a French scholar, M. de Sacy, finds several most singular statements in the *Book of Enoch*, “worthy of the most serious examination,” he says. For instance:

> The author [Enoch] makes the solar year consist of 364 days, and seems to know periods of three, of five, and of eight years, followed by four supplementary days, which, in his system, appear to be those of the equinoxes and solstices.*

To which he adds, later on:

> I see only one way to excuse <note>original: "palliate"</note> them [these “absurdities”]; it is to suppose that the author explains some imaginary system which may have existed *before the order of Nature had been altered at the period of the Universal Deluge.*†

Precisely so; and the Secret Doctrine teaches that this “order of nature” has been thus altered, and the series of the Earth’s humanities too. For, as the angel Uriel tells Enoch:

> Behold, I have shown you all things, O Enoch; and all things have I revealed to you. You see the sun, the moon, and *those which guide the stars of heaven, which cause all their movements, seasons, and arrivals to return.* In the days of sinners *the years shall be shortened.* . . . *The moon shall change its laws.* . . .‡

In those days also, years before the Great Deluge that swept away the Atlanteans and changed the face of the whole Earth (because “the *Earth* [or its axis] became tilted”), Nature—geologically, astronomically, and cosmically in general—could not have been the same, just because the Earth had tilted. To quote from Enoch:

> And Noah cried with a bitter voice, Hear me; hear me; hear me; three times. And he said, . . . The earth labors and is violently shaken. Surely, I shall perish with it.§

This, by the way, looks like one of those many “inconsistencies,” if the *Bible* is read literally. For, to say the least, this is a very strange

# THE SECRET POWER OF THE SATANS.

It is strange to find such fear in someone who had “found grace in the eyes of the Lord” and had been instructed to build an Ark! Yet here we see the venerable Patriarch expressing as much fear as if, rather than being a “friend” of God, he were one of the Giants doomed by the wrathful Deity. The Earth had already tilted on its axis, and the flood of waters had become simply a matter of time; nonetheless, Noah seems to know nothing of his intended rescue.

A decree had indeed been issued—the decree of Nature and the Law of Evolution—stating that the Earth should change its Race, and that the Fourth Race <note>The Fourth Root-Race refers to the Atlanteans, who, according to the Secret Doctrine, were destroyed by a global flood due to their increasing materiality and misuse of spiritual powers.</note> should be destroyed to make room for a better one. The Manvantara <term>Manvantara: in Hindu cosmology, a vast period of time or a cycle of manifestation</term> had reached its turning point of three and a half Rounds, and gigantic, physical humanity had reached the peak <note>original: "acme"</note> of dense materiality. This explains the apocalyptic verse that speaks of a commandment sent forth for their destruction, “that their *end may be*”—meaning the end of that specific Race:

> For they truly *knew* every secret of the angels, every oppressive and secret power of the *Satans* <note>In this context, "Satans" refers to adversarial or chaotic forces of nature and the elements, rather than a single personified Devil.</note>, and every power of those who practice sorcery, as well as those who create molten images throughout the whole earth.*

This leads to a natural question: Who could have informed the author of this powerful vision—regardless of the age he lived in before the time of Galileo—that the Earth could occasionally tilt its axis? Where did he derive such astronomical and geological knowledge if the Secret Wisdom, from which the ancient Rishis <term>Rishis: ancient Indian sages or seers believed to have received divine inspiration</term> and Pythagoras had learned, is merely a fantasy—an invention of later ages? Did Enoch perhaps read prophetically the lines in Frédéric Klée’s work on the Deluge:

> The position of the terrestrial globe in relation to the sun was evidently different in primitive times than it is now; and this difference must have been caused by a displacement of the earth's axis of rotation.

This brings to mind that "unscientific" statement made by the Egyptian priests to Herodotus <note>Herodotus was a 5th-century BCE Greek historian known as the "Father of History."</note>: that the Sun has not always risen where it rises *now*, and that in ancient times the ecliptic <term>ecliptic: the apparent path of the Sun across the celestial sphere; its tilt relative to the equator causes the seasons</term> had crossed the equator at right angles.†

There are many such “mysterious sayings” <note>original: "dark sayings"</note> scattered throughout the Purânas <term>Purânas: a vast genre of Indian literature covering history, mythology, and cosmology</term>, the Bible, and other mythologies. To the Occultist, they reveal two facts: (*a*) that the Ancients knew as well as, and perhaps better than, modern scientists do about astronomy, geology <note>original: "Geognosy" — an older term for the study of the Earth's structure and materials</note>, and general cosmography <note>original: "Cosmography" — the science that maps the general features of the universe and the Earth</note>; and (*b*) that the behavior of the Globe has altered more than once in the past.

The *Book of Enoch*, in short, is a *summary* <note>original: "résumé"</note>, a compound of the main features of the history of the Third, Fourth, and Fifth Races <note>In the Secret Doctrine, the Third Race refers to the Lemurians, the Fourth to the Atlanteans, and the Fifth to our current humanity.</note>; a very few prophecies from the present age of the world; and a long retrospective, introspective, and prophetic summary of universal and quite historical events—geological, ethnological, astronomical, and psychic—with a touch of theogony <term>Theogony: the genealogy or origin of a system of gods</term> from the antediluvian <term>Antediluvian: belonging to the period before the biblical Flood</term> records. The book of this mysterious personage is referred to and quoted copiously in the *Pistis Sophia* <note>A key Gnostic text.</note>, and also in the *Zohar* and its most ancient Midrashim <note>Jewish commentaries on Hebrew scriptures.</note>. Origen and Clement of Alexandria <note>Influential early Christian theologians of the 2nd and 3rd centuries.</note> held it in the highest esteem. To say, therefore, that it is a post-Christian forgery is to utter an absurdity and to become guilty of an anachronism; for Origen, among others, who lived in the second century of the Christian era, mentions it as an ancient and venerable work. The secret and sacred Name and its potency are well and clearly, though allegorically, described in the old volume. From the eighteenth to the fiftieth chapter, the Visions of Enoch are all descriptive of the Mysteries of Initiation, one of which is the Burning Valley of the "Fallen Angels."

Perhaps St. Augustine was quite right in saying that the Church rejected the *Book of Enoch* from her canon because of its too great antiquity <note>original: "ob nimiam antiquitatem"</note>.† There was no room for the events noticed in it within the limit of the 4,004 years B.C. assigned to the world since its "creation"!

When the Abbé Louis Constant—better known as Éliphas Lévi—stated in his *History of Magic* <note>original: "Histoire de la Magie"</note> that the *Sepher Yetzirah* <note>original: "Sepher Jetzirah"; The Book of Formation</note>, the *Zohar* <note>The Book of Splendor, a foundational work of Jewish mysticism</note>, and the *Revelation* <note>original: "Apocalypse"</note> of St. John are the masterpieces of the Occult Sciences, he should have added—if he had wanted to be accurate and clear—"in Europe." It is quite true that these works contain "more meaning than words" and that their "expression is poetic," while their "numbers" are "exact." Unfortunately, however, before anyone can appreciate the poetry of the expressions or the exactness of the numbers, they must learn the real significance and meaning of the terms and symbols used.

But humanity will never learn this as long as we remain ignorant of the fundamental principle of the Secret Doctrine, whether in Eastern Esotericism or in Kabbalistic <term>Kabbalah: a traditional system of Jewish mysticism and localized interpretation of the Bible</term> Symbology. This principle is the "key" to the value, in all their aspects, of the names of God, angels, and patriarchs in the Bible—their mathematical or geometrical values and their relationship to the manifested natural world. Therefore, while on one hand the *Zohar* "amazes [the mystic] by the depth of its views and the great simplicity of its images," on the other hand, that work misleads the student with descriptions of Ain Suph <note>original: "Ain Suph"; also spelled Ein Sof, meaning the Infinite or Boundless Godhead</note> and Jehovah, despite the assurance that:

> The book is careful to explain that the human form with which it clothes God is but an image of the Word <note>The Logos or divine creative principle</note>, and that God should not be expressed by any thought or any form.

It is well known that Origen, Clement of Alexandria <note>original: "Clemens"</note>, and the Rabbis admitted that the *Kabbalah* and the *Bible* were veiled and secret books; but few know...

The concept of representing the *hidden* Deity as the circumference of a circle, and the Creative Power—which is both male and female, or the <term>Androgynous Word: a divine creative force containing both masculine and feminine principles</term>—as the diameter across it, is one of the world's oldest symbols. Every great theory of the origin of the universe <note>original: "Cosmogony"</note> has been built upon this idea. 

Among the ancient Aryans, the Egyptians, and the Chaldeans, this symbol was complete. It included the idea of the eternal and unchanging Divine Thought in its absolute form, entirely separate from the beginning stage of what is called "creation." It also encompassed psychological and spiritual evolution, as well as the mechanical process of building the universe <note>original: "cosmogonical construction"</note>. Among the Hebrews, however, while the earlier concept can clearly be found in the *Zohar* and the *Sepher Yetzirah* <note>original: "Sepher Jetzirah"; The Book of Formation</note> (or what remains of it), the material later included in the *Pentateuch* <note>the first five books of the Bible</note>, especially in *Genesis*, focuses only on this secondary stage. That is, it deals with the mechanical laws of creation—or more accurately, construction—while the <term>Theogony: an account of the origin and genealogy of the gods</term> is barely mentioned, if at all.

True echoes of the Ancient <note>original: "Archaic"</note> Doctrine can now only be found in the first six chapters of *Genesis*, the excluded *Book of Enoch*, and the poem of *Job*, which has been misunderstood and mistranslated. The key to this knowledge is now lost, even to the most learned Rabbis. During the early Middle Ages, their ancestors—driven by national pride and a deep hatred of Christianity—chose to let this knowledge sink into the deep sea of oblivion rather than share it with their fierce and relentless persecutors. 

Jehovah was their own tribal deity, inseparable from the Law of Moses and unsuitable for any context other than the Mosaic Law. When the "Lord God of Abraham and Jacob" was violently pulled out of his original setting—where he belonged—he could hardly be forced into the new Christian Bible <note>original: "Canon"</note> without causing contradictions and logical breaks. Because they were the weaker party, the Judeans (Jews) could not prevent this misuse of their traditions. However, they kept the secret of the origin of <term>Adam Kadmon: the "original man" or divine prototype of humanity in Kabbalah</term>, their male-female Jehovah. Consequently, the new Christian framework proved to be a complete misfit for the old God. In this way, they were indeed avenged!

These symbols become tenfold more puzzling when, instead of being correlated or shown to flow logically from one another, any single meaning is accepted as the one and only explanation of the entire symbolic idea. An instance may be given that perfectly illustrates this point. Here are two interpretations, provided by two learned Kabbalists and scholars, of the same verse in *Exodus*. Moses begs the Lord to show him his “glory.” It is obvious that the literal, surface-level phrasing found in the *Bible* is not what should be accepted. There are *seven* levels of meaning in the *Kabbalah* <note>A system of Jewish mysticism that seeks to explain the relationship between the eternal, mysterious Infinite and the mortal, finite universe.</note>, and we can provide two of them as interpreted by these scholars. One translates the passage while explaining it:

> “You cannot see My face; . . . I will put you in a cleft of the rock and I will cover you with My hand while I pass by. And then I will take away My hand, and you shall see My *a’hoor*,” <note>original: "a’hoor" — Hebrew for "back" or "behind."</note> that is, My back.*

Then the translator adds in a side-note:

> That is, I will show you “My back,” meaning My visible universe and My lower manifestations; but, as a man still in the flesh, you cannot see My invisible nature. This is the reasoning of the Kabbalah.†

This is correct and represents the cosmo-metaphysical explanation. Now, the other Kabbalist speaks, providing the numerical meaning <note>This refers to Gematria, a Kabbalistic method of interpreting Hebrew words by calculating the numerical value of their letters.</note>. Because it involves many suggestive ideas and is presented more fully, we may give it more space. This summary is from an unpublished manuscript and explains more thoroughly what was provided in Section III regarding the “Holy of Holies.”‡

The numbers assigned to the name “Moses” are the same as those for “I am that I am,” so that the names Moses and Jehovah are in numerical harmony. The word Moses is משה (M-Sh-H: 5 + 300 + 40), and the sum of its letters is 345. Jehovah—the preeminent Spirit of the Lunar Year—assumes the value of 543, which is the reverse of 345.

In the third chapter of *Exodus*, in the 13th and 14th verses, it says: And Moses said . . . "Indeed, when I come to the children of Israel and say to them, 'The God of your fathers has sent me to you,' and they say to me, 'What is his name?' what shall I say to them?" And God said to Moses, "I Am That I Am."

The Hebrew words for this expression are *ehyeh asher ehyeh*, and the values of the sums of their letters are as follows:

| אהיה (Ehyeh) | אשר (Asher) | אהיה (Ehyeh) |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| 21 | 501 | 21 |

. . . This being his [God’s] name, the sum of the values composing it (21, 501, and 21) is 543.

To provide a check and to maintain a strict use of a specific set of numbers to develop certain grand results, for which those numbers are specifically employed.

Additionally, dividing the 24 hours of the day gives three eights as the quotient <note>24 divided by 3 equals 8; thus 8-8-8</note>. . . . The primary goal of this entire system of "Number Checks" was to preserve forever the exact value of the Lunar Year in the natural measurement of days.

These are the astronomical and numerical meanings within the secret <term>theogony</term> <note>The genealogy or origin of a group of gods.</note> of the star-based and cosmic gods invented by the Chaldean-Hebrews—representing only two meanings out of seven. The other five would astonish Christians even more.

The series of "Oedipuses" <note>In Greek mythology, Oedipus was the hero who solved the riddle of the Sphinx.</note> who have attempted to interpret the riddle of the Sphinx is long indeed. For many ages, she has been devouring the brightest and noblest intellects of the Christian world; but now the Sphinx is conquered. In the great intellectual struggle that has ended in the complete victory of the "Oedipuses" of Symbolism, it is not the Sphinx who, burning with the shame of defeat, has had to bury herself in the sea. Rather, it is the many-sided symbol named Jehovah—whom Christians and civilized nations have accepted as their God—that has collapsed. The Jehovah symbol has failed under too close an analysis and is, in effect, drowned. 

Symbologists have discovered with dismay that their adopted Deity was only a mask for many other gods—at best a <term>euhemerized</term> <note>Turning a mythological figure or a natural force into a historical person or a specific god.</note> extinct planet, the <term>Genius</term> <note>A presiding spirit or planetary deity.</note> of the Moon and Saturn to the Jews, or the Sun and Jupiter to the early Christians. This triad was composed of the Sun (the Father) and the two planets Mercury (the Son) and Venus (the Holy Ghost), also known as Sophia, the Spirit of Wisdom, Love, and Truth, and Lucifer, acting as Christ, the “bright and morning star.”* For, if the Father is the Sun (the “Elder Brother”), then...

In the Eastern Inner Philosophy, the nearest planet to the Sun is Mercury (known as Hermes, Budha <note>In Sanskrit, Budha refers to the planet Mercury and the deity of wisdom, distinct from Gautama Buddha.</note>, or Thoth), whose mother on Earth was named Maia. Now, this planet receives seven times more light than any other; this fact led the Gnostics to call their Christos—and the Kabbalists to call their Hermes (in an astronomical sense)—the "Seven-fold Light." Finally, this God was Bel—the Sun being known as Bel to the Gauls; Helios to the Greeks; Baal to the Phoenicians; and El in Chaldean. From this we get El-ohim, Emmanuel, and El ("God") in Hebrew. 

But even the Kabbalistic <term>God</term> <note>Referring to the abstract concept of the divine in Jewish mysticism.</note> has vanished under the revisions of the rabbis. Ever since this key was lost, Jews and Christians have tried their best to blend these two different conceptions—the national god and the absolute—but in vain. They have only succeeded in finally stripping even the Universal Deity of its majestic character and primitive meaning.

Neither David nor Solomon recognized Moses or the law of Moses. They aspired to build a temple to **YHWH** <note>original: יהוה</note>, similar to the structures built by Hiram for Hercules and Venus, or Adon and Astarte.

### THE ANTIQUITY OF THE CROSS.

Deity of the Semites <note>original: "Shemites"; the ancient peoples of the Near East including Hebrews, Phoenicians, and Arabs.</note>. Hence it was told to Moses when he was initiated at Horeb—the cave—under the direction of Jethro, the Kenite (or Cainite) priest of Midian. In an old religion of the Chaldaeans, whose remains are to be found among the Neo-Platonists <note>Philosophers from the 3rd century AD onwards who expanded upon the teachings of Plato.</note>, the highest Divinity, enthroned above the seven Heavens, representing the Spiritual Light-Principle... and also conceived of as the <term>Demiurge</term> <note>The creator of the material universe, often considered a subordinate deity in Gnostic and Platonic thought.</note>, was called Iao <note>original: "Ιαω" (Greek) and "יהו" (Hebrew)</note>. He was, like the Hebrew Yaho, mysterious and unmentionable, and his name was shared only with those who were initiated. The Phoenicians had a Supreme God whose name was three-lettered and *secret*, and he was Iao.”†

The cross, say the Kabbalists <note>Followers of Jewish mysticism.</note>, repeating the lesson of the Occultists, is one of the most ancient—nay, perhaps, the *most* ancient of symbols. This was demonstrated at the very beginning of the Proem in Volume I. The Eastern Initiates show it as existing at the same time as the circle of Divine Infinity and the first differentiation of the Essence: the union of Spirit and Matter. This interpretation has been rejected by mainstream scholars, and the astronomical allegory alone has been accepted and made to fit into cleverly imagined earthly events.

Let us demonstrate this statement. In Astronomy, as mentioned, Mercury is the son of Caelus and Lux—of the Sky and Light, or the Sun; in Mythology, he is the offspring of Jupiter and Maia. He is the “Messenger” of his Father Jupiter, the Messiah of the Sun. In Greek, his name Hermes means, among other things, the “Interpreter”—the Word (the <note>original: "Logos" or "Verbum"</note>). Now Mercury is born on Mount Cyllene among shepherds and is the patron of the latter. As a <term>psychopomp</term> <note>original: "psychopompic Genius"; a spirit that guides the souls of the dead to the afterlife.</note>, he conducted the souls of the dead to Hades and brought them back again, a role attributed to Jesus after his death and resurrection. The symbols of Hermes-Mercury (the Gods of Boundaries <note>original: "Dii Termini"</note>) were placed along and at the turning points of highways, just as crosses are now placed in Italy, and they were cross-shaped <note>original: "cruciform"</note>.‡ Every seventh day, the priests anointed these boundary markers with oil and hung them with garlands once a year; hence, they were the *anointed* (the "christs"). Mercury, when speaking through his oracles, says:

> I am he whom you call the Son of the Father [Jupiter] and Maia. Leaving the King of Heaven [the Sun], I come to help you, mortals.

Mercury heals the blind and restores sight, both mental and physical.§ He was often represented as three-headed and called <term>Tricephalus</term> <note>From the Greek for "three-headed."</note>,

### THE SECRET DOCTRINE.

Mercury was considered threefold <note>original: "Triplex"</note>, as one with the Sun and Venus. Finally, as the philosopher Cornutus <note>Lydus, *On the Months*, book 4.</note> shows, Mercury was sometimes represented in a cubic form without arms, because "the power of speech and eloquence can succeed without the assistance of arms or feet." It is this cubic form which connects the boundary markers <term>Termini</term> <note>Statues used in antiquity to mark boundaries, often depicting the god Hermes or Mercury.</note> directly with the cross. Furthermore, the eloquence or power of speech associated with Mercury led the church historian Eusebius—whom the author calls "crafty"—to say, "Hermes is the emblem of the Word <note>original: "Logos"</note> which creates and interprets all," for he is the Creative Word. Eusebius also shows that the philosopher Porphyry taught that the "Speech of Hermes"—now interpreted as the "Word of God" in the Hermetic text *Pymander* <note>The *Poimandres*, a foundational text of Hermeticism.</note>—is a Creative Speech <note>original: "Verbum"</note>, a seminal principle scattered throughout the Universe.† 

In Alchemy, "Mercury" is the fundamental "Moist" Principle, the primitive or elementary water containing the Seed of the Universe, fertilized <note>original: "fecundated"</note> by the solar fires. To represent this fertilizing principle, the Egyptians often added a phallus to the cross (uniting the male and female, or the vertical and horizontal lines). The cross-shaped boundary markers also represented this dual idea, which was found in Egypt in the form of the cubic Hermes. The author of *The Source of Measures* explains why.‡

As he demonstrates, a cube unfolded becomes a cross in the shape of a Tau <note>The T-shaped cross.</note> or the Egyptian form; furthermore, "the circle attached to the Tau creates the ansated cross" <note>The Ankh, the Egyptian symbol of life.</note> of the ancient Pharaohs. They had known this from their priests and their "King-Initiates" for ages. They also understood the meaning of "the attachment of a man to the cross," an idea that was connected to the origin of human life and, consequently, the phallic form. However, this physical interpretation only appeared long after the original concept: the divine architect <term>Vishvakarmâ</term> <note>In Hinduism, the "All-Maker" and architect of the gods.</note> crucifying the "Sun-Initiate" <note>A symbolic representation of an initiate undergoing spiritual death and rebirth.</note> on a cross-shaped lathe. As the same author writes:

> The attachment of a man to the cross . . . was made use of in this form of display by the Hindus.§

However, this was intended to align with the idea of a person's rebirth through spiritual, rather than physical, regeneration. The candidate for initiation was attached to the Tau or astronomical cross with a concept far grander and nobler than that of the origin of mere earthly life.

On the other hand, the ancient Semitic peoples <note>original: "Semites"; the author here suggests that later cultures focused more on the procreative rather than spiritual aspects of the symbol.</note> seem to have had no other or higher purpose in life than the procreation of their species. # A PERSONAL, IS A FINITE GOD.

Geometrically <note>The word "geometrically" completes the sentence from the previous page: "...in the shape of a cross. Geometrically..."</note>, and according to the reading of the *Bible* by means of the numerical method, the author of *The Source of Measures* is quite correct.

The entire [Jewish] system seems to have been anciently regarded as one resting in nature, and one which was adopted by nature, or God, as the *basis or law* for the practical exertion of creative power—that is, it was the *creative design*, of which creation was the practical application. This seems to be established by the fact that, under the system set forth, measures of *planetary times* serve coordinately as measures of the *size of planets*, and of the peculiarity of their shapes—that is, in the length of their equatorial and polar diameters. . . . This system [that of creative design] seems to underlie the whole Biblical structure, as a foundation for its *ritualism* and for its display of the works of the Deity through architecture, using the sacred unit of measure in the Garden of Eden, the Ark of Noah, the Tabernacle, and the Temple of Solomon.*

Thus, by the very demonstration of the defenders of this system, the Jewish Deity is proved to be, at best, only the manifested <term>Duad</term> <note>A "Duad" refers to a pair or duality, representing the first stage of manifestation where the One becomes Two (e.g., spirit and matter), rather than the absolute, undifferentiated unity.</note>, never the One Absolute All. Geometrically demonstrated, he is a *number*; symbolically, he is a <term>euhemerized</term> <note>Euhemerism is the theory that mythological gods were originally human beings or personified natural forces. Here, it suggests the deity is merely a glorified symbol of physical fertility.</note> **Priapus** <note>A Greek god of fertility, often represented by phallic symbols.</note>. This can hardly satisfy a humanity thirsting for the demonstration of real spiritual truths and the possession of a God with a divine nature, rather than one in human form <note>original: "anthropomorphic"</note>. It is strange that the most learned of modern Kabalists <note>Followers of the Kabbalah, a school of Jewish mysticism.</note> can see in the cross and circle nothing but a symbol of the manifested creative and <term>androgyne</term> <note>Combining both male and female characteristics.</note> Deity in its relation to, and interference with, this phenomenal world.† One author believes that:

> However man [meaning the Jew and the Rabbi] obtained knowledge of the practical measure, . . . by which nature was thought to adjust the planets in size to harmonize with the notation of their movements, it seems he did obtain it. He valued its possession as the means of his realization of the Deity—that is, he approached so nearly to a conception of a *Being having a mind like his own*, only infinitely more powerful, as to be able to understand a *law of creation* established by that Being, which must have existed prior to any creation (called in the Kabbalah "the Word" <note>original: "Logos"</note>).‡

This may have satisfied the practical Semitic mind, but the Eastern Occultist must decline the offer of such a God. Indeed, a Deity or Being "having a mind like that of man, only infinitely more powerful," is *no God that has any place beyond the cycle of creation*. He has nothing to do with the ideal conception of the Eternal Universe. He is, at best, one of the subordinate creative powers, the Totality of which—

# A PLAGIARISM BY PASCAL.

We should not, then, look for the origin of the cross and circle in the *Bible*, but rather in the eras before the Great Flood <note>original: "beyond the Flood"</note>. Therefore, returning to the works of Éliphas Lévi and the *Zohar*, we speak on behalf of the Eastern Occultists. We say that by applying practical application to theoretical principles, they agree completely with the philosopher Blaise Pascal, who stated:

->God is a circle, the center of which is everywhere and the circumference nowhere.<-

In contrast, the Kabbalists say the opposite and maintain that position solely because they wish to veil <note>original: "veil their doctrine"; to hide the deeper meaning from the uninitiated.</note> their true teachings. Incidentally, this definition of God as a circle did not originate with Pascal at all, as Éliphas Lévi believed. The French philosopher borrowed it either from Hermes Trismegistus <note>original: "Mercury Trismegistus"; the legendary Hellenistic figure representing a combination of the Greek god Hermes and the Egyptian god Thoth.</note> or from Cardinal Cusa’s Latin work, *On Learned Ignorance* <note>original: "De Doctâ Ignorantiâ"</note>, in which he uses the phrase. Furthermore, Pascal distorted the phrase by replacing the words “Cosmic Circle”—the symbolic term in the original inscription—with the word *Theos* (God). To the ancients, however, both words meant the same thing.

---
->A.<-
### CROSS AND CIRCLE.

Ancient philosophers always attributed something divine and mysterious to the shape of the circle. The ancient world was consistent in its use of symbols and its pantheistic intuitions (the belief that the universe and God are one). By uniting the visible and invisible infinities into one, they represented both the Deity and its outward Veil alike by a circle. This merging of the two into a single unity, and the fact that the name <term>Theos</term> <note>Theos: The Greek word for "God."</note> was given to both indifferently, makes the concept even more *scientific* and philosophical. 

Plato’s etymological definition of the word <term>theos</term> (θεὸς) has been given elsewhere. In his dialogue *Cratylus*, he derives it from the verb *the-ein* (θέειν), meaning “to move” or “to run,” as suggested by the motion of the heavenly bodies, which he connects with the divine. According to Esoteric Philosophy, during its “Nights” and its “Days” (or cycles of rest and activity), this Deity is “Eternal Perpetual Motion.” It is the “Ever-Becoming,” as well as the “universally Present and Ever-Existing.” 

The latter term is a purely abstract root; the former is the only way the human mind can conceive of the divine if it removes all specific shapes or forms. It is a perpetual, never-ending evolution, circling back through ages <note>original: "æons"</note> of time in its constant progress until it returns to its original state: Absolute Unity.

It was only the minor gods who were made to carry the symbolic attributes of the higher ones. For example, the Egyptian god Shoo, the personification...

In that very learned work, *The Natural Genesis*, by Gerald Massey <note>Gerald Massey (1828–1907) was an English poet and self-taught Egyptologist whose work heavily influenced theosophical thought.</note>, under the heading “Typology of the Cross,” there is more information to be found on the cross and circle than in any other work we know of. He who would desire proofs of the antiquity of the cross is referred to these two volumes. The author says:

> The circle and cross are inseparable. . . . The Handled Cross <note>original: "Crux Ansata"; the Ankh, an Egyptian hieroglyph representing life.</note> unites the circle and cross of the four corners. From this origin, the circle and the cross came to be interchangeable at times. For example, the *Chakra*, or Disk of Vishnu, is a circle. The name denotes circling, wheeling round, periodicity, and the wheel of time. The god uses this as a weapon to hurl at the enemy. In a similar way, Thor <note>The Norse god of thunder.</note> throws his weapon, the *Fylfot*—a form of the four-footed cross [the Swastika] and a type of the four directions. Thus, the cross is equivalent to the circle of the year. The wheel emblem unites the cross and circle in one, as does the hieroglyphic cake and the Ankh-tie <image-desc>Ankh symbol</image-desc>.†

This double symbol <note>original: "glyph"</note> was not considered sacred by the general public <note>original: "the profane"</note>, but only by the Initiates. For Raoul Rochette <note>A 19th-century French archaeologist.</note> shows that:‡

> The sign ♀ occurs as the *reverse* of a Phoenician coin, with a Ram as the front side <note>original: "obverse"</note>. . . . The same sign, sometimes called "Venus’ Looking-Glass" because it represented reproduction, was used to mark the hindquarters of valuable broodmares of Corinthian and other beautiful breeds of horses.

This proves that even as far back as those early days, the cross had already become the symbol of human procreation, and that the forgetting <note>original: "obvlion"</note> of the *divine* origin of the cross and circle had begun.

Another form of the cross is described in the *Journal of the Royal Asiatic Society*:§

> At each of the four corners is placed a quarter-arc of an egg-shaped <note>original: "oviform"</note> curve, and when the four are put together, they form an oval; thus, the figure combines the cross with the circle around it in four parts, corresponding to the four corners of the cross. The four segments correspond to the four feet of the Swastika cross and the *Fylfot* of Thor. The four-leaved lotus flower of Buddha is likewise depicted at the center of this cross, the lotus being an Egyptian and Hindu symbol <note>original: "type"</note> of the four directions. This is the astronomical aspect of the double symbol <note>original: "glyph"</note>. There are six more aspects, however, and an attempt may be made to interpret a few of these. The subject is so vast that it would require many volumes on its own.

But the most curious of these Egyptian symbols of the cross and circle, mentioned in the work cited above, is one that receives its full explanation and final meaning from Aryan symbols of the same nature. The author says:

> The four-armed cross is simply the cross of the four directions <note>original: "quarters"</note>, but the cross-sign is not always simple.* This is a type that was developed from an identifiable beginning, which was adapted to the expression of various ideas afterward. The most sacred cross of Egypt that was carried in the hands of the Gods, the Pharaohs, and the mummied dead, is the Ankh <image-desc>the Ankh symbol, a cross with a loop at the top</image-desc>, the sign of life, the living, an oath, and the covenant. . . . The top of this is the hieroglyphic *Ru* <image-desc>the hieroglyphic Ru, a horizontal almond or mouth shape</image-desc> set upright on the Tau-cross. The *Ru* is the door, gate, mouth, or the place of outlet. This denotes the birthplace in the northern quarter of the heavens, from which the Sun is reborn. Hence the *Ru* of the *Ankh*-sign is the *feminine* type of the birthplace, representing the north. It was in the northern quarter that the Goddess of the Seven Stars, called the “Mother of the Revolutions,” gave birth to time in the earliest cycle of the year. The first sign of this primeval <note>original: "primordial"</note> circle and cycle made in heaven is the earliest shape of the Ankh-cross <image-desc>a looped line or noose</image-desc>, a mere loop which contains both a circle and the cross in one image. This loop or noose is carried in front of the oldest mother-creator <note>original: "genitrix"</note>, *Typhon* of the *Great Bear*, as her *Ark*, the symbolic image <note>original: "ideograph"</note> of a *period*, an *ending*, or a *time*, shown to mean one revolution. This, then, represents the circle made in the northern heaven by the Great Bear which constituted the earliest year of time. From this fact, we infer that the loop or *Ru* of the North represents that quarter, the birthplace of time, when figured as the *Ru* of the *Ankh* symbol. Indeed, this can be proved. The noose is an *Ark* or *Rek* type of reckoning. The *Ru* of the *Ankh*-cross was continued in the Cypriote R, <image-desc>a circular glyph with a small internal mark</image-desc>, and the Coptic Ro, <image-desc>the letter P</image-desc>.† The Ro was carried into the Greek cross <image-desc>a Chi-Rho monogram</image-desc>, which is formed of the Ro and Chi or *R-k*. . . . The *Rek*, or *Ark*, was the sign of all beginning <note>original: "Arche"</note> on this account, and the Ark-tie is the cross of the North, the hind part of heaven.‡
